tables.comment: Moxie-private chat state. Direct anonymous/authenticated access is forbidden; only the server-side Moxie module may use the service role.
Moxie-private contacts. Not part of Memphis operational AI context.
Moxie-private deliverables. Not part of Memphis operational AI context.
Moxie-private notes. Not part of Memphis operational AI context.
Moxie-private reminders. Not part of Memphis operational AI context.
Moxie-private suggested reminders. Not part of Memphis operational AI context.
Moxie-private suggested contacts. Not part of Memphis operational AI context.
Durable manager quality inspections linked to canonical cleaning sessions for employee/location performance comparison.
Hashed, manager-issued, expiring and revocable access grants for public CoverAll assignment pages.
Known-good forward restoration set for the canonical canary authority; no legacy writer or destructive down-migration is included.
Append-only named-manager corrections. Original sessions and at-event snapshots remain unchanged.
Revocable employee-device credentials. Only HMAC token hashes are stored.
Short-lived one-time enrollment codes generated by an authenticated Ops Manager.
Short-lived AES-GCM ciphertext for idempotent native custodial enrollment response recovery. Plaintext device credentials are never stored here.
Privacy-preserving device authentication audit events.
Explicit staged rollout state for employee-device credentials: observe, enroll, then enforce.
Immutable terminal replay records for authenticated native custodial device removal. No plaintext credentials are stored.
Service-only FCM registrations bound to one device credential, employee assignment, and assignment epoch.
Native employee event reminders. Provider acceptance is sent; ordinary swipe dismissal is local and not claimed as delivery proof.
Idempotency and audit ledger for ChatGPT Outlook-to-events synchronization. No mailbox credentials are stored.
Private object-storage metadata; binary data is never stored inline in PostgreSQL.
Private persistent Gemini Console conversations scoped to a server-authenticated manager identity.
Durable controlled repair authorization and execution evidence. Browser input cannot supply shell commands.
Server-side audit of Moxie data access. Memphis modules are not authorized to read Annie/Moxie state tables.
Server-side persistent Moxie authentication credential. Passwords are scrypt-derived; plaintext is never stored.
Recipient tracking for broadcasts.
Broadcast announcements sent by Ops Managers or admins.
Maps physical device identifiers to messenger users for auto-login.
Per-device hidden thread state so deleting a thread hides it only on that device.
Messages sent inside messenger threads.
Per-user delivery/read tracking for messenger messages.
Replay-safe ledger for user-scoped conversation removal and admin-only global tombstones. Thread ids intentionally survive content purge.
Participants in messenger threads.
Messenger conversation threads. Module-local communication layer.
Messenger module identities. Separate from scan/scheduler/events but bridged to employees.
Privacy-preserving authentication audit events. IP and user agent values are stored only as HMAC hashes.
Argon2id Device Security application password hash and rotation version. No plaintext password is stored.
Short-lived second-factor Device Security sessions for SECURITY_ADMIN trusted manager devices.
Server-side abuse protection for numeric Ops Manager enrollment code attempts. Keys are privacy-preserving HMAC hashes.
Short-lived single-use Ops Manager browser enrollment codes. code_hash is an HMAC of the normalized code; plaintext codes are returned only once by the backend and are never persisted.
Named passwordless Ops Manager principals. Device trust is stored separately in ops_manager_trusted_devices.
Per-manager-app-installation notification choices. Messages default on; event and location alerts default off.
Durable manager mobile push queue with leasing, retry and delivery audit state.
Short-lived single-use Ops Manager trusted-device pairing tokens. token_hash is persisted; raw pairing tokens are returned only by the server-side creation function.
FCM registration tokens for named manager app installations only; employee kiosk devices are not eligible.
Durable privacy-preserving per-browser/IP abuse limits for the shared numeric enrollment passcode.

One active shared Ops Manager enrollment window at a time. The server returns an eight-digit passcode once; only its keyed HMAC is persisted. Each successful use creates a separate revocable OPS_MANAGER device and does not consume the window.
Revocable Ops Manager trusted-device credentials. token_hash is an HMAC; raw cookie secrets are never persisted.
Durable, service-only public submission throttles; bucket keys are HMACs and never store raw IP addresses.
Private deployment configuration. Configure STATIC_WEEKLY_AUTHORITY_ATTESTATION_SECRET through a privileged release path; never commit, expose, or grant this HMAC key to service_role.

Private versioned scheduler HMAC keyring. Secrets are database-private and never returned by health or mutation responses. Release ownership provisions a separate control-plane database identity, sets STATIC_WEEKLY_CONTROL_PLANE_DATABASE_URL only on that deployment, rotates with at most 24-hour verification overlap, and revokes/recoveries through v3 release procedures.
Exact assignment-bound device-reported schedule render evidence; never proof a person read the schedule.
Private durable manager staffing-command ledger. PREPARING and PREPARED are not schedule authority.
Private non-authoritative complete candidate staging; rows never become schedule authority without the typed atomic commit.
Append-only effective-dated working/departed state for a stable recurring roster slot.
One immutable complete seven-day solver horizon, including the exact accepted exception set, authority receipt, replay identity, objective, metrics, and envelope.
Immutable verified temporary lunch responsibility bound to one accepted weekly projection; normal ownership and visit clocks are unchanged.

Custodial coverage target location groups. These are not event venues.

Authenticated manager UUID for cancellation; cancelled_by is the historical display-name snapshot.
Explicit manager-classified employee-visible and spoken custodial preparation. Never infer from generic notes, source text, parser, or ticket details.
Manager-selected custodial-only reminder codes. Never infer from generic notes, source text, parser, or ticket details.
Explicit America/Chicago start instant chosen by manager input; null only for legacy/uninterpreted event rows.
Explicit America/Chicago end instant chosen by manager input; null only for legacy/uninterpreted event rows.
Marketing-first approval gate. Only approved reports may be dispatched to Operations Managers and the current location custodian.
True only for canonical locations that may be selected as a primary event venue.
True for locations/areas that may be selected as custodial coverage targets; this is separate from event venue eligibility.
True for the canonical Zoo Footprint scope record.

Set only after a device explicitly acknowledges receipt. Legacy rows before this migration may contain insertion timestamps.
Set when the recipient device reports that the message was rendered to the user.
Set when an operational message or broadcast is explicitly acknowledged.
Immutable application-owned identity for singleton/system threads; null for ordinary user-created conversations.
Immutable original group RPC creation tuple; NULL means legacy UNBOUND, never inferred from current membership. Contains exact received title and ordered UUID array, not device/auth authority.
Application-owned key for a shared public messaging identity; manager authentication records remain separate.
Database-derived paused-restore evidence only; cannot remain staged when ordinary admission resumes.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_coverall.assert_packet_preparation_target(p_manager uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE p custodial_leadership_private.policy%rowtype;
BEGIN
 IF p_manager IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Explicit packet preparation target required';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM custodial_leadership_private.policy WHERE singleton FOR SHARE;
 IF p_manager=p.cohort_principal_id THEN
  IF p.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM true OR NOT coalesce('custodialManagementAdmin'=ANY(p.permissions),false)
   OR p.approved_by IS NULL OR p.approved_at IS NULL OR p.approval_ref IS NULL
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ops_manager_managers m WHERE m.manager_id=p.cohort_principal_id
    AND m.active IS TRUE AND m.revoked_at IS NULL AND m.is_system_principal IS TRUE)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Exact enabled approved management cohort target required';END IF;
  RETURN; -- Target eligibility ONLY; not an authenticated actor or browser.
 END IF;
 -- Named-target semantics remain the original manager_actor call, unchanged.
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_coverall.manual_recurring_projection_accepted(p_binding uuid, p_projection uuid, p_revision bigint, p_operation uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE b custodial_coverall.manual_application_bindings%rowtype;
 p public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections%rowtype;l public.weekly_schedule_lunch_documents%rowtype;
 o custodial_coverall.recurring_materialization_operations%rowtype;
 s custodial_coverall.recurring_materialization_stages%rowtype;
 normal public.static_weekly_manual_repeat_confirmations%rowtype;
 receipt jsonb;vector jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM custodial_coverall.manual_application_bindings WHERE operation_id=p_binding;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections WHERE projection_id=p_projection;
 IF p_projection=b.original_projection_id THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 -- A legitimate normal replay can retain the same projection for another
 -- original request. Any real matching admission proves the immutable bytes;
 -- the receipt trigger supplies its exact NEW operation, never an arbitrary one.
 SELECT operation.* INTO o FROM custodial_coverall.recurring_materialization_operations operation
  JOIN custodial_coverall.recurring_materialization_receipts r USING(operation_id)
  WHERE r.receipt_json->>'projectionId'=p_projection::text AND (p_operation IS NULL OR operation.operation_id=p_operation)
  ORDER BY operation.operation_id LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT receipt_json INTO STRICT receipt FROM custodial_coverall.recurring_materialization_receipts WHERE operation_id=o.operation_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT l FROM public.weekly_schedule_lunch_documents WHERE projection_id=p_projection;
 IF b.origin<>'MANUAL_INITIAL' OR o.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_id OR o.source_digest IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_digest
  OR o.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.publication_id OR o.version_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.version_id
  OR p.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.publication_id OR p.version_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.version_id
  OR p.week_start IS DISTINCT FROM o.frame_start OR p.week_end<>o.frame_start+6
  OR receipt->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-recurring-confirmation.v2'
  OR receipt->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'RECURRING_MANUAL_MATERIALIZATION' OR receipt->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERSISTED_CURRENT'
  OR receipt->'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.operation_id) OR receipt->'managerId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.manager_id)
  OR receipt->'sourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.source_id) OR receipt->'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.publication_id)
  OR receipt->'versionId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.version_id) OR receipt->'projectionId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_projection)
  OR receipt->'frameStart' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start) OR receipt->'frameEnd' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start+6)
  OR receipt->'authorityRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_revision) OR p_revision<o.authority_revision
  OR receipt->'lunchDocumentIdentity' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(l.document_identity)
  OR receipt->'normalSourceChanged' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR receipt->'samePhysicalTransaction' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR receipt->'normalPatternSolverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR o.request_json->'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.operation_id)
  OR o.request_json->'managerId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.manager_id)
  OR o.request_json->'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.publication_id)
  OR o.request_json->'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start)
  OR o.request_json->'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.authority_revision)
  OR o.request_json->>'idempotencyKey' IS DISTINCT FROM o.idempotency_key
  OR o.request_json->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-recurring-request.v1'
  OR o.request_json->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'RECURRING_MANUAL_MATERIALIZATION'
  OR l.document_json->>'document_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM l.document_identity
  OR l.document_json->>'base_authority_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p.authority_digest
  OR l.document_json->>'base_replay_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p.replay_digest
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original typed recurring receipt/source/publication/frame/lunch correspondence differs';END IF;
 IF o.basis_json IS NOT NULL AND o.repeat_basis IS NULL THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM custodial_coverall.recurring_materialization_stages WHERE operation_id=o.operation_id;
  IF s.envelope_json IS DISTINCT FROM p.projection_envelope OR s.lunch_json IS DISTINCT FROM l.document_json
   OR s.candidate_digest IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(jsonb_build_object('envelope',s.envelope_json,'lunch',s.lunch_json))
   OR receipt->>'candidateDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM s.candidate_digest
   OR receipt->'employmentRevisionVector' IS DISTINCT FROM o.basis_json->'employmentRevisionVector'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{semantic_snapshot,recurringOperation,operationId}' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.operation_id)
   OR p.projection_envelope#>>'{authority,schema}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-period-projection-authority.v1'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>>'{adapter,schema}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-period-database-adapter.v1'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,sourcePublicationId}' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.publication_id)
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,sourceVersionId}' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.version_id)
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,normalSourceChanged}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
   OR receipt->'newStaffingCommandCreated' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR receipt->'newPTOCreated' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Prepared or changed recurring native stage is not accepted delivery authority';END IF;
 ELSIF o.repeat_basis IS NOT NULL AND o.basis_json IS NULL THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT normal FROM public.static_weekly_manual_repeat_confirmations WHERE manager_id=o.manager_id AND request_id=o.operation_id;
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('serviceDate',d->'serviceDate','employeeId',e->'employeeId',
   'employmentRevision',e->'employmentRevision','requestId',e#>>'{command,requestId}') ORDER BY d->>'serviceDate',e->>'employeeId') INTO vector
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.repeat_basis->'employmentByDate') days(d) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d->'employees') employees(e);
  IF receipt->'originalRepeatReceipt' IS DISTINCT FROM normal.receipt_json
   OR receipt->'employmentRevisionVector' IS DISTINCT FROM vector OR normal.request_json->'employmentRevisionVector' IS DISTINCT FROM vector
   OR normal.request_json->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-recurring-reference.v1'
   OR normal.request_json->'managerId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.manager_id) OR normal.request_json->'requestId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.operation_id)
   OR normal.request_json->'sourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.source_id) OR normal.request_json->'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.publication_id)
   OR normal.request_json->'versionId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.version_id) OR normal.request_json->'frameStart' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start)
   OR normal.request_json->'frameEnd' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start+6) OR normal.request_json->'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.authority_revision)
   OR normal.request_json->'generation' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.generation) OR normal.request_json->>'catalogEntryDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM o.catalog_digest
   OR normal.request_json->'origin' IS DISTINCT FROM o.repeat_basis->'origin'
   OR normal.request_json->'baselineSnapshotDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM o.repeat_basis->'baselineSnapshotDigest'
   OR normal.request_json->'sourceProjectionIdentity' IS DISTINCT FROM o.repeat_basis->'sourceProjectionIdentity'
   OR normal.request_json->'sourceLunchIdentity' IS DISTINCT FROM o.repeat_basis->'sourceLunchIdentity'
   OR normal.request_json->>'exceptionSetDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb('[]'::jsonb)
   OR normal.receipt_json->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-recurring-confirmation.v1'
   OR normal.receipt_json->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERSISTED_CURRENT'
   OR normal.receipt_json->'source_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.source_id) OR normal.receipt_json->'publication_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.publication_id)
   OR normal.receipt_json->'projection_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_projection)
   OR normal.receipt_json->'authority_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_revision)
   OR normal.receipt_json->'frameStart' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start) OR normal.receipt_json->'frameEnd' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start+6)
   OR normal.receipt_json->>'lunch_document_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM l.document_identity
   OR normal.receipt_json->>'referenceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(normal.request_json)
   OR normal.receipt_json->'normalSourceChanged' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR normal.receipt_json->'solverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
   OR receipt->'operationalSelectionSolverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
   OR p.compiler_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved-manual-repeat-v1'
   OR p.projection_envelope->>'compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved-manual-repeat-v1'
   OR p.projection_envelope->'applied_exceptions' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
   OR p.projection_envelope#>>'{adapter,schema}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-recurring-reference-adapter.v1'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>>'{authority,repeatReference,schema}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-manual-fixed-period-reference.v1'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,repeatReference,sourceId}' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(b.source_id)
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,repeatReference,frameStart}' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(o.frame_start)
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,repeatReference,origin}' IS DISTINCT FROM normal.request_json->'origin'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,repeatReference,baselineSnapshotDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM normal.request_json->'baselineSnapshotDigest'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,repeatReference,originalProjectionIdentity}' IS DISTINCT FROM normal.request_json->'sourceProjectionIdentity'
   OR p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,repeatReference,originalLunchIdentity}' IS DISTINCT FROM normal.request_json->'sourceLunchIdentity'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original admitted normal repeat correspondence differs';END IF;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'One exact typed recurring admission kind required';END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_leadership_private.approved_names()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;valid integer;
BEGIN
 WITH approved(ord,label,key) AS(VALUES
  (1,'Eric McKenney','eric_mckenney_facilities_maintenance_manager'),(2,'Haley','haley_lejman_water_quality_manager'),
  (3,'Brandy Gull','brandy_gull_horticulture_manager'),(4,'Jennifer','jennifer_sheffield_director_operations'),
  (5,'Annie','annie_feist_operations_admin'),(6,'Eric Operle','eric_custodial_manager')),
 matches AS(SELECT a.ord,a.label,m.manager_id,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY a.ord) n
  FROM approved a JOIN public.ops_manager_managers m ON m.system_key=a.key
  WHERE m.active AND m.revoked_at IS NULL AND m.is_system_principal=false)
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId',manager_id,'displayName',label) ORDER BY ord)
 INTO valid,result FROM matches WHERE n=1;
 IF valid<>6 OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'accountId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(result) x)<>6 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_leadership_private.read_security_scope(p_manager uuid, p_credential uuid, p_device text, p_signed_expires timestamp with time zone, p_security_session uuid, p_version integer, p_security_hash text, p_csrf_hash text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE view jsonb;s custodial_leadership_private.security_scopes%rowtype;observed timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
 view:=custodial_leadership_private.session_view(p_credential);
 SELECT * INTO s FROM custodial_leadership_private.security_scopes WHERE session_id=p_security_session;
 IF view IS NULL OR view#>>'{cohort,principalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_manager::text OR view->>'browserId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_device
  OR NOT(view#>'{cohort,permissions}' ? 'custodialManagementAdmin') OR s.session_id IS NULL OR s.registration_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential
  OR s.cohort_principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_manager OR s.browser_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM p_device OR s.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
  OR s.policy_version IS DISTINCT FROM (view#>>'{cohort,policyVersion}')::integer OR s.security_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM (view#>>'{cohort,securityEpoch}')::integer
  OR s.security_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM p_version OR s.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM p_security_hash OR s.csrf_hash IS DISTINCT FROM p_csrf_hash
  OR p_security_hash IS NULL OR p_csrf_hash IS NULL OR s.created_at>observed OR s.expires_at<=observed
  OR p_signed_expires IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_signed_expires) OR p_signed_expires<=observed
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current original cohort security scope required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN least(observed+interval '5 minutes',p_signed_expires,s.expires_at,(view->>'credentialExpiresAt')::timestamptz);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_leadership_private.require_context(p_principal uuid, p_permission text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE c custodial_leadership_private.request_contexts%rowtype;view jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO c FROM custodial_leadership_private.request_contexts WHERE backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND transaction_id=txid_current();
 IF c.request_id IS NULL OR c.cohort_principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_principal OR c.permission IS DISTINCT FROM p_permission
  OR c.created_at+interval '5 minutes'<=clock_timestamp()
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Custodial authenticated original request context required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 view:=custodial_leadership_private.session_view(c.registration_id);
 IF view IS NULL OR view#>>'{cohort,principalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_principal::text
  OR(view#>>'{cohort,policyVersion}')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM c.policy_version
  OR NOT(view#>'{cohort,permissions}' ? p_permission)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Custodial original cohort credential was revoked or changed' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('manager_id',p_principal,'manager_name','Custodial leadership cohort',
  'actor_kind','CUSTODIAL_LEADERSHIP_COHORT','identity_assurance','SELF_ASSERTED_NAME',
  'credential_id',c.registration_id,'browser_id',view->>'browserId','request_id',c.request_id,'policy_version',c.policy_version,
  'custodialManagementAdmin',view#>'{cohort,permissions}' ? 'custodialManagementAdmin',
  'claimed_account_id',view#>>'{claimedAccount,accountId}','claimed_name',view#>>'{claimedAccount,displayName}',
  'individual_identity_verified',false,'owner',false,'device_id',view->>'browserId');
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.assert_inventory_manager_read(p_manager uuid, p_credential uuid, p_device text, p_signed_expires timestamp with time zone, p_security_session uuid, p_password_version integer, p_security_hash text, p_csrf_hash text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE m public.ops_manager_managers%rowtype;c public.ops_manager_trusted_devices%rowtype;
 cfg public.ops_manager_device_security_config%rowtype;s public.ops_manager_device_security_sessions%rowtype;
 observed timestamptz;BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custodial_leadership_private.policy p WHERE p.cohort_principal_id=p_manager) THEN
  RETURN custodial_leadership_private.read_security_scope(p_manager,p_credential,p_device,p_signed_expires,p_security_session,p_password_version,p_security_hash,p_csrf_hash);
 END IF;
 -- Same owner/password/security-session boundary as assert_current_manager,
 -- with NO FOR SHARE or effects: the intended port must work in READ ONLY.
 SELECT * INTO STRICT m FROM public.ops_manager_managers WHERE manager_id=p_manager;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.ops_manager_trusted_devices WHERE credential_id=p_credential;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT cfg FROM public.ops_manager_device_security_config WHERE singleton;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM public.ops_manager_device_security_sessions WHERE session_id=p_security_session;
 observed:=clock_timestamp();
 IF p_manager IS NULL OR p_credential IS NULL OR p_security_session IS NULL OR nullif(btrim(p_device),'') IS NULL
  OR m.active IS DISTINCT FROM true OR m.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR m.is_system_principal IS DISTINCT FROM false
  OR m.system_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'eric_custodial_manager' OR ('SECURITY_ADMIN'=ANY(m.roles)) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR nullif(btrim(m.display_name),'') IS NULL
  OR c.manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_manager OR c.device_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_device OR c.max_access_level IS DISTINCT FROM 'full_access'
  OR c.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR c.created_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(c.created_at) OR c.created_at>observed
  OR c.expires_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(c.expires_at) OR c.expires_at<=observed
  OR p_signed_expires IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_signed_expires) OR p_signed_expires<=observed
  OR s.manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_manager OR s.credential_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential
  OR s.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR s.created_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(s.created_at) OR s.created_at>observed
  OR s.expires_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(s.expires_at) OR s.expires_at<=observed
  OR s.password_version IS DISTINCT FROM cfg.password_version OR s.password_version IS DISTINCT FROM p_password_version
  OR p_security_hash IS NULL OR p_security_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR s.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM p_security_hash
  OR p_csrf_hash IS NULL OR p_csrf_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR s.csrf_hash IS DISTINCT FROM p_csrf_hash
  OR cfg.sessions_revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND s.created_at<=cfg.sessions_revoked_at THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='current original inventory owner read session required';END IF;
 RETURN least(observed+interval '5 minutes',p_signed_expires,c.expires_at,s.expires_at);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.assert_registered_challenge(p_challenge custodial_same_original_recovery_challenges)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE request jsonb;receipt jsonb;keys text[];BEGIN
 IF p_challenge.native_request_utf8 IS NULL OR octet_length(p_challenge.native_request_utf8) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 786432
  OR p_challenge.native_request_id IS NULL OR p_challenge.native_request_id<>p_challenge.challenge_id
  OR p_challenge.native_request_timestamp IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_challenge.native_request_timestamp)
  OR p_challenge.native_attestation_digest IS NULL OR p_challenge.native_attestation_digest !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR p_challenge.native_intent_record_sha256 IS NULL OR p_challenge.native_intent_record_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR p_challenge.native_registration_receipt_utf8 IS NULL
  OR octet_length(p_challenge.native_registration_receipt_utf8) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 24576
  OR p_challenge.native_challenge_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_challenge.native_request_utf8,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR p_challenge.native_request_timestamp>p_challenge.registered_at+interval '30 seconds'
  OR p_challenge.native_request_timestamp<p_challenge.registered_at-interval '120 seconds'
  OR p_challenge.expires_at>least(p_challenge.registered_at+interval '5 minutes',p_challenge.native_request_timestamp+interval '5 minutes') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original native preparation provenance unavailable';END IF;
 PERFORM public.custodial_v15_assert_native_json(p_challenge.native_request_utf8::json,0);
 request:=p_challenge.native_request_utf8::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(request) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='closed original challenge required';END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key COLLATE "C") INTO keys FROM jsonb_object_keys(request) key;
 IF keys IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['current_original_query_envelope_base64','native_challenge_intent_id','native_challenge_intent_record_sha256',
   'original_target','original_target_sha256','purpose','schema']::text[]
  OR request->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.same-original-recovery-native-challenge.v1'
  OR request->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'AUTHORIZE_SAME_ORIGINAL_RECOVERY_PREPARATION'
  OR request->>'native_challenge_intent_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_challenge.native_request_id::text
  OR request->>'native_challenge_intent_record_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM p_challenge.native_intent_record_sha256
  OR request->'original_target' IS DISTINCT FROM p_challenge.original_target
  OR request->>'original_target_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM p_challenge.target_sha256
  OR p_challenge.target_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.document_digest('target',p_challenge.original_target) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='exact original native preparation binding required';END IF;
 PERFORM public.custodial_v15_assert_native_json(p_challenge.native_registration_receipt_utf8::json,0);
 receipt:=p_challenge.native_registration_receipt_utf8::jsonb;
 IF receipt IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
  'schema','custodial.same-original-recovery-native-challenge-receipt.v1','state','ORIGINAL_CHALLENGE_RECORDED_PREPARATION_ONLY',
  'challenge_id',p_challenge.challenge_id,'challenge_sha256',p_challenge.challenge_sha256,'original_target_sha256',p_challenge.target_sha256,
  'native_challenge_intent_id',p_challenge.native_request_id,'native_challenge_intent_record_sha256',p_challenge.native_intent_record_sha256,
  'registered_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros(p_challenge.registered_at),'expires_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros(p_challenge.expires_at),
  'retry_safe',false,'limits',custodial_recovery.denied_effects()) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original native registration receipt changed';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.canonical_document(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result text;BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_value) IN ('string','boolean') THEN RETURN p_value::text;END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_value)<>'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='closed preparation document required';END IF;
 SELECT '{'||coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(key)::text||':'||custodial_recovery.canonical_document(value),',' ORDER BY key COLLATE "C"),'')||'}'
 INTO result FROM jsonb_each(p_value);RETURN result;
END $function$

 SELECT '{"inventory_acknowledged":false,"work_accepted":false,"replay_allowed":false,"finalizer_allowed":false,"key_removal":false,"phone_released":false}'::jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.document_digest(p_kind text, p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_kind NOT IN ('target','request','preview','receipt') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='closed preparation digest purpose required';END IF;
 RETURN encode(extensions.digest(convert_to('custodial.same-original-recovery-'||p_kind||'.v1'||E'\n'
  ||custodial_recovery.canonical_document(CASE p_kind WHEN 'preview' THEN p_value-'preview_sha256'
   WHEN 'receipt' THEN p_value-'receipt_sha256' ELSE p_value END),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.inventory_manager_original_command(p_original_utf8 text, p_manager uuid, p_credential uuid, p_device text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE request jsonb;BEGIN
 IF p_original_utf8 IS NULL OR octet_length(p_original_utf8) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='bounded original inventory decision required';END IF;
 PERFORM public.custodial_v15_assert_native_json(p_original_utf8::json,0);request:=p_original_utf8::jsonb;
 IF NOT custodial_recovery.inventory_object_keys(request,ARRAY['schema','request_id','native_request_id',
   'expected_review_sha256','expected_inventory_manifest_sha256','expected_registration_receipt_sha256',
   'expected_separation_authority_revision','expected_manager_id','expected_manager_credential_id',
   'expected_manager_device_id','decision','manager_confirmation'])
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(request) WHERE jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')
  OR request->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.original-inventory-separation-request.v1'
  OR request->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'AUTHORIZE_EXACT_ORIGINAL_RETAINED_INVENTORY_SEPARATION'
  OR request->>'manager_confirmation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONFIRM_LOGICAL_SEPARATION_KEEP_ALL_ORIGINAL_WORK_AND_KEYS'
  OR request->>'expected_manager_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_manager::text
  OR request->>'expected_manager_credential_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential::text
  OR request->>'expected_manager_device_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_device
  OR p_device IS NULL OR p_device !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['request_id','native_request_id','expected_manager_id','expected_manager_credential_id']) k
   WHERE request->>k !~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[1-5][a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['expected_review_sha256','expected_inventory_manifest_sha256','expected_registration_receipt_sha256']) k
   WHERE request->>k !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
  OR request->>'expected_separation_authority_revision' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$'
  OR (request->>'expected_separation_authority_revision')::numeric>9007199254740991 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='closed original inventory command and issuer required';END IF;
 RETURN request;
END $function$

functions.identity_arguments: saved custodial_original_inventory_separation_approvals
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.inventory_manager_receipt_document(saved custodial_original_inventory_separation_approvals)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE request jsonb;receipt jsonb;digest text;BEGIN
 request:=custodial_recovery.inventory_manager_original_command(saved.original_request_utf8,saved.manager_id,saved.manager_credential_id,saved.manager_device_id);
 IF saved.original_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(saved.original_request_utf8,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR request->>'request_id' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.request_id::text
  OR request->>'native_request_id' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.inventory_native_request_id::text
  OR request->>'expected_review_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.review_sha256
  OR request->>'expected_inventory_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.manifest_sha256
  OR request->>'expected_registration_receipt_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.registration_receipt_sha256
  OR request->>'expected_separation_authority_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.original_target->>'separation_authority_revision' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='immutable original inventory decision changed';END IF;
 receipt:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.original-inventory-separation-receipt.v1',
  'state','INVENTORY_ACK_RECORDED_LOGICAL_SEPARATION_ONLY','approval_id',saved.approval_id,
  'original_request',request,'original_request_sha256',saved.original_request_sha256,'original_target',saved.original_target,
  'issuer',jsonb_build_object('manager_id',saved.manager_id,'manager_credential_id',saved.manager_credential_id,'manager_device_id',saved.manager_device_id),
  'inventory_manifest_sha256',saved.manifest_sha256,'registration_receipt_sha256',saved.registration_receipt_sha256,
  'approved_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros(saved.approved_at),'expires_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros(saved.expires_at),
  'purpose_admission_id','exact-original-retained-inventory-separation.v1','retry_safe',false,
  'limits',custodial_recovery.denied_effects()||'{"inventory_acknowledged":true,"finalizer_allowed":true}'::jsonb);
 digest:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to('custodial.original-inventory-separation-receipt.v1'||E'\n'
  ||custodial_recovery.canonical_document(receipt),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 receipt:=receipt||jsonb_build_object('receipt_sha256',digest);
 IF saved.receipt_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND saved.receipt_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='immutable original decision receipt digest changed';END IF;
 IF saved.receipt_utf8 IS NOT NULL AND saved.receipt_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.canonical_document(receipt) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='immutable original decision receipt bytes changed';END IF;
 RETURN custodial_recovery.canonical_document(receipt);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_current_native_manager_preparation(p_operation uuid, p_device uuid, p_credential uuid, p_credential_hash text, p_credential_key_id text, p_generation uuid, p_chunk_index integer, p_original_write_request uuid, p_original_write_body_sha256 text, p_original_write_attestation_digest text, p_native_request uuid, p_native_request_timestamp timestamp with time zone, p_native_request_body_sha256 text, p_native_attestation_digest text, p_original_utf8 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE registered text;challenge public.custodial_same_original_recovery_challenges%rowtype;
 approval public.custodial_same_original_recovery_approvals%rowtype;
 manager public.ops_manager_managers%rowtype;credential public.ops_manager_trusted_devices%rowtype;
 config public.ops_manager_device_security_config%rowtype;session public.ops_manager_device_security_sessions%rowtype;
 receipt jsonb;request jsonb;observed timestamptz;until_time timestamptz;BEGIN
 -- Revalidate the SAME original native credential, frame, target, request and
 -- attestation under this one statement snapshot before looking for approval.
 registered:=custodial_recovery.read_native_registration_original(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,
  p_credential_key_id,p_generation,p_chunk_index,p_original_write_request,p_original_write_body_sha256,
  p_original_write_attestation_digest,p_native_request,p_native_request_timestamp,p_native_request_body_sha256,
  p_native_attestation_digest,p_original_utf8);
 IF registered IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT challenge FROM public.custodial_same_original_recovery_challenges WHERE challenge_id=p_native_request;
 SELECT * INTO approval FROM public.custodial_same_original_recovery_approvals WHERE challenge_id=challenge.challenge_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT manager FROM public.ops_manager_managers WHERE manager_id=approval.manager_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT credential FROM public.ops_manager_trusted_devices WHERE credential_id=approval.manager_credential_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT config FROM public.ops_manager_device_security_config WHERE singleton;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT session FROM public.ops_manager_device_security_sessions WHERE session_id=approval.security_session_id;
 observed:=clock_timestamp();
 -- Same owner/password floor as the original issue path, without row locks:
 -- this read has NO mutation/effect authority and must run in READ ONLY SQL.
 IF manager.active IS DISTINCT FROM true OR manager.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
  OR manager.is_system_principal IS DISTINCT FROM false OR manager.system_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'eric_custodial_manager'
  OR ('SECURITY_ADMIN'=ANY(manager.roles)) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR nullif(btrim(manager.display_name),'') IS NULL
  OR credential.manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM manager.manager_id OR credential.device_id IS DISTINCT FROM approval.manager_device_id
  OR credential.max_access_level IS DISTINCT FROM 'full_access' OR credential.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
  OR credential.created_at IS NULL OR credential.created_at>observed OR credential.expires_at IS NULL
  OR NOT isfinite(credential.expires_at) OR credential.expires_at<=observed
  OR NOT isfinite(approval.signed_session_expires_at) OR approval.signed_session_expires_at<=observed
  OR session.manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM approval.manager_id OR session.credential_id IS DISTINCT FROM approval.manager_credential_id
  OR session.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR session.created_at IS NULL OR session.created_at>observed
  OR session.expires_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(session.expires_at) OR session.expires_at<=observed
  OR session.password_version IS DISTINCT FROM config.password_version
  OR session.password_version IS DISTINCT FROM approval.security_password_version
  OR session.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM approval.security_token_hash OR session.csrf_hash IS DISTINCT FROM approval.security_csrf_hash
  OR config.sessions_revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND session.created_at<=config.sessions_revoked_at
  OR challenge.expires_at<=observed OR approval.expires_at<=observed OR approval.issued_at>observed THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='current original owner preparation session required';END IF;
 PERFORM public.custodial_v15_assert_native_json(approval.original_request_utf8::json,0);
 PERFORM public.custodial_v15_assert_native_json(approval.receipt_utf8::json,0);
 request:=approval.original_request_utf8::jsonb;receipt:=approval.receipt_utf8::jsonb;
 IF approval.original_request_raw_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(approval.original_request_utf8,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR approval.original_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.document_digest('request',request)
  OR approval.receipt_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.document_digest('receipt',receipt)
  OR receipt->>'receipt_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.receipt_sha256
  OR receipt->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.same-original-recovery-approval-receipt.v1'
  OR receipt->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'APPROVAL_RECORDED_ONLY'
  OR receipt->>'purpose_admission_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'same-original-preparation.v1'
  OR receipt->>'approval_id' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.approval_id::text
  OR receipt->'original_request' IS DISTINCT FROM request
  OR receipt->>'original_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.original_request_sha256
  OR receipt->'original_target' IS DISTINCT FROM challenge.original_target
  OR receipt->>'challenge_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM challenge.challenge_sha256
  OR receipt->>'preview_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM challenge.preview_sha256
  OR receipt->'issuer' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('manager_id',approval.manager_id,
   'manager_credential_id',approval.manager_credential_id,'manager_device_id',approval.manager_device_id)
  OR receipt->>'issued_at' IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.utc_micros(approval.issued_at)
  OR receipt->>'expires_at' IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.utc_micros(approval.expires_at)
  OR receipt->'retry_safe' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR receipt->'limits' IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.denied_effects()
  OR request->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.same-original-recovery-approval-request.v1'
  OR request->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'AUTHORIZE_SAME_ORIGINAL_RECOVERY_PREPARATION'
  OR request->>'manager_confirmation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONFIRM_THIS_SAME_ORIGINAL_ONLY'
  OR request->>'challenge_id' IS DISTINCT FROM challenge.challenge_id::text
  OR request->>'request_id' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.request_id::text
  OR request->>'expected_challenge_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM challenge.challenge_sha256
  OR request->>'expected_preview_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM challenge.preview_sha256
  OR request->>'expected_manager_id' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.manager_id::text
  OR request->>'expected_manager_credential_id' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.manager_credential_id::text
  OR request->>'expected_manager_device_id' IS DISTINCT FROM approval.manager_device_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original manager preparation receipt changed';END IF;
 until_time:=least(challenge.expires_at,approval.expires_at,approval.signed_session_expires_at,credential.expires_at,session.expires_at);
 RETURN custodial_recovery.canonical_document(jsonb_build_object(
  'schema','custodial.same-original-current-manager-preparation.v1',
  'state','CURRENT_MANAGER_PREPARATION_OBSERVED_NO_EFFECT_RIGHTS','purpose_admission_id','same-original-preparation.v1',
  'original_registration_utf8',registered,'original_approval_receipt_utf8',approval.receipt_utf8,
  'observed_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros(observed),'current_until',custodial_recovery.utc_micros(until_time),
  'transaction_authority',false,'limits',custodial_recovery.denied_effects()));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_native_inventory_decision_current(p_operation uuid, p_device uuid, p_credential uuid, p_credential_hash text, p_credential_key_id text, p_generation uuid, p_separation uuid, p_authority_revision text, p_native_request uuid, p_native_request_timestamp timestamp with time zone, p_native_request_body_sha256 text, p_native_attestation_digest text, p_original_request_utf8 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE registered text;saved public.custodial_original_inventory_separation_approvals%rowtype;review jsonb;receipt text;BEGIN
 registered:=custodial_recovery.read_native_inventory_request_original(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,p_credential_key_id,
  p_generation,p_separation,p_authority_revision,p_native_request,p_native_request_timestamp,p_native_request_body_sha256,p_native_attestation_digest,p_original_request_utf8);
 IF registered IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO saved FROM public.custodial_original_inventory_separation_approvals WHERE inventory_native_request_id=p_native_request;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF clock_timestamp()>=saved.expires_at OR saved.approved_at>clock_timestamp() THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original inventory approval no longer current';END IF;
 receipt:=custodial_recovery.inventory_manager_receipt_document(saved);
 -- The current native caller cannot select the manager/session or reuse a
 -- historical receipt as live authority. All pins derive from its immutable
 -- actual original issuing row, then the complete semantics are re-read now.
 review:=custodial_recovery.review_original_inventory(saved.manager_id,saved.manager_credential_id,saved.manager_device_id,
  saved.signed_session_expires_at,saved.security_session_id,saved.security_password_version,saved.security_token_hash,saved.security_csrf_hash,
  saved.inventory_native_request_id);
 IF review IS NULL OR review->>'review_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.review_sha256
  OR review->'original_target' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.original_target
  OR review->>'inventory_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.manifest_sha256
  OR review->>'registration_receipt_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM saved.registration_receipt_sha256
  OR registered IS DISTINCT FROM custodial_recovery.read_native_inventory_request_original(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,p_credential_key_id,
   p_generation,p_separation,p_authority_revision,p_native_request,p_native_request_timestamp,p_native_request_body_sha256,p_native_attestation_digest,p_original_request_utf8)
  OR clock_timestamp()>=saved.expires_at THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='current exact original inventory approval source changed';END IF;
 RETURN receipt; -- Still DATA; no native capability, removal or replay authority.
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_native_inventory_manifest_chunk_original(p_operation uuid, p_device uuid, p_credential uuid, p_credential_hash text, p_credential_key_id text, p_generation uuid, p_separation uuid, p_authority_revision text, p_native_request uuid, p_native_request_timestamp timestamp with time zone, p_native_request_body_sha256 text, p_native_attestation_digest text, p_original_request_utf8 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE request jsonb;row public.custodial_native_inventory_manifest_chunks%rowtype;BEGIN
 request:=custodial_recovery.assert_native_inventory_manifest_original(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,p_credential_key_id,
  p_generation,p_separation,p_authority_revision,p_original_request_utf8);
 SELECT * INTO row FROM public.custodial_native_inventory_manifest_chunks
  WHERE inventory_native_request_id=(request->>'inventory_native_request_id')::uuid
   AND chunk_index=(request->>'manifest_chunk_index')::integer;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF row.native_request_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_request OR row.native_request_timestamp IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_request_timestamp
  OR row.original_request_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM p_original_request_utf8 OR row.request_body_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_request_body_sha256
  OR row.native_attestation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_attestation_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='same original manifest chunk status only';END IF;
 RETURN row.receipt_utf8;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_native_registration_original(p_operation uuid, p_device uuid, p_credential uuid, p_credential_hash text, p_credential_key_id text, p_generation uuid, p_chunk_index integer, p_original_write_request uuid, p_original_write_body_sha256 text, p_original_write_attestation_digest text, p_native_request uuid, p_native_request_timestamp timestamp with time zone, p_native_request_body_sha256 text, p_native_attestation_digest text, p_original_utf8 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE source jsonb;original public.custodial_same_original_recovery_challenges%rowtype;BEGIN
 IF p_operation IS NULL OR p_device IS NULL OR p_credential IS NULL OR p_generation IS NULL OR p_native_request IS NULL
  OR p_original_write_request IS NULL OR p_chunk_index IS DISTINCT FROM 0
  OR p_original_utf8 IS NULL OR octet_length(p_original_utf8) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 786432
  OR p_native_request_timestamp IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_native_request_timestamp)
  OR p_native_request_body_sha256 IS NULL OR p_native_request_body_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR p_native_attestation_digest IS NULL OR p_native_attestation_digest !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_original_utf8,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_request_body_sha256 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='fixed same original native status inputs required';END IF;
 -- Same statement snapshot/current original credential and complete retained
 -- target. Never replace issuer/generation from today's defaults or a row ID.
 source:=custodial_recovery.read_original_target(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,p_credential_key_id,p_generation,
  p_chunk_index,p_original_write_request,p_original_write_body_sha256,p_original_write_attestation_digest);
 IF source IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO original FROM public.custodial_same_original_recovery_challenges WHERE challenge_id=p_native_request;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF original.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_operation
  OR original.target_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM source->>'original_target_sha256'
  OR original.original_target IS DISTINCT FROM source->'original_target'
  OR original.native_request_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_request
  OR original.native_request_timestamp IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_request_timestamp
  OR original.native_challenge_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_request_body_sha256
  OR original.native_attestation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_native_attestation_digest
  OR original.native_request_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM p_original_utf8 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='native status belongs to another original request';END IF;
 PERFORM custodial_recovery.assert_registered_challenge(original);
 -- Exact stored receipt, including its original expiry and six false effects.
 -- Expired historical evidence is not renewed current preparation authority.
 RETURN original.native_registration_receipt_utf8;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_original_completion(p_operation uuid, p_device uuid, p_credential uuid, p_credential_hash text, p_credential_key_id text, p_generation uuid, p_chunk_index integer, p_native_request uuid, p_request_sha256 text, p_attestation_digest text, p_original_completion_utf8 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE target jsonb;p_payload jsonb;p_device_uuid uuid;p_identifier text;p_employee uuid;p_epoch bigint;
 v_control jsonb;v_response jsonb;v_evidence jsonb;v_correlation text;bad boolean;hit record;
 hits integer:=0;fingerprint jsonb;accepted jsonb:=NULL;disposition text:='UNRESOLVED_RETAINED';
BEGIN
 -- Revalidate the same complete retained frame, original credential, inactive
 -- original employee, separation and generation in THIS statement snapshot.
 target:=custodial_recovery.read_original_target(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,p_credential_key_id,
  p_generation,p_chunk_index,p_native_request,p_request_sha256,p_attestation_digest);
 IF target IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF p_chunk_index IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR p_original_completion_utf8 IS NULL
  OR octet_length(p_original_completion_utf8) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='bounded original completion DATA required';END IF;
 -- Duplicate detection over JSON, BEFORE jsonb conversion, with no integer/
 -- float coercion. The original raw UTF8 remains the input/hash identity.
 WITH RECURSIVE nodes(v,d) AS (
  SELECT p_original_completion_utf8::json,0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.v,n.d+1 FROM nodes n CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT value v FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_typeof(n.v)='object' THEN n.v ELSE '{}'::json END)
   UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_array_elements(CASE WHEN json_typeof(n.v)='array' THEN n.v ELSE '[]'::json END)
  ) child WHERE n.d<=24
 )
 SELECT count(*)>32768 OR coalesce(max(d),0)>24 OR coalesce(bool_or(
  CASE WHEN json_typeof(v)='object' THEN
   (SELECT count(*)<>count(DISTINCT key COLLATE "C") FROM json_each(v))
  ELSE false END),false) INTO bad FROM nodes;
 IF bad THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='original completion JSON ambiguity or bounds';END IF;
 p_payload:=p_original_completion_utf8::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) k WHERE k NOT IN(
   'p_device_id','p_client_session_id','p_client_completion_id','p_location_code','p_client_started_at','p_client_ended_at',
   'p_response_json','p_scan_evidence','p_correlation_id','p_native_finish_scan_entry_id',
   'p_native_completion_attestation_version','p_native_completion_attestation',
   'p_native_completion_transport_attestation_version','p_native_completion_transport_attestation',
   'p_context_id','p_occurrence_id','p_submission_proof','p_snapshot_id','p_snapshot_employee_id',
   'p_snapshot_assignment_epoch','p_snapshot_credential_id'))
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'p_response_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'p_scan_evidence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(p_payload->'p_scan_evidence') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='original completion shape required';END IF;
 p_device_uuid:=(target#>>'{original_target,canonical_device_pk}')::uuid;
 p_identifier:=target#>>'{original_target,canonical_device_id}';
 p_employee:=(target#>>'{original_target,employee_id}')::uuid;
 p_epoch:=(target#>>'{original_target,assignment_epoch}')::bigint;
 IF p_device_uuid IS DISTINCT FROM p_device OR p_payload->>'p_device_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_identifier
  OR (target#>>'{original_target,credential_id}')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential
  OR p_payload->>'p_native_completion_attestation_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial-native-completion.v2'
  OR coalesce(lower(btrim(p_payload->>'p_native_completion_attestation')),'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='same original completion actor required';END IF;
 v_control:=p_payload#>'{p_response_json,__custodial_offline_reconciliation_v1}';
 IF jsonb_typeof(v_control) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR coalesce(v_control->>'context_id','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR coalesce(v_control->>'submission_proof','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='original completion proof required';END IF;
 IF p_payload->'p_submission_proof' IS NOT NULL AND p_payload->'p_submission_proof'<>'null'::jsonb
  AND p_payload->>'p_submission_proof' IS DISTINCT FROM v_control->>'submission_proof' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='contradictory original completion proof';END IF;
 v_response:=(p_payload->'p_response_json')-'__custodial_offline_reconciliation_v1';
 v_evidence:=p_payload->'p_scan_evidence';
 v_correlation:=coalesce(nullif(p_payload->>'p_correlation_id',''),'scan-commit:'||(p_payload->>'p_client_session_id')||':'||(p_payload->>'p_client_completion_id'));
 -- Carry the existing exact original record/session/native-finish/payload/
 -- proof/evidence predicates. ONLY ordinary active-employee transport checks
 -- are replaced by the preceding same-statement original-target authorization.
 FOR hit IN
select receipt.result_json || jsonb_build_object(
    'reconciliation_id',receipt.reconciliation_id,
    'started_at',to_char(context.started_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
    'ended_at',to_char(context.native_completed_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
    'completed_at',to_char(context.native_completed_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
    'native_completion_attested',true,'native_finish_scan_entry_id',context.native_finish_scan_entry_id) as result,
    (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fingerprint',evidence.event_fingerprint,
      'source',jsonb_build_object(
        'client_event_id',evidence.client_event_id,'context_id',context.context_id::text,'device_id',context.device_id::text,
        'event_type',evidence.event_payload->>'event_type','location_id',context.location_id::text,
        'payload_json',coalesce(evidence.event_payload->'payload_json','{}'::jsonb),
        'result',nullif(evidence.event_payload->>'result',''),
        'scanned_at',(evidence.event_payload->>'scanned_at')::timestamptz,
        'session_id',session.id::text,'notes',nullif(evidence.event_payload->>'notes',''))::text)
      order by evidence.client_event_id)
      from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
      where evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id
        and evidence.context_id=context.context_id and evidence.session_id=session.id) as event_fingerprints,
    jsonb_build_object(
    'accepted_session_id',session.id,'reconciliation_id',receipt.reconciliation_id,'context_id',context.context_id,
    'occurrence_id',context.occurrence_id,'original_employee_id',context.employee_id,
    'original_credential_id',context.credential_id,'device_id',context.device_id,
    'location_id',context.location_id,'client_session_id',receipt.client_session_id,
    'client_completion_id',receipt.client_completion_id,'assignment_epoch',context.assignment_epoch,
    'payload_fingerprint',receipt.payload_fingerprint,'submitted_at',response.submitted_at) as original
  from public.custodial_offline_reconciliation_records receipt
  join public.custodial_offline_actor_contexts context on context.context_id=receipt.context_id
  join public.sessions session on session.id=receipt.session_id
  join public.completion_responses response on response.id=receipt.completion_response_id
  join public.devices device on device.id=context.device_id
  join public.employees employee on employee.id=context.employee_id
  join public.locations location on location.id=context.location_id
  join public.custodial_offline_submission_proofs proof on proof.context_id=context.context_id
  where receipt.client_session_id=(p_payload->>'p_client_session_id')
    and receipt.client_completion_id=(p_payload->>'p_client_completion_id')
    and receipt.context_id=(v_control->>'context_id')::uuid
    and receipt.state='committed' and receipt.quarantine_reason is null
    and context.status='committed' and session.status='closed' and proof.state='consumed'
    and proof.proof_digest=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_control->>'submission_proof','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    and receipt.occurrence_id=context.occurrence_id and receipt.occurrence_fingerprint=context.occurrence_fingerprint
    and receipt.original_employee_id=context.employee_id and receipt.credential_id=context.credential_id
    and receipt.device_id=context.device_id and receipt.location_id=context.location_id
    and context.client_session_id=session.client_session_id and receipt.client_session_id=session.client_session_id
    and context.employee_id=session.employee_id and context.device_id=session.device_id and context.location_id=session.location_id
    and response.session_id=session.id and response.client_completion_id=receipt.client_completion_id
    and response.location_id=context.location_id and response.device_id=context.device_id
    and response.submitted_by_employee_id=context.employee_id
    and context.started_at=session.started_at and context.native_completed_at=session.ended_at
    and context.started_at=(p_payload->>'p_client_started_at')::timestamptz
    and context.native_completed_at=(p_payload->>'p_client_ended_at')::timestamptz
    and context.native_completed_at>context.started_at and isfinite(context.native_completed_at)
    and context.native_start_attestation_version='custodial-native-start.v1' and context.native_scan_entry_id is not null
    and context.native_completion_attestation_version='custodial-native-completion.v2'
    and context.native_completion_attestation_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(lower(btrim(p_payload->>'p_native_completion_attestation')),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    and context.native_finish_scan_entry_id=(p_payload->>'p_native_finish_scan_entry_id')::uuid
    and context.native_finish_scan_entry_id<>context.native_scan_entry_id
    and (context.canonical_location_code=(p_payload->>'p_location_code')
      or context.location_aliases @> jsonb_build_array((p_payload->>'p_location_code')::text))
    and location.id=session.location_id
    and device.id=p_device_uuid::uuid and device.device_id=p_identifier
    and (p_payload->>'p_device_id')=device.device_id 
    and device.assigned_employee_id=context.employee_id and context.employee_id=p_employee::uuid
    and device.assignment_epoch=context.assignment_epoch and context.assignment_epoch=p_epoch
    and context.credential_id=p_credential::uuid
    and receipt.payload_json->'response_json'=v_response::jsonb
    and response.response_json=receipt.payload_json->'response_json'
    and receipt.payload_json->'scan_evidence'=v_evidence::jsonb
    and receipt.payload_fingerprint=public.custodial_offline_payload_fingerprint(context,
      (p_payload->>'p_client_completion_id'),(p_payload->>'p_client_started_at')::timestamptz,
      (p_payload->>'p_client_ended_at')::timestamptz,v_response::jsonb,
      v_evidence::jsonb,v_correlation)
    and receipt.result_json->>'status'='closed'
    and receipt.result_json->>'client_session_id'=receipt.client_session_id
    and receipt.result_json->>'client_completion_id'=receipt.client_completion_id
    and receipt.result_json->>'session_uuid'=session.session_uuid
    and receipt.result_json->>'completion_response_id'=response.id::text
    and receipt.result_json->>'occurrence_id'=context.occurrence_id::text
    and receipt.result_json->>'original_employee_id'=context.employee_id::text
    and (receipt.result_json->>'started_at')::timestamptz=context.started_at
    and (receipt.result_json->>'ended_at')::timestamptz=context.native_completed_at
    and receipt.result_json->>'correlation_id' is not distinct from nullif(btrim(v_correlation),'')
    and (p_payload->'p_context_id' is null or p_payload->'p_context_id'='null'::jsonb or context.context_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_context_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_occurrence_id' is null or p_payload->'p_occurrence_id'='null'::jsonb or context.occurrence_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_occurrence_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_id' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_id'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_employee_id' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_employee_id'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_employee_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_employee_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_assignment_epoch' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_assignment_epoch'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_assignment_epoch::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_assignment_epoch'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_credential_id' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_credential_id'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_credential_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_credential_id'))
    and (select count(*) from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
      where evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id)=jsonb_array_length(receipt.payload_json->'scan_evidence')
    and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(receipt.payload_json->'scan_evidence') event
      where not exists(select 1 from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
        where evidence.client_event_id=btrim(event->>'client_event_id') and evidence.context_id=context.context_id
          and evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id and evidence.session_id=session.id
          and evidence.event_payload=event))
    and (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(receipt.payload_json->'scan_evidence') event
      where event->>'event_type'='scan_finish')=1
    and exists(select 1 from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
      where evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id and evidence.context_id=context.context_id and evidence.session_id=session.id
        and lower(evidence.client_event_id)=context.native_finish_scan_entry_id::text
        and evidence.event_payload->>'event_type'='scan_finish' and evidence.event_payload->>'result'='ok'
        and evidence.event_payload#>>'{payload_json,entry_source}'='native-nfc'
        and evidence.event_payload->>'scanned_at'=(p_payload->>'p_client_ended_at'))
  limit 2
 LOOP
  hits:=hits+1;
  IF hits>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='ambiguous accepted original completion';END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(hit.event_fingerprints) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(hit.event_fingerprints)<>jsonb_array_length(v_evidence) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original event fingerprint coverage changed';END IF;
  FOR fingerprint IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(hit.event_fingerprints) LOOP
   IF jsonb_typeof(fingerprint) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
    (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(fingerprint))<>2 OR
    jsonb_typeof(fingerprint->'source') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR
    octet_length(fingerprint->>'source')>16384 OR
    fingerprint->>'fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(fingerprint->>'source','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original event fingerprint changed';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  accepted:=jsonb_build_object(
   'reconciliation_id',hit.original->>'reconciliation_id','context_id',hit.original->>'context_id',
   'occurrence_id',hit.original->>'occurrence_id','session_id',hit.original->>'accepted_session_id',
   'completion_response_id',hit.result->>'completion_response_id','client_session_id',hit.original->>'client_session_id',
   'client_completion_id',hit.original->>'client_completion_id','employee_id',hit.original->>'original_employee_id',
   'credential_id',hit.original->>'original_credential_id','assignment_epoch',hit.original->>'assignment_epoch',
   'payload_fingerprint',hit.original->>'payload_fingerprint',
   'started_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros((hit.result->>'started_at')::timestamptz),
   'ended_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros((hit.result->>'ended_at')::timestamptz),
   'submitted_at',custodial_recovery.utc_micros((hit.original->>'submitted_at')::timestamptz),
   'location_id',hit.original->>'location_id');
  disposition:='ACCEPTED_EXACT_ORIGINAL';
 END LOOP;
 -- This purpose's closed response explicitly permits JSON null for retained
 -- unknown work. The preparation signer intentionally rejects null; do not
 -- widen that shared authority serializer or turn unknown into acceptance.
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  'schema','custodial.same-original-completion-SQL-read.v1',
  'state','CURRENT_EXACT_ORIGINAL_COMPLETION_DISPOSITION_NOT_ACK',
  'operation_id',p_operation::text,'original_generation_id',p_generation::text,
  'argument_values_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_original_completion_utf8,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'disposition',disposition,'result',accepted,'transaction_authority',false,'limits',custodial_recovery.denied_effects())::text;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_original_preparation(p_manager uuid, p_credential uuid, p_device text, p_signed_expires timestamp with time zone, p_security_session uuid, p_password_version integer, p_security_hash text, p_csrf_hash text, p_original_utf8 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE request jsonb;prior public.custodial_same_original_recovery_approvals%rowtype;BEGIN
 PERFORM custodial_recovery.assert_current_manager(p_manager,p_credential,p_device,p_signed_expires,
 p_security_session,p_password_version,p_security_hash,p_csrf_hash);
 IF p_original_utf8 IS NULL OR octet_length(p_original_utf8) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='original preparation status request required';END IF;
 PERFORM public.custodial_v15_assert_native_json(p_original_utf8::json,0);request:=p_original_utf8::jsonb;
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.custodial_same_original_recovery_approvals WHERE request_id=(request->>'request_id')::uuid;
 IF NOT FOUND OR prior.manager_id<>p_manager OR prior.manager_credential_id<>p_credential OR prior.manager_device_id<>p_device
  OR prior.original_request_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM p_original_utf8 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 RETURN prior.receipt_utf8; -- Original bytes/time only; never writer/upsert/renew.
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_original_target(p_operation uuid, p_device uuid, p_credential uuid, p_credential_hash text, p_credential_key_id text, p_generation uuid, p_chunk_index integer, p_native_request uuid, p_request_sha256 text, p_attestation_digest text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE source jsonb;op public.custodial_native_private_custody_operations%rowtype;
 credential public.device_auth_credentials%rowtype;descriptor jsonb;BEGIN
 -- The owning fixed reader verifies current original credential, separation,
 -- generation and exact already-retained WRITE target in this same snapshot.
 source:=public.custodial_private_custody_v1_read_complete_frame(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,p_credential_key_id,
  p_generation,p_chunk_index,p_native_request,p_request_sha256,p_attestation_digest);
 IF source IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF source->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_OPAQUE_FRAME_BYTES_ONLY' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='complete original recovery source unavailable';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT op FROM public.custodial_native_private_custody_operations
  WHERE operation_id=p_operation AND device_id=p_device AND credential_id=p_credential AND generation_id=p_generation;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT credential FROM public.device_auth_credentials WHERE credential_id=p_credential AND device_id=p_device;
 -- Missing or rotated issuer provenance is NOT filled from current defaults.
 -- This pin describes the existing server credential issuer, not phone AES.
 IF jsonb_typeof(credential.metadata_json->'credential_secret_key_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR credential.metadata_json->>'credential_secret_key_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential_key_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original credential issuer provenance unavailable';END IF;
 descriptor:=jsonb_build_object('operation_id',op.operation_id,'separation_id',op.separation_id,
  'separation_authority_revision',op.original_context->>'authority_revision','canonical_device_pk',op.device_id,
  'canonical_device_id',op.original_context->>'canonical_device_id','employee_id',op.original_context->>'employee_id',
  'credential_id',op.credential_id,'assignment_epoch',op.original_context->>'assignment_epoch',
  'original_generation_id',op.generation_id,'original_credential_secret_key_id',credential.metadata_json->>'credential_secret_key_id',
  'principal_digest',op.principal_digest,'engine_revision',op.owner_proof->>'engine_revision',
  'original_wire_sha256',op.original_wire_sha256,'original_frozen_work_sha256',op.owner_proof->>'original_frozen_work_sha256',
  'capsule_sha256',op.owner_proof->>'capsule_sha256','record_sha256',op.record_sha256,'frame_sha256',op.frame_sha256,
  'plan_sha256',op.plan_sha256,'aad_binding_sha256',op.owner_proof->>'aad_binding_sha256',
  'source_capture_sha256',op.owner_proof->>'source_capture_sha256','values_sha256',op.owner_proof->>'values_sha256',
  'semantic_join_sha256',op.owner_proof->>'semantic_join_sha256','layout_sha256',op.owner_proof->>'layout_sha256');
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(descriptor) WHERE jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='original recovery target has unresolved fields';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.same-original-recovery-target-SQL.v1',
  'state','ORIGINAL_TARGET_DESCRIPTOR_ONLY','original_target',descriptor,
  'original_target_sha256',custodial_recovery.document_digest('target',descriptor),
  'original_write_readback',source->'readback','limits',custodial_recovery.denied_effects());
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ack_device_notification(p_device_identifier text, p_notification_key text, p_notification_type text DEFAULT 'notification'::text, p_action text DEFAULT 'dismissed'::text, p_metadata_json jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_device text;v_key text:=nullif(btrim(p_notification_key),'');v_action text:=lower(btrim(p_action));
 v_type text:=lower(btrim(p_notification_type));v_row public.device_notification_acknowledgements%rowtype;
begin
 if nullif(btrim(p_device_identifier),'') is null or length(p_device_identifier)>200
  or v_key is null or length(v_key)>500 or v_type is null or length(v_type) not between 1 and 80
  or v_action is null or v_action not in ('received','displayed','dismissed','opened','acknowledged')
  or jsonb_typeof(p_metadata_json) is distinct from 'object' then raise exception 'invalid notification receipt'; end if;
 if v_type='lunch_coverage' then raise exception 'native lunch receipt requires exact credential and assignment binding'; end if;
 select d.device_id into v_device from public.devices d where d.active
  and upper(btrim(d.device_id))=upper(btrim(p_device_identifier));
 if v_device is null then select d.device_id into v_device from public.device_aliases a
  join public.devices d on d.id=a.canonical_device_id and d.active where a.active
  and upper(btrim(a.alias_identifier))=upper(btrim(p_device_identifier)); end if;
 if v_device is null then raise exception 'active device not found'; end if;
 insert into public.device_notification_acknowledgements(device_identifier,notification_key,notification_type,
  received_at,displayed_at,dismissed_at,opened_at,acknowledged_at,metadata_json)
 values(v_device,v_key,v_type,
  case when v_action='received' then statement_timestamp() end,
  case when v_action='displayed' then statement_timestamp() end,
  case when v_action='dismissed' then statement_timestamp() end,
  case when v_action='opened' then statement_timestamp() end,
  case when v_action='acknowledged' then statement_timestamp() end,p_metadata_json)
 on conflict(device_identifier,notification_key,credential_id,assignment_epoch) do update set
  received_at=coalesce(device_notification_acknowledgements.received_at,excluded.received_at),
  displayed_at=coalesce(device_notification_acknowledgements.displayed_at,excluded.displayed_at),
  dismissed_at=coalesce(device_notification_acknowledgements.dismissed_at,excluded.dismissed_at),
  opened_at=coalesce(device_notification_acknowledgements.opened_at,excluded.opened_at),
  acknowledged_at=coalesce(device_notification_acknowledgements.acknowledged_at,excluded.acknowledged_at),
  updated_at=statement_timestamp()
 returning * into v_row;
 return to_jsonb(v_row);
end $function$
