CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_manager_list_offline_reconciliations(p_manager_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_before timestamp with time zone, p_backend_execution_secret text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.custodial_require_backend_execution_secret(p_backend_execution_secret);
  if not exists(select 1 from public.ops_manager_managers m where m.manager_id=p_manager_id and m.active=true and m.revoked_at is null and m.roles && array['OPS_MANAGER','DIRECTOR','SECURITY_ADMIN']::text[]) then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='active named manager authority is required'; end if;
  return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'reconciliation_id',r.reconciliation_id,'state',r.state,'reason',r.quarantine_reason,'original_employee_id',r.original_employee_id,'occurrence_id',r.occurrence_id,'created_at',r.created_at,
    'notifications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('outbox_id',o.outbox_id,'notification_kind',o.notification_kind,'disposition_id',o.disposition_id,'state',o.state,
      'status_label',case o.state when 'pending' then 'Pending delivery' when 'claimed' then 'Delivery in progress' when 'retry' then 'Retry scheduled' when 'delivered' then 'Delivered' else 'Delivery unavailable' end,
      'attempts',o.attempts,'claimed_at',o.claimed_at,'lease_expires_at',o.lease_expires_at,'next_attempt_at',o.next_attempt_at,'delivered_at',o.delivered_at,'failed_at',o.failed_at,'last_error',nullif(left(coalesce(o.last_error,''),500),''),
      'recipient_count',(select count(*) from public.custodial_offline_reconciliation_delivery_recipients dr where dr.outbox_id=o.outbox_id)) order by o.created_at,o.outbox_id) from public.custodial_offline_reconciliation_outbox o where o.reconciliation_id=r.reconciliation_id),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) order by r.created_at desc) from (select * from public.custodial_offline_reconciliation_records where p_before is null or created_at<p_before order by created_at desc limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,50),100))) r),'[]'::jsonb);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_manager_open_problems(p_manager_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_backend_execution_secret text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit integer:=greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,100),200));
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  perform public.custodial_require_backend_execution_secret(p_backend_execution_secret);
  if not exists(select 1 from public.ops_manager_managers m where m.manager_id=p_manager_id
    and m.active=true and m.revoked_at is null and m.is_system_principal=false
    and m.roles && array['OPS_MANAGER','CUSTODIAL_MANAGER','DIRECTOR','SECURITY_ADMIN']::text[]) then
    raise exception using errcode='42501',message='active named manager authority is required';
  end if;
  with items as (
    select 'maintenance'::text as source, t.id::text as source_id,
      case when t.issue_source='completion_form' then 'Cleaning issue / maintenance reminder'
        else 'Maintenance reminder' end as source_label,
      coalesce(t.location_name_snapshot,l.location_name,t.location_code_snapshot,l.location_code) as location,
      t.issue_summary as summary,t.reported_at as observed_at,'open'::text as status,
      t.issue_source as source_detail
    from public.maintenance_tickets t left join public.locations l on l.id=t.location_id
    where t.status='open'
    union all
    select 'guest'::text,g.id::text,'Approved guest issue'::text,
      coalesce(g.location_name,g.location_code),g.issue_type,g.submitted_at,'open'::text,g.severity
    from public.guest_cleanliness_reports g
    where g.status='open' and g.marketing_review_status='approved'
      and exists(select 1 from public.system_settings s where s.setting_key='guest_issues_feature_approved'
        and s.setting_value='true'::jsonb)
    union all
    select 'saved_work'::text,r.reconciliation_id::text,'Protected saved work needs review'::text,
      coalesce(l.location_name,l.location_code,'Location not available'),
      'Protected work requires manager review'::text,r.created_at,
      'quarantined'::text,'offline_reconciliation'::text
    from public.custodial_offline_reconciliation_records r
    left join public.locations l on l.id=r.location_id
    where r.state='quarantined' and not exists (
      select 1 from public.custodial_offline_reconciliation_dispositions d
      where d.reconciliation_id=r.reconciliation_id and d.disposition='superseded_by_new_occurrence'
    )
  ), bounded as (
    select * from items order by observed_at desc nulls last,source,source_id limit v_limit
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from items),
    'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) order by b.observed_at desc nulls last,b.source,b.source_id),'[]'::jsonb))
    into v_result from bounded b;
  return v_result;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_mark_post_session_gps(p_result jsonb, p_session_state text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_scan_event_id uuid;
begin
  v_scan_event_id := nullif(p_result->>'scan_event_id','')::uuid;
  update public.device_location_proximity_status gps
  set result='post_session',
      badge_color='amber',
      metadata_json=coalesce(gps.metadata_json,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
        'authoritative',false,
        'evidence_scope','post_session_advisory',
        'session_state',p_session_state
      )
  where gps.session_uuid=coalesce(p_result->>'session_uuid','')
    and gps.device_id=(select d.id from public.devices d where d.device_id=p_result->>'device_id' limit 1)
    and gps.location_id=(select l.id from public.locations l where l.location_code=p_result->>'location_code' limit 1);

  if v_scan_event_id is not null then
    update public.scan_events se
    set result='post_session',
        notes='GPS arrived after the cleaning was no longer active. It is retained as advisory evidence only.',
        payload_json=coalesce(se.payload_json,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
          'authoritative',false,
          'evidence_scope','post_session_advisory',
          'session_state',p_session_state
        )
    where se.id=v_scan_event_id;
  end if;

  return coalesce(p_result,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'result','post_session',
    'badge_color','amber',
    'authoritative',false,
    'evidence_scope','post_session_advisory',
    'session_state',p_session_state
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_alert_event_binding(p_job uuid, p_event jsonb, p_credential uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare a public.employee_native_alert_finalizations%rowtype;
 prep public.employee_native_alert_preparations%rowtype;
 g public.employee_native_push_generations%rowtype;
 field text;
begin
 if p_job is null or p_credential is null or p_at is null or not isfinite(p_at) then return false;end if;
 select * into a from public.employee_native_alert_finalizations where job_id=p_job;
 select * into prep from public.employee_native_alert_preparations where job_id=p_job;
 select * into g from public.employee_native_push_generations
  where generation_id=(p_event->>'generation_id')::uuid;
 if a.job_id is null or prep.job_id is null or g.generation_id is null
  or a.preparation_id<>prep.preparation_id or a.source_revision<>prep.source_revision
  or a.alert_kind is distinct from prep.alert_kind
  or a.finalized_at<g.activated_at or a.finalized_at>p_at
  or (g.dispatch_retired_at is not null and a.finalized_at>g.dispatch_retired_at)
  or g.revoked_at is not null or g.credential_id<>p_credential
  or g.device_id::text is distinct from prep.expected->>'device_uuid'
  or g.registration_id::text is distinct from prep.expected->>'registration_id'
  or g.token_digest is distinct from a.payload->>'token_digest'
  or g.principal_digest is distinct from a.payload->>'principal_digest'
  or g.employee_id::text is distinct from a.payload->>'receipt_employee_id'
  or g.device_identifier is distinct from a.payload->>'receipt_device_id'
  or g.assignment_epoch::text is distinct from a.payload->>'receipt_assignment_epoch'
  or a.payload->>'receipt_credential_id' is distinct from p_credential::text
  or a.payload->>'receipt_job_id' is distinct from p_job::text
  or a.payload->>'generation_id' is distinct from g.generation_id::text
  or a.payload->>'schema' is distinct from (case a.alert_kind when 'EVENT' then 'custodial.native-event-payload.v1'
    when 'MESSAGE' then 'custodial.native-message-payload.v1' end)
  or a.payload->>'reservation_at' is distinct from public.custodial_native_location_utc(a.finalized_at)
  or a.payload->>'valid_until' is distinct from public.custodial_native_location_utc(a.valid_until)
  or a.payload->>'content_sha256' is distinct from a.content_sha256
  or exists(select 1 from public.employee_native_push_delivery_receipts legacy
    where legacy.job_id=p_job and legacy.native_payload is not null) then return false;end if;
 foreach field in array array['generation_id','receipt_job_id','notification_key','receipt_credential_id',
  'receipt_employee_id','receipt_device_id','receipt_assignment_epoch',
  'principal_digest','token_digest','content_sha256'] loop
  if p_event->>field is distinct from a.payload->>field then return false;end if;
 end loop;
 -- This is ORIGINAL receipt binding, not a fresh inventory/send permission.
 -- The unchanged outer v2 algorithm validates original admission/observation
 -- intervals and exact replay. A transport delay past valid_until or a later
 -- business-source change must not erase a valid original received/Open/ACK.
 -- Fresh inventory retains the separate live-source and current-time checks.
 return true;
exception when data_exception or invalid_text_representation then return false;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_location_inventory_rows(p_credential uuid, p_principal text, p_generations jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(job_id uuid, reservation_at timestamp with time zone, payload jsonb, provider_outcome text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select r.job_id,r.prepared_at,r.native_payload,coalesce(o.outcome,'prepared')
 from public.employee_native_push_delivery_receipts r
 join public.employee_native_push_generations g on g.generation_id=r.native_generation_id
 left join lateral(select outcome from public.employee_native_location_outcomes x where x.job_id=r.job_id
  order by (x.outcome<>'delivery_outcome_unknown') desc,x.server_received_at desc,x.operation_id desc limit 1) o on true
 where r.credential_id=p_credential and g.credential_id=p_credential and g.principal_digest=p_principal
  and p_generations ? g.generation_id::text and g.revoked_at is null
  and g.registration_id=r.registration_id and g.token_digest=r.token_hash and g.assignment_epoch=r.assignment_epoch
  and r.native_payload->>'receipt_employee_id'=g.employee_id::text
  and r.native_payload->>'receipt_device_id'=g.device_identifier and r.native_payload->>'principal_digest'=g.principal_digest
  and r.prepared_at>=g.activated_at and (g.dispatch_retired_at is null or r.prepared_at<=g.dispatch_retired_at)
  and r.native_valid_until>p_at and coalesce(o.outcome,'prepared')<>'known_nonacceptance'
  and ((r.native_payload->>'schema'='custodial.native-location-payload.v2'
   and public.custodial_native_location_live(r.job_id,r.native_payload,p_at) is true)
   or (r.native_payload->>'schema'='custodial.native-provider-payload.v1'
   and r.native_payload->>'kind'='employee_lunch_coverage'
   and public.custodial_native_lunch_live(r.job_id,r.native_payload,p_at) is true))
 union all
 select a.job_id,a.finalized_at,a.payload,coalesce(o.provider_outcome,'prepared')
 from public.employee_native_alert_finalizations a
 join public.employee_native_alert_preparations prep on prep.job_id=a.job_id
  and prep.preparation_id=a.preparation_id and prep.source_revision=a.source_revision
 join public.employee_native_push_generations g on g.generation_id=(a.payload->>'generation_id')::uuid
 left join public.employee_native_alert_outcomes o on o.job_id=a.job_id
 where prep.expected->>'credential_id'=p_credential::text
  and g.credential_id=p_credential and g.principal_digest=p_principal
  and p_generations ? g.generation_id::text and g.revoked_at is null
  and g.registration_id::text=prep.expected->>'registration_id'
  and g.token_digest=a.payload->>'token_digest'
  and g.assignment_epoch::text=a.payload->>'receipt_assignment_epoch'
  and g.employee_id::text=a.payload->>'receipt_employee_id'
  and g.device_identifier=a.payload->>'receipt_device_id'
  and a.payload->>'principal_digest'=g.principal_digest
  and a.finalized_at>=g.activated_at
  and (g.dispatch_retired_at is null or a.finalized_at<=g.dispatch_retired_at)
  and a.valid_until>p_at and coalesce(o.provider_outcome,'prepared')<>'known_nonacceptance'
  and not exists(select 1 from public.employee_native_provider_events n
   where n.job_id=a.job_id and n.action='acknowledged')
  and public.custodial_native_alert_source_live(a.job_id,p_at) is true
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.job_id,r.prepared_at,r.native_payload,coalesce(o.evidence->>'outcome','prepared')::text
 FROM public.employee_native_schedule_finalizations f
 JOIN public.employee_native_push_delivery_receipts r ON r.job_id=f.job_id
 LEFT JOIN public.employee_native_schedule_outcomes o ON o.job_id=f.job_id
 JOIN public.employee_native_push_generations g ON g.generation_id=r.native_generation_id
 WHERE r.credential_id=p_credential AND g.credential_id=p_credential AND g.principal_digest=p_principal
  AND p_generations ? g.generation_id::text AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
  AND g.registration_id=r.registration_id AND g.token_digest=r.token_hash AND g.assignment_epoch=r.assignment_epoch
  AND r.native_payload->>'receipt_employee_id'=g.employee_id::text
  AND r.native_payload->>'receipt_device_id'=g.device_identifier AND r.native_payload->>'principal_digest'=g.principal_digest
  AND r.prepared_at>=g.activated_at AND (g.dispatch_retired_at IS NULL OR r.prepared_at<=g.dispatch_retired_at)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.employee_native_provider_events n WHERE n.job_id=r.job_id AND n.action='acknowledged')
  AND coalesce(o.evidence->>'outcome','prepared') IN('prepared','delivery_outcome_unknown','provider_accepted')
  AND public.custodial_native_schedule_live(r.job_id,r.native_payload,p_at) IS TRUE;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_location_live(p_job uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select isfinite(p_at) and (p_payload->>'valid_until')::timestamptz>p_at
 and p_payload->>'service_date'=public.sch_service_date(p_at)::text
 and 1=(select count(*) from public.custodial_operational_location_assignments(public.sch_service_date(p_at)) a
  join public.weekly_schedule_versions v on v.version_id=a.version_id
  join public.weekly_schedule_publications pub on pub.publication_id=a.publication_id and pub.version_id=v.version_id
  join public.static_weekly_authority_source_documents s on s.source_id=v.authority_source_id
  join public.mz_location_reminder_candidates(public.sch_service_date(p_at),p_at) c on c.location_id=a.location_id
  join public.operational_notification_jobs j on j.job_id=p_job and j.source_id=a.location_id
  where j.job_type='employee_native_push' and j.payload_json#>'{data_json,test_delivery}' is null
   and j.payload_json#>>'{data_json,kind}'='employee_location_status'
   and j.job_key='employee-location-push:'||(p_payload->>'notification_key')||':'||(p_payload->>'receipt_credential_id')
   and j.payload_json->>'credential_id'=p_payload->>'receipt_credential_id'
   and j.payload_json->>'employee_id'=p_payload->>'receipt_employee_id'
   and j.payload_json->>'device_identifier'=p_payload->>'receipt_device_id'
   and j.payload_json->>'assignment_epoch'=p_payload->>'receipt_assignment_epoch'
   and j.payload_json#>>'{data_json,notification_key}'=p_payload->>'notification_key'
   and j.payload_json#>>'{data_json,projection_id}'=a.projection_id::text
   and j.payload_json#>>'{data_json,publication_id}'=a.publication_id::text
   and a.assigned_employee_id::text=p_payload->>'receipt_employee_id'
   and a.assignment_status='ASSIGNED' and a.projection_status='current'
   and a.coverage_start<=(p_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::time
   and a.coverage_end>(p_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::time
   and a.location_id::text=p_payload->>'location_id'
   and a.location_code=p_payload->>'location_code' and a.location_name=p_payload->>'location_name'
   and a.form_type=p_payload->>'form_type'
   and a.projection_id::text=p_payload->>'projection_id' and a.publication_id::text=p_payload->>'publication_id'
   and a.version_id::text=p_payload->>'version_id' and a.occurrence_id::text=p_payload->>'occurrence_id'
   and a.authority_source=p_payload->>'authority_source' and s.source_id::text=p_payload->>'authority_source_id'
   and s.source_digest=p_payload->>'authority_source_digest'
   and c.notification_key||':projection:'||a.projection_id::text=p_payload->>'notification_key'
   and c.status_code=p_payload->>'status_code'
   and public.custodial_native_location_utc(c.cleaned_at)=p_payload->>'cleaned_at'
   and public.custodial_native_location_utc(c.cycle_base_at)=p_payload->>'cycle_base_at'
   and c.cycle_base_evidence=p_payload->>'cycle_base_evidence'
   and public.custodial_native_location_utc(c.due_soon_at)=p_payload->>'due_soon_at'
   and public.custodial_native_location_utc(c.overdue_at)=p_payload->>'overdue_at'
   and not exists(select 1 from public.device_notification_acknowledgements ack
    where upper(btrim(ack.device_identifier))=p_payload->>'receipt_device_id'
     and ack.notification_key=p_payload->>'notification_key' and ack.credential_id::text=p_payload->>'receipt_credential_id'
     and ack.assignment_epoch::text=p_payload->>'receipt_assignment_epoch' and ack.employee_id::text=p_payload->>'receipt_employee_id'
     and ack.acknowledged_at is not null));
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin

  or (select array_agg(key order by key) from jsonb_object_keys(p_tuple) key) is distinct from array['job_id','reservation_at']
  or jsonb_typeof(p_tuple->'job_id') is distinct from 'string' or p_tuple->>'job_id' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'

  or p_tuple->>'reservation_at' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{6}Z$'
 then return false;end if;
 return public.custodial_native_location_utc((p_tuple->>'reservation_at')::timestamptz)=p_tuple->>'reservation_at';
exception when others then return false;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_provider_generation_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op='DELETE' then raise exception 'native provider generation history is retained'; end if;
 if (to_jsonb(new)-array['dispatch_retired_at','revoked_at']) is distinct from
    (to_jsonb(old)-array['dispatch_retired_at','revoked_at'])
  or (old.dispatch_retired_at is not null and new.dispatch_retired_at is distinct from old.dispatch_retired_at)
  or (old.revoked_at is not null and new.revoked_at is distinct from old.revoked_at)
 then raise exception 'native provider generation binding is immutable'; end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_provider_interval_observation(o jsonb, p_required boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare field text; first_at timestamptz; last_at timestamptz;
begin
 if jsonb_typeof(o) is distinct from 'object' or
  (select array_agg(key order by key) from jsonb_object_keys(o) key) is distinct from
   array['boot_count','clock_profile_id','earliest_at','elapsed_realtime_ms','latest_at'] then
  raise exception 'exact native interval observation required' using errcode='22023';end if;
 foreach field in array array['boot_count','elapsed_realtime_ms'] loop
  if o->field is distinct from 'null'::jsonb and
   (jsonb_typeof(o->field) is distinct from 'number' or o->>field !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$'
    or (o->>field)::numeric>(case when field='boot_count' then 2147483647 else 9007199254740991 end)) then
   raise exception 'exact native interval counter required' using errcode='22023';end if;
 end loop;
 if o->'earliest_at'='null'::jsonb then
  if p_required is distinct from false or o->'latest_at' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb or o->'clock_profile_id' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb then
   raise exception 'complete native interval required' using errcode='22023';end if;
 else
  first_at:=public.custodial_native_provider_event_time(o->'earliest_at');last_at:=public.custodial_native_provider_event_time(o->'latest_at');
  if last_at<first_at or jsonb_typeof(o->'clock_profile_id') is distinct from 'string'
   or o->>'clock_profile_id' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$' or o->'boot_count'='null'::jsonb or o->'elapsed_realtime_ms'='null'::jsonb then
   raise exception 'ordered qualified native interval evidence required' using errcode='22023';end if;
 end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_provider_registration_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare at_time timestamptz:=clock_timestamp(); foreign_binding boolean;
begin
 foreign_binding := (new.device_id,new.credential_id,new.employee_id,new.assignment_epoch,new.platform)
  is distinct from (old.device_id,old.credential_id,old.employee_id,old.assignment_epoch,old.platform)
  or ((new.active is not true or new.revoked_at is not null) and new.revoked_reason is distinct from 'token_rotated');
 if foreign_binding or new.active is not true or new.revoked_at is not null
  or new.token_hash is distinct from old.token_hash or new.fcm_token is distinct from old.fcm_token then
  update public.employee_native_push_generations set dispatch_retired_at=coalesce(dispatch_retired_at,at_time),
   revoked_at=case when foreign_binding then coalesce(revoked_at,at_time) else revoked_at end
   where registration_id=old.registration_id and revoked_at is null;
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_attempt_binding(p_job uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.employee_native_push_delivery_receipts%rowtype;f public.employee_native_schedule_finalizations%rowtype;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.employee_native_push_delivery_receipts WHERE job_id=p_job;
 SELECT * INTO f FROM public.employee_native_schedule_finalizations WHERE job_id=p_job;
 IF r.job_id IS NULL OR f.job_id IS NULL OR r.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.source_reservation_id
  OR r.native_payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM f.content_sha256
  OR public.custodial_native_schedule_receipt_binding(r.native_payload,r.job_id,r.source_id,r.credential_id,r.assignment_epoch,
   r.native_generation_id,r.token_hash,r.prepared_at,r.native_valid_until,r.native_payload_sha256) IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original SCHEDULE finalization required' USING errcode='42501';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('receipt_job_id',r.job_id::text,'lease_token',r.lease_token::text,
  'registration_id',r.registration_id::text,'generation_id',r.native_generation_id::text,
  'reservation_at',public.custodial_native_location_utc(r.prepared_at),'content_sha256',r.native_payload_sha256,
  'token_digest',r.token_hash,'principal_digest',r.native_payload->>'principal_digest',
  'receipt_credential_id',r.credential_id::text,'receipt_assignment_epoch',r.assignment_epoch::text,
  'receipt_employee_id',r.native_payload->>'receipt_employee_id','receipt_device_id',r.native_payload->>'receipt_device_id',
  'source_reservation_id',f.source_reservation_id::text);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_content_source(uuid, uuid, uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_content_source_at(p_operation_id uuid, p_employee_id uuid, p_generation_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE source_status jsonb;r jsonb;w jsonb;candidate jsonb;
BEGIN
 source_status:=public.custodial_native_schedule_source_status_at(p_operation_id,p_employee_id,p_generation_id,p_at);
 IF source_status->'source_current' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-content-source.v1','status','CONTENT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE',
   'dispatch_authorized',false,'delivery_admitted',false,'source_status',source_status,'candidate',null);END IF;
 r:=source_status->'reservation';w:=r->'window';
 candidate:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-content-candidate.v1','kind','employee_schedule_ownership',
  'notification_type','schedule_ownership','title','9:45 assignment update',
  'body',(w->>'employee_name')||', your scheduled responsibilities have changed at 9:45 AM. Please see your Schedule page for your updated assignments.',
  'channel_id','employee-schedule-ownership','route','employee-schedule.html?hub=employee','notification_key',w->>'logical_key',
  'service_date',w->>'service_date','boundary_local','09:45','employee_id',w->>'employee_id','generation_id',w->>'generation_id',
  'source_reservation_id',r->>'reservation_id','source_operation_id',r->>'operation_id','source_window_sha256',r->>'window_sha256',
  'server_source_sha256',w->>'server_source_sha256','source_revision',w->>'source_revision','projection_id',w->>'projection_id',
  'publication_id',w->>'publication_id','version_id',w->>'version_id','assignment_occurrence_id',w->>'assignment_occurrence_id',
  'source_valid_from',w->>'valid_from','source_valid_until',w->>'valid_until');
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(candidate) e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(candidate) e WHERE e.value='' OR e.value~'[[:cntrl:]]'
   OR octet_length(e.value)>CASE WHEN e.key='title' THEN 180 WHEN e.key='notification_key' THEN 240 ELSE 1000 END)
  OR octet_length(public.custodial_native_location_canonical(candidate))>3500 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE accepted content unsupported; no truncation' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-content-source.v1','status','CONTENT_CURRENT_SOURCE_ONLY',
  'dispatch_authorized',false,'delivery_admitted',false,'source_status',source_status,'candidate',candidate);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_evidence_valid(p jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_object_keys(p) key)
  IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['error_code','operation_id','outcome','provider_message_id']
  OR jsonb_typeof(p->'operation_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR p->>'operation_id' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p->'outcome') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF p->>'outcome'='provider_accepted' THEN
  RETURN p->'error_code'='null'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(p->'provider_message_id')='string'
   AND length(p->>'provider_message_id') BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
   AND p->>'provider_message_id'=btrim(p->>'provider_message_id') AND p->>'provider_message_id' !~ '[[:cntrl:]]';
 END IF;
 RETURN p->>'outcome' IN('known_nonacceptance','delivery_outcome_unknown') AND p->'provider_message_id'='null'::jsonb
  AND jsonb_typeof(p->'error_code')='string' AND p->>'error_code'~'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,99}$';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_finalization_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE s public.employee_native_schedule_source_reservations%rowtype;
 r public.employee_native_push_delivery_receipts%rowtype;j public.operational_notification_jobs%rowtype;content jsonb;expected jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original SCHEDULE finalization immutable' USING errcode='23514';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.employee_native_schedule_source_reservations WHERE reservation_id=NEW.source_reservation_id;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.employee_native_push_delivery_receipts WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id;
 IF s.reservation_id IS NULL OR r.job_id IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE source/receipt missing' USING errcode='23514';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO j FROM public.operational_notification_jobs WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id;
 content:=public.custodial_native_schedule_content_source_at(s.operation_id,s.employee_id,s.generation_id,r.prepared_at);
 expected:=(content->'candidate')-'schema'-'employee_id';
 IF s.reservation_id IS NULL OR r.job_id IS NULL OR content->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONTENT_CURRENT_SOURCE_ONLY'
  OR r.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.reservation_id OR r.native_generation_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.generation_id
  OR r.prepared_at<s.reserved_at OR r.prepared_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.finalized_at
  OR r.native_valid_until IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_until OR r.native_valid_until IS DISTINCT FROM s.valid_until
  OR r.native_payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.content_sha256 OR s.source_window_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_window_sha256
  OR r.native_payload->>'receipt_employee_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s.employee_id::text
  OR r.native_payload->>'receipt_device_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_window#>>'{recipient,device_identifier}'
  OR r.credential_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_window#>>'{recipient,credential_id}'
  OR r.assignment_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_window#>>'{recipient,assignment_epoch}'
  OR r.native_payload->>'principal_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_window#>>'{recipient,principal_digest}'
  OR r.token_hash IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_window#>>'{recipient,token_digest}'
  OR j.job_id IS NULL OR j.job_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'employee_native_push' OR j.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.reservation_id
  OR j.job_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'employee-schedule-push:'||s.reservation_id::text||':'||r.credential_id::text
  OR r.job_key IS DISTINCT FROM j.job_key OR r.lease_token IS DISTINCT FROM j.lease_token
  OR r.registration_id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT registration_id FROM public.employee_native_push_generations WHERE generation_id=s.generation_id)
  OR (r.native_payload-ARRAY['schema','principal_digest','token_digest','receipt_job_id','receipt_credential_id',
   'receipt_employee_id','receipt_device_id','receipt_assignment_epoch','reservation_at','valid_until','content_sha256']) IS DISTINCT FROM expected
  OR public.custodial_native_schedule_receipt_binding(r.native_payload,r.job_id,r.source_id,r.credential_id,r.assignment_epoch,
   r.native_generation_id,r.token_hash,r.prepared_at,r.native_valid_until,r.native_payload_sha256) IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE finalization not bound to original source and receipt' USING errcode='23514';END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_finalization_status(p_source uuid, p_employee uuid, p_generation uuid)

 SELECT r0.* INTO r FROM public.employee_native_schedule_finalizations f
  JOIN public.employee_native_schedule_source_reservations s ON s.reservation_id=f.source_reservation_id

AS $function$
DECLARE s public.employee_native_schedule_source_reservations%rowtype;j public.operational_notification_jobs%rowtype;g public.employee_native_push_generations%rowtype;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original SCHEDULE job marker immutable' USING errcode='23514';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.employee_native_schedule_source_reservations WHERE reservation_id=NEW.source_reservation_id;
 SELECT * INTO j FROM public.operational_notification_jobs WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id;
 SELECT * INTO g FROM public.employee_native_push_generations WHERE generation_id=s.generation_id;
 IF s.reservation_id IS NULL OR j.job_id IS NULL OR g.generation_id IS NULL OR g.employee_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.employee_id
  OR NEW.prepared_at<s.reserved_at OR NEW.prepared_at>=s.valid_until
  OR NEW.source_window_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_window_sha256
  OR NEW.expected IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('assignment_epoch',g.assignment_epoch::text,'credential_id',g.credential_id::text,
   'device_id',g.device_identifier,'employee_id',g.employee_id::text,'generation_id',g.generation_id::text,'principal_digest',g.principal_digest,
   'registration_id',g.registration_id::text,'token_digest',g.token_digest)
  OR j.job_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'employee_native_push' OR j.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.reservation_id
  OR j.job_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'employee-schedule-push:'||s.reservation_id::text||':'||g.credential_id::text
  OR j.payload_json IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('credential_id',g.credential_id::text,'device_id',g.device_id::text,
   'device_identifier',g.device_identifier,'employee_id',g.employee_id::text,'assignment_epoch',g.assignment_epoch::text,
   'data_json',jsonb_build_object('kind','employee_schedule_ownership','source_reservation_id',s.reservation_id::text))
  OR NEW.job_payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(j.payload_json) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE job not bound to exact source/actor/payload' USING errcode='23514';END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_preparation_source_at(p_source uuid, p_employee uuid, p_generation uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE window_reply jsonb;w jsonb;g public.employee_native_push_generations%rowtype;expected jsonb;preparation jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_source IS NULL OR p_employee IS NULL OR p_generation IS NULL OR p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact SCHEDULE preparation source/actor/time required' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 window_reply:=public.custodial_native_schedule_window_source_at(p_source,p_employee,p_generation,p_at);
 IF window_reply->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CURRENT_WINDOW_SOURCE_ONLY' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-preparation-source.v1','status','SOURCE_NOT_CURRENT','source_status',window_reply->>'status',
   'dispatch_authorized',false,'delivery_admitted',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'preparation',null);END IF;
 w:=window_reply->'window';
 SELECT * INTO g FROM public.employee_native_push_generations WHERE generation_id=p_generation;
 -- The canonical window has already validated the current generation,
 -- registration, credential/device/person/epoch and accepted source. Never
 -- synthesize the missing registration ID from the source window or artwork.
 IF g.generation_id IS NULL OR w->>'employee_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_employee::text
  OR w->>'generation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_generation::text OR w->>'assignment_occurrence_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_source::text
  OR w#>>'{recipient,employee_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.employee_id::text
  OR w#>>'{recipient,generation_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.generation_id::text
  OR w#>>'{recipient,device_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.device_id::text
  OR w#>>'{recipient,device_identifier}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.device_identifier
  OR w#>>'{recipient,credential_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.credential_id::text
  OR w#>>'{recipient,assignment_epoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.assignment_epoch::text
  OR w#>>'{recipient,principal_digest}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.principal_digest
  OR w#>>'{recipient,token_digest}' IS DISTINCT FROM g.token_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE preparation current recipient projection mismatch' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('assignment_epoch',g.assignment_epoch::text,'credential_id',g.credential_id::text,
  'device_id',g.device_identifier,'employee_id',g.employee_id::text,'generation_id',g.generation_id::text,
  'principal_digest',g.principal_digest,'registration_id',g.registration_id::text,'token_digest',g.token_digest);
 preparation:=jsonb_build_object('source_key',p_source,'employee_id',p_employee,'generation_id',p_generation,
  'service_date',w->>'service_date','projection_id',w->>'projection_id','publication_id',w->>'publication_id',
  'version_id',w->>'version_id','source_revision',w->>'source_revision','expected_source_sha256',w->>'server_source_sha256','expected',expected);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-preparation-source.v1','status','CURRENT_PREPARATION_SOURCE_ONLY','source_status','CURRENT_WINDOW_SOURCE_ONLY',
  'dispatch_authorized',false,'delivery_admitted',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'preparation',preparation);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_receipt_binding(p jsonb, p_job uuid, p_source uuid, p_credential uuid, p_epoch bigint, p_generation uuid, p_token text, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_until timestamp with time zone, p_sha text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE keys text[];field text;source_from timestamptz;source_until timestamptz;
BEGIN
 IF p IS NULL OR p_job IS NULL OR p_source IS NULL OR p_credential IS NULL OR p_epoch IS NULL
  OR p_generation IS NULL OR p_token IS NULL OR p_at IS NULL OR p_until IS NULL OR p_sha IS NULL
  OR jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key COLLATE "C") INTO keys FROM jsonb_object_keys(p) key;
 IF keys IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['assignment_occurrence_id','body','boundary_local','channel_id','content_sha256',
  'generation_id','kind','notification_key','notification_type','principal_digest','projection_id','publication_id',
  'receipt_assignment_epoch','receipt_credential_id','receipt_device_id','receipt_employee_id','receipt_job_id',
  'reservation_at','route','schema','server_source_sha256','service_date','source_operation_id','source_reservation_id',
  'source_revision','source_valid_from','source_valid_until','source_window_sha256','title','token_digest','valid_until','version_id']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(p) e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(p) e WHERE e.value='' OR e.value~'[[:cntrl:]]'
   OR octet_length(e.value)>CASE WHEN e.key='title' THEN 180 WHEN e.key='notification_key' THEN 240 ELSE 1000 END)
  OR p->>'schema'<>'custodial.native-schedule-payload.v1' OR p->>'kind'<>'employee_schedule_ownership'
  OR p->>'notification_type'<>'schedule_ownership' OR p->>'channel_id'<>'employee-schedule-ownership'
  OR p->>'route'<>'employee-schedule.html?hub=employee' OR p->>'boundary_local'<>'09:45'
  OR p->>'generation_id'<>p_generation::text OR p->>'receipt_job_id'<>p_job::text
  OR p->>'source_reservation_id'<>p_source::text OR p->>'receipt_credential_id'<>p_credential::text
  OR p->>'receipt_assignment_epoch'<>p_epoch::text OR p_epoch<1 OR p_epoch>9007199254740991
  OR p->>'token_digest'<>p_token OR p->>'content_sha256'<>p_sha
  OR p->>'receipt_device_id' !~ '^KIOSK_(0[2-9]|10)$'
  OR p->>'source_revision' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$' OR (p->>'source_revision')::numeric>9007199254740991
  OR p->>'notification_key'<>'schedule-ownership:'||(p->>'service_date')||':'||(p->>'receipt_employee_id')||':09:45'
  THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 FOREACH field IN ARRAY ARRAY['generation_id','receipt_job_id','receipt_credential_id','receipt_employee_id',
  'source_reservation_id','source_operation_id','projection_id','publication_id','version_id','assignment_occurrence_id'] LOOP
  IF p->>field !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOREACH field IN ARRAY ARRAY['principal_digest','token_digest','content_sha256','source_window_sha256','server_source_sha256'] LOOP
  IF p->>field !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOREACH field IN ARRAY ARRAY['source_valid_from','source_valid_until','reservation_at','valid_until'] LOOP
  IF p->>field !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{6}Z$'
   OR p->>field<>public.custodial_native_location_utc((p->>field)::timestamptz) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 source_from:=(p->>'source_valid_from')::timestamptz;source_until:=(p->>'source_valid_until')::timestamptz;
 RETURN isfinite(p_at) AND isfinite(p_until) AND source_from<=p_at AND p_at<p_until AND p_until<=source_until
  AND p->>'reservation_at'=public.custodial_native_location_utc(p_at)
  AND p->>'valid_until'=public.custodial_native_location_utc(p_until)
  AND (source_from AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date::text=p->>'service_date'
  AND (source_from AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::time=time '09:45'
  AND p_sha=public.static_weekly_digest_text(public.custodial_native_location_canonical(p-'content_sha256'))
  AND octet_length(public.custodial_native_location_canonical(p))<=3500;
EXCEPTION WHEN data_exception THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_source_requests_at(p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE day date;a record;actor record;anchor uuid;target jsonb;requests jsonb:='[]';authority jsonb;status text;
BEGIN
 IF p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'finite source discovery time required' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 day:=public.sch_service_date(p_at);
 SELECT * INTO a FROM public.static_weekly_v6_schedule_authority_state(day);
 status:='SOURCE_NOT_CURRENT';
 IF a.governed IS TRUE AND a.projection_status='current' AND a.authority_source='static_weekly_projection' THEN
  -- The retired four-day transition has separate occurrence/projection tables.
  -- Never label that illustrated reader DTO as a normal native source.
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections p
   WHERE p.projection_id=a.projection_id AND p.publication_id=a.publication_id AND p.version_id=a.version_id) THEN
   status:='SOURCE_ORIGIN_UNSUPPORTED';
  ELSE
   status:='SOURCE_CANDIDATES_ONLY';
   authority:=jsonb_build_object('projection_id',a.projection_id,'publication_id',a.publication_id,
    'version_id',a.version_id,'source_revision',a.projection_authority_revision::text);
   FOR actor IN SELECT g.generation_id,g.employee_id FROM public.employee_native_push_generations g
    JOIN public.devices d ON d.id=g.device_id AND d.active AND d.device_id=g.device_identifier
     AND d.assigned_employee_id=g.employee_id AND d.assignment_epoch=g.assignment_epoch
    JOIN public.device_auth_credentials c ON c.credential_id=g.credential_id AND c.device_id=d.id
     AND c.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.revoked_at IS NULL AND c.expires_at>p_at
    JOIN public.employee_push_registrations r ON r.registration_id=g.registration_id AND r.device_id=d.id
     AND r.credential_id=c.credential_id AND r.employee_id=g.employee_id AND r.assignment_epoch=g.assignment_epoch
     AND r.active AND r.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.platform='android' AND r.token_hash=g.token_digest
    JOIN public.employees e ON e.id=g.employee_id AND e.active AND e.employee_code~'^EMP[0-9]+$'
    WHERE g.activated_at<=p_at AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.dispatch_retired_at IS NULL
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections p,
       jsonb_array_elements(p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,projectionAvailability}') v
      WHERE p.projection_id=a.projection_id AND v->>'serviceDate'=day::text
       AND v->>'incumbentPersonId'=g.employee_id::text AND v->>'status'='working'
       AND (v#>>'{shift,start}')::time<=time '09:45' AND (v#>>'{shift,end}')::time>time '09:45')=1
    ORDER BY g.employee_id,g.generation_id LOOP
    SELECT o.occurrence_id INTO anchor FROM public.weekly_schedule_occurrences o
     WHERE o.projection_id=a.projection_id AND o.publication_id=a.publication_id AND o.version_id=a.version_id
      AND o.service_date=day AND o.state='created' AND o.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND o.coverage_end>=time '09:45'
      AND o.coverage_start<o.coverage_end AND (o.owner_person_id_snapshot=actor.employee_id OR EXISTS(
       SELECT 1 FROM public.static_weekly_v8_read_lunch_segments(day) l
        WHERE l.projection_id=a.projection_id AND l.normal_occurrence_id=o.occurrence_id
         AND l.normal_owner_id=o.owner_person_id_snapshot AND l.coverer_id=actor.employee_id
         AND l.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND l.coverage_end>=time '09:45' AND l.coverage_start<l.coverage_end))
     ORDER BY o.occurrence_id LIMIT 1;
    IF anchor IS NULL THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
    -- Reuse the actual current recipient/source validator; registrations alone
    -- never establish current target identity. No token is returned.
    target:=public.custodial_native_target_source_at('SCHEDULE',anchor,actor.employee_id,actor.generation_id,p_at);
    IF target->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SOURCE_ONLY_POLICY_MISSING' THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
    IF target#>>'{source,source_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM a.projection_id::text
     OR target#>>'{source,publication_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM a.publication_id::text
     OR target#>>'{source,version_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM a.version_id::text
     OR target#>>'{source,source_revision}' IS DISTINCT FROM a.projection_authority_revision::text THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'native source discovery snapshot binding changed' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(requests) r WHERE r->>'employee_id'=actor.employee_id::text) THEN
     status:='SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS';requests:='[]';authority:=null;EXIT;END IF;
    IF jsonb_array_length(requests)>=4096 THEN status:='SOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED';requests:='[]';authority:=null;EXIT;END IF;
    requests:=requests||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('source_key',anchor,'employee_id',actor.employee_id,'generation_id',actor.generation_id));
   END LOOP;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-source-requests.v1','status',status,
  'service_date',day,'timezone','America/Chicago','authority',authority,'requests',requests,
  'dispatch_authorized',false,'delivery_admitted',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null);
END $function$

functions.identity_arguments: p_source_key uuid, p_employee_id uuid, p_generation_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_window_source_at(p_source_key uuid, p_employee_id uuid, p_generation_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 target jsonb;day date;projection uuid;publication uuid;version uuid;availability jsonb;matches integer;
 segments jsonb;physical jsonb;loans jsonb;analysis jsonb;before_units jsonb;after_units jsonb;
 cut time;shift_end time;start_at timestamptz;end_at timestamptz;credential_end timestamptz;
 name text;source_document jsonb;source_digest text;window_data jsonb;v_status text;
BEGIN
 IF p_source_key IS NULL OR p_employee_id IS NULL OR p_generation_id IS NULL OR p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact native SCHEDULE source and server time required' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 target:=public.custodial_native_target_source_at('SCHEDULE',p_source_key,p_employee_id,p_generation_id,p_at);
 IF target->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SOURCE_ONLY_POLICY_MISSING' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status',target->>'status',
   'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',null);END IF;
 day:=(target#>>'{source,service_date}')::date;projection:=(target#>>'{source,source_id}')::uuid;
 publication:=(target#>>'{source,publication_id}')::uuid;version:=(target#>>'{source,version_id}')::uuid;
 SELECT count(*),min(value::text)::jsonb INTO matches,availability
  FROM public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections p,
   jsonb_array_elements(p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,projectionAvailability}') value
  WHERE p.projection_id=projection AND value->>'serviceDate'=day::text
   AND value->>'incumbentPersonId'=p_employee_id::text AND value->>'status'='working';
 IF matches<>1 OR availability#>>'{shift,start}' IS NULL OR availability#>>'{shift,end}' IS NULL
  OR (availability#>>'{shift,start}')::time>time '09:45'
  OR (availability#>>'{shift,end}')::time<=time '09:45' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact working SCHEDULE recipient availability required' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 name:=availability->>'incumbentName';shift_end:=(availability#>>'{shift,end}')::time;
 IF name IS NULL OR btrim(name)='' OR octet_length(name)>180 OR name~'[[:cntrl:]]' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted SCHEDULE recipient name unsupported' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 -- Trusted canonical readers, not a caller-supplied DTO or SQL expression.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY segment_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO segments FROM (
  SELECT service_date,projection_status,version_id,publication_id,projection_id,segment_id,location_group_id,
   included_location_ids,owner_type,assigned_employee_id,coverage_start,coverage_end,status,source_type,service_mode,governed
  FROM public.static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(day)) r;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY occurrence_id,location_id,coverage_start),'[]'::jsonb) INTO physical FROM (
  SELECT service_date,projection_status,version_id,publication_id,projection_id,occurrence_id,location_group_id,location_id,
   assigned_employee_id,coverage_start,coverage_end,assignment_status,authority_source
  FROM public.custodial_operational_location_assignments(day)) r;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY normal_occurrence_id,responsibility_id,coverage_start),'[]'::jsonb) INTO loans FROM (
  SELECT projection_id,loan_id,responsibility_id,normal_occurrence_id,normal_owner_id,coverer_id,location_group_id,
   included_location_ids,included_snapshots='[]'::jsonb AS included_snapshots_empty,service_mode,coverage_start,coverage_end
  FROM public.static_weekly_v8_read_lunch_segments(day)) r;
 IF jsonb_array_length(segments)>4096 OR jsonb_array_length(physical)>4096 OR jsonb_array_length(loans)>4096
  OR octet_length(jsonb_build_array(segments,physical,loans)::text)>2097152 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE source limit exceeded' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(segments) AS r(service_date date,projection_status text,
  version_id uuid,publication_id uuid,projection_id uuid,segment_id uuid,location_group_id uuid,included_location_ids uuid[],
  owner_type text,assigned_employee_id uuid,coverage_start time,coverage_end time,status text,source_type text,service_mode text,governed boolean)),
 p AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(physical) AS r(service_date date,projection_status text,version_id uuid,
  publication_id uuid,projection_id uuid,occurrence_id uuid,location_group_id uuid,location_id uuid,assigned_employee_id uuid,
  coverage_start time,coverage_end time,assignment_status text,authority_source text)),
 l AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(loans) AS r(projection_id uuid,loan_id text,responsibility_id text,
  normal_occurrence_id uuid,normal_owner_id uuid,coverer_id uuid,location_group_id uuid,included_location_ids uuid[],
  included_snapshots_empty boolean,service_mode text,coverage_start time,coverage_end time)),
 sides AS(SELECT * FROM (VALUES(0,true),(1,false)) r(side,pre)),
 active AS(SELECT sides.side,sides.pre,s.* FROM s CROSS JOIN sides WHERE
  CASE WHEN sides.pre THEN s.coverage_start<time '09:45' AND s.coverage_end>=time '09:45'
   ELSE s.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND s.coverage_end>time '09:45' END),
 effective AS(SELECT a.*,loan.n AS loan_count,CASE WHEN loan.n=1 THEN loan.coverer ELSE a.assigned_employee_id END AS effective_owner
  FROM active a CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*) AS n,(array_agg(l.coverer_id))[1] AS coverer FROM l
   WHERE l.normal_occurrence_id=a.segment_id AND CASE WHEN a.pre THEN l.coverage_start<time '09:45' AND l.coverage_end>=time '09:45'
    ELSE l.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND l.coverage_end>time '09:45' END) loan),
 selected_physical AS(SELECT e.side,e.segment_id,e.effective_owner,e.loan_count,p.* FROM effective e JOIN p
  ON p.occurrence_id=e.segment_id AND CASE WHEN e.pre THEN p.coverage_start<time '09:45' AND p.coverage_end>=time '09:45'
   ELSE p.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND p.coverage_end>time '09:45' END),
 units AS(SELECT e.side,'DUTY:'||e.service_mode||':'||e.location_group_id::text AS key,e.effective_owner AS owner
   FROM effective e WHERE e.service_mode IN('reminder_only','response_only_no_clean')
  UNION ALL SELECT p.side,'LOCATION:'||p.location_id::text,p.assigned_employee_id FROM selected_physical p),
 invalid_segments AS(SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.service_date IS DISTINCT FROM day OR s.projection_id IS DISTINCT FROM projection
  OR s.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM publication OR s.version_id IS DISTINCT FROM version OR s.projection_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'current'
  OR s.governed IS DISTINCT FROM true OR s.source_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'static_weekly_projection'
  OR s.coverage_start IS NULL OR s.coverage_end IS NULL OR s.coverage_start>=s.coverage_end
  OR s.service_mode IS NULL OR s.service_mode NOT IN('scan_tracked','reminder_only','response_only_no_clean')
  OR s.included_location_ids IS NULL OR (s.service_mode='scan_tracked' AND cardinality(s.included_location_ids)=0)
  OR (s.service_mode<>'scan_tracked' AND cardinality(s.included_location_ids)<>0)
  OR NOT((s.status='ASSIGNED' AND ((s.owner_type='EMPLOYEE' AND s.assigned_employee_id IS NOT NULL)
   OR(s.owner_type='COVERALL' AND s.assigned_employee_id IS NULL))) OR(s.status='OPEN' AND s.owner_type='OPEN' AND s.assigned_employee_id IS NULL))),
 invalid_loans AS(SELECT 1 FROM l LEFT JOIN s ON s.segment_id=l.normal_occurrence_id WHERE s.segment_id IS NULL
  OR s.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'ASSIGNED' OR l.projection_id IS DISTINCT FROM projection
  OR l.normal_owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.assigned_employee_id OR l.location_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.location_group_id
  OR l.service_mode IS DISTINCT FROM s.service_mode OR l.coverage_start IS NULL OR l.coverage_end IS NULL
  OR l.coverage_start>=l.coverage_end OR l.coverage_start<s.coverage_start OR l.coverage_end>s.coverage_end
  OR (l.service_mode='scan_tracked' AND (l.included_snapshots_empty IS DISTINCT FROM false OR l.included_location_ids IS NULL))
  OR (l.service_mode<>'scan_tracked' AND l.included_snapshots_empty IS DISTINCT FROM true)
  OR ARRAY(SELECT unnest(coalesce(l.included_location_ids,'{}'::uuid[])) ORDER BY 1)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY(SELECT unnest(s.included_location_ids) ORDER BY 1)),
 invalid_physical AS(SELECT 1 FROM p LEFT JOIN s ON s.segment_id=p.occurrence_id WHERE s.segment_id IS NULL
  OR s.service_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'scan_tracked' OR p.location_id IS NULL OR NOT(p.location_id=ANY(s.included_location_ids))
  OR p.location_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.location_group_id OR p.projection_id IS DISTINCT FROM projection
  OR p.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM publication OR p.version_id IS DISTINCT FROM version OR p.service_date IS DISTINCT FROM day
  OR p.projection_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'current' OR p.assignment_status IS DISTINCT FROM s.status
  OR p.coverage_start IS NULL OR p.coverage_end IS NULL OR p.coverage_start>=p.coverage_end
  OR p.coverage_start<s.coverage_start OR p.coverage_end>s.coverage_end
  OR p.authority_source IS NULL OR p.authority_source NOT IN('static_weekly_projection','static_weekly_lunch_coverage')),
 edges AS(SELECT coverage_start AS edge FROM s WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_end FROM s WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_start FROM p WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_end FROM p WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_start FROM l WHERE normal_owner_id=p_employee_id OR coverer_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_end FROM l WHERE normal_owner_id=p_employee_id OR coverer_id=p_employee_id)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'before_units',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM units WHERE side=0 AND owner=p_employee_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'after_units',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM units WHERE side=1 AND owner=p_employee_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'cut',(SELECT min(edge) FROM edges WHERE edge>time '09:45'),
  'invalid',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalid_segments) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalid_loans) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalid_physical)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective WHERE loan_count>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM units GROUP BY side,key HAVING count(*)<>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective e WHERE e.service_mode='scan_tracked' AND
    (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_physical p WHERE p.side=e.side AND p.segment_id=e.segment_id)<>cardinality(e.included_location_ids))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected_physical p WHERE p.assigned_employee_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.effective_owner
    OR p.authority_source IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN p.loan_count=1 THEN 'static_weekly_lunch_coverage' ELSE 'static_weekly_projection' END)) INTO analysis;
 IF (analysis->>'invalid')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current accepted SCHEDULE source incomplete or ambiguous' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 before_units:=analysis->'before_units';after_units:=analysis->'after_units';
 IF before_units=after_units THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status','NO_OWNERSHIP_CHANGE',
   'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',null);END IF;
 cut:=(analysis->>'cut')::time;
 -- Working availability is an additional authoritative ceiling, never an
 -- invented expiry. Credential and04:00 operational-day ceilings also apply.
 cut:=least(coalesce(cut,shift_end),shift_end);
 start_at:=(day+time '09:45') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago';
 SELECT expires_at INTO STRICT credential_end FROM public.device_auth_credentials
  WHERE credential_id=(target#>>'{recipient,credential_id}')::uuid;
 end_at:=least((day+cut) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago',credential_end,
  ((day+1)+time '04:00') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago');
 IF end_at<=start_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'finite SCHEDULE source interval unavailable' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 IF p_at>=end_at OR (p_at>=start_at AND public.sch_service_date(p_at) IS DISTINCT FROM day) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status','SOURCE_WINDOW_EXPIRED',
   'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',null);END IF;
 source_document:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-source-evidence.v1','target',target,
  'availability',availability,'segments',segments,'physical',physical,'loans',loans,
  'valid_from',to_char(start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'valid_until',to_char(end_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'));
 source_digest:=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(source_document);
 window_data:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window.v1','logical_key','schedule-ownership:'||day::text||':'||p_employee_id::text||':09:45',
  'service_date',day,'timezone','America/Chicago','employee_id',p_employee_id,'employee_name',name,'generation_id',p_generation_id,
  'recipient',target->'recipient','projection_id',projection,'publication_id',publication,'version_id',version,
  'source_revision',target#>>'{source,source_revision}','assignment_occurrence_id',p_source_key,'before_units',before_units,'after_units',after_units,
  'server_source_sha256',source_digest,'server_digest_format','postgres-jsonb-sha256.v1',
  'valid_from',to_char(start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'valid_until',to_char(end_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'server_now',to_char(p_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'));
 v_status:=CASE WHEN p_at<start_at THEN 'WINDOW_NOT_STARTED' ELSE 'CURRENT_WINDOW_SOURCE_ONLY' END;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status',v_status,
  'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',window_data);
END $function$

 RETURNS TABLE(open_work_id uuid, source_kind text, session_id uuid, context_id uuid, session_uuid text, client_session_id text, location_id uuid, location_code text, location_name text, employee_id uuid, employee_name text, device_id uuid, device_identifier text, status text, started_at timestamp with time zone, ended_at timestamp with time zone, duration_minutes integer, duration_display text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    session.id,
    'session'::text,
    session.id,
    null::uuid,
    session.session_uuid,
    session.client_session_id,
    session.location_id,
    location.location_code,
    location.location_name,
    session.employee_id,
    employee.display_name,
    session.device_id,
    device.device_id,
    session.status,
    session.started_at,
    session.ended_at,
    session.duration_minutes,
    session.duration_display,
    session.created_at
  from public.sessions session
  join public.locations location on location.id=session.location_id
  join public.employees employee on employee.id=session.employee_id
  join public.devices device on device.id=session.device_id
  where session.status in ('active','pending_submit')

  union all

  select
    context.context_id,
    'native_offline_context'::text,
    null::uuid,
    context.context_id,
    context.client_session_id,
    context.client_session_id,
    context.location_id,
    context.canonical_location_code,
    location.location_name,
    context.employee_id,
    coalesce(assignment.new_employee_name,employee.display_name),
    context.device_id,
    coalesce(assignment.device_identifier,device.device_id),
    'active'::text,
    context.started_at,
    null::timestamptz,
    null::integer,
    null::text,
    context.created_at
  from public.custodial_offline_actor_contexts context
  join public.custodial_offline_submission_proofs proof
    on proof.context_id=context.context_id and proof.state='issued'
  join public.locations location on location.id=context.location_id
  join public.employees employee on employee.id=context.employee_id
  join public.devices device on device.id=context.device_id
  left join public.custodial_employee_device_assignment_history assignment
    on assignment.assignment_change_id=context.assignment_change_id
      and assignment.device_id=context.device_id
      and assignment.new_employee_id=context.employee_id
  where context.status='activated'
    and context.native_scan_entry_id is not null
    and context.native_start_attestation_version='custodial-native-start.v1'
    and context.native_start_attestation_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.sessions existing
      where existing.client_session_id=context.client_session_id
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_operational_location_assignments(p_service_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(service_date date, authority_source text, projection_status text, version_id uuid, publication_id uuid, projection_id uuid, occurrence_id uuid, location_group_id uuid, group_code text, group_name text, assigned_employee_id uuid, assigned_employee_name text, assignment_status text, coverage_start time without time zone, coverage_end time without time zone, location_id uuid, location_code text, location_name text, form_type text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  with base(service_date,authority_source,projection_status,version_id,publication_id,projection_id,occurrence_id,location_group_id,group_code,group_name,assigned_employee_id,assigned_employee_name,assignment_status,coverage_start,coverage_end,location_id,location_code,location_name,form_type) as materialized (
    select segment.service_date,
    segment.source_type,
    segment.projection_status,
    segment.version_id,
    segment.publication_id,
    segment.projection_id,
    segment.segment_id,
    segment.location_group_id,
    segment.group_code,
    segment.group_name,
    segment.assigned_employee_id,
    segment.assigned_employee_name,
    segment.status,
    segment.coverage_start::time,
    segment.coverage_end::time,
    location.id,
    location.location_code,
    location.location_name,
    location.form_type
  from public.static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(p_service_date) segment
  cross join lateral unnest(segment.included_location_ids) included(location_id)
  join public.locations location on location.id = included.location_id and location.active = true
  where segment.service_mode = 'scan_tracked'
  ), lunch as materialized (
    select segment.*,coalesce((select p.projection_envelope#>>'{authority,compilerInput,version,lunchCoveragePolicy,schema}'
      ='memphis-zoo.static-weekly-full-hour-lunch-policy.v1'
      from public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections p where p.projection_id=segment.projection_id),false) full_scheduled_lunch
    from public.static_weekly_v8_read_lunch_segments(p_service_date) segment where segment.service_mode='scan_tracked'
  ), cuts as (
    select occurrence_id,location_id,coverage_start as boundary from base
    union select occurrence_id,location_id,coverage_end from base
    union select b.occurrence_id,b.location_id,l.coverage_start from base b join lunch l
      on (l.normal_occurrence_id=b.occurrence_id or (l.full_scheduled_lunch and l.projection_id=b.projection_id))
       and b.location_id=any(l.included_location_ids)
    union select b.occurrence_id,b.location_id,l.coverage_end from base b join lunch l
      on (l.normal_occurrence_id=b.occurrence_id or (l.full_scheduled_lunch and l.projection_id=b.projection_id))
       and b.location_id=any(l.included_location_ids)
  ), pieces as (
    select occurrence_id,location_id,boundary as starts,
      lead(boundary) over(partition by occurrence_id,location_id order by boundary) as ends
    from cuts
  ) select b.service_date,
    case when l.responsibility_id is null then b.authority_source else 'static_weekly_lunch_coverage' end,
    b.projection_status,b.version_id,b.publication_id,b.projection_id,b.occurrence_id,
    b.location_group_id,b.group_code,b.group_name,
    case when l.responsibility_id is null then b.assigned_employee_id else l.coverer_id end,
    case when l.responsibility_id is null then b.assigned_employee_name when l.coverer_id is not null then l.coverer_name else null end,
    b.assignment_status,p.starts,p.ends,b.location_id,b.location_code,b.location_name,b.form_type
  from base b join pieces p on p.occurrence_id is not distinct from b.occurrence_id
    and p.location_id=b.location_id and p.starts>=b.coverage_start and p.ends<=b.coverage_end
  left join lateral (select candidate.* from lunch candidate
    where (candidate.normal_occurrence_id=b.occurrence_id or (candidate.full_scheduled_lunch and candidate.projection_id=b.projection_id))
      and b.location_id=any(candidate.included_location_ids) and p.starts>=candidate.coverage_start and p.ends<=candidate.coverage_end
    order by candidate.loan_id,candidate.responsibility_id,candidate.normal_occurrence_id limit 1) l on true
  where p.starts<p.ends

$function$
functions.comment: Current physical responsibility splits at accepted lunch boundaries; normal source ownership and original occurrence identity remain unchanged.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_private_custody_v1_read_complete_frame(p_operation uuid, p_device uuid, p_credential uuid, p_credential_hash text, p_credential_key_id text, p_generation uuid, p_chunk_index integer, p_native_request uuid, p_request_sha256 text, p_attestation_digest text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE target jsonb;op public.custodial_native_private_custody_operations%rowtype;row_count integer;frame bytea;
BEGIN
 target:=public.custodial_private_custody_v1_read_chunk(p_operation,p_device,p_credential,p_credential_hash,p_credential_key_id,
  p_generation,p_chunk_index,p_native_request,p_request_sha256,p_attestation_digest);
 IF target IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT op FROM public.custodial_native_private_custody_operations
  WHERE operation_id=p_operation AND device_id=p_device AND credential_id=p_credential AND generation_id=p_generation;
 SELECT count(*) INTO row_count FROM public.custodial_native_private_custody_chunks WHERE operation_id=p_operation;
 IF row_count>op.chunk_count OR EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.custodial_native_private_custody_chunks c WHERE c.operation_id=p_operation AND
   (c.chunk_index>=op.chunk_count OR octet_length(c.chunk_bytes)<>least(24576,op.frame_bytes-c.chunk_index*24576)
    OR c.chunk_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(c.chunk_bytes,'sha256'),'hex')
    OR c.request_body_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(c.request_bytes,'sha256'),'hex')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='complete original custody chunk closure mismatch';END IF;
 IF row_count<op.chunk_count THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.private-custody-complete-frame-SQL-input.v1',
   'state','INCOMPLETE_ORIGINAL_OPAQUE_FRAME','readback',target,'frame_bytes',op.frame_bytes,'frame_sha256',op.frame_sha256,
   'record_sha256',op.record_sha256,'plan_sha256',op.plan_sha256,'chunk_count',op.chunk_count,'received_chunk_count',row_count,'frame_base64',NULL);
 END IF;
 -- Unique immutable (operation,index) rows and exact bounded count/length
 -- imply every original index exists. Ordered binary concatenation is not a
 -- new request, write, retry or change to any retained row.
 SELECT string_agg(chunk_bytes,''::bytea ORDER BY chunk_index) INTO frame
  FROM public.custodial_native_private_custody_chunks WHERE operation_id=p_operation;
 IF octet_length(frame) IS DISTINCT FROM op.frame_bytes
  OR encode(extensions.digest(frame,'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM op.frame_sha256
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='complete original custody frame bytes mismatch';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.private-custody-complete-frame-SQL-input.v1',
  'state','COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_OPAQUE_FRAME_BYTES_ONLY','readback',target,'frame_bytes',op.frame_bytes,'frame_sha256',op.frame_sha256,
  'record_sha256',op.record_sha256,'plan_sha256',op.plan_sha256,'chunk_count',op.chunk_count,'received_chunk_count',row_count,
  'frame_base64',replace(encode(frame,'base64'),E'\n',''));
END $function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    raise exception using errcode='23514', message='Custodial offline recipient delivery evidence is append-only';
  end if;
  if not public.custodial_backend_transition_allowed() then
    raise exception using errcode='23514', message='Custodial offline recipient delivery state is mutable only by the canonical delivery worker';
  end if;
  if new.delivery_recipient_id is distinct from old.delivery_recipient_id
     or new.outbox_id is distinct from old.outbox_id
     or new.manager_id is distinct from old.manager_id
     or new.recipient_user_id is distinct from old.recipient_user_id
     or new.client_message_id is distinct from old.client_message_id
     or new.notification_instance_key is distinct from old.notification_instance_key
     or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at then
    raise exception using errcode='23514', message='Custodial offline recipient identity is immutable';
  end if;
  return new;
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_release_authority_current_column_definition(p_object_identity text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_relation_text text:=split_part(p_object_identity,':',1); v_column_name text:=substr(p_object_identity,position(':' in p_object_identity)+1);
  v_relation oid:=to_regclass(v_relation_text); v_row record;
begin
  select format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) data_type,a.attidentity identity_kind,a.attgenerated generated_kind,
    pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) expression,a.attnotnull not_null,
    case when a.attcollation<>t.typcollation then quote_ident(cn.nspname)||'.'||quote_ident(co.collname) end collation_identity
  into v_row
  from pg_attribute a join pg_type t on t.oid=a.atttypid
  left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=a.attrelid and d.adnum=a.attnum
  left join pg_collation co on co.oid=a.attcollation left join pg_namespace cn on cn.oid=co.collnamespace
  where a.attrelid=v_relation and a.attname=v_column_name and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped;
  if not found then return null; end if;
  return 'select public.custodial_release_authority_restore_column('
    ||quote_literal(v_relation_text)||','||quote_literal(v_column_name)||','||quote_literal(v_row.data_type)||','
    ||coalesce(quote_literal(v_row.collation_identity),'null')||','||quote_literal(v_row.identity_kind::text)||','||quote_literal(v_row.generated_kind::text)||','
    ||coalesce(quote_literal(v_row.expression),'null')||','||case when v_row.not_null then 'true' else 'false' end||');';
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_release_authority_current_grant_definition(p_object_identity text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_relation oid := to_regclass(p_object_identity);
  v_function oid := to_regprocedure(p_object_identity);
begin
  if v_relation is not null then
    return (
      select 'select public.custodial_release_authority_reset_grants('||quote_literal(p_object_identity)||');'
        || coalesce((
          select string_agg(
            ' grant '||g.privilege_type||' on table '||quote_ident(n.nspname)||'.'||quote_ident(c.relname)||' to '
              ||case when g.grantee=0 then 'public' else quote_ident(r.rolname) end
              ||case when g.is_grantable then ' with grant option' else '' end||';',
            '' order by g.grantee,g.privilege_type,g.is_grantable
          )
          from aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) g
          left join pg_roles r on r.oid=g.grantee
          where g.grantee<>c.relowner
        ),'')
        || coalesce((
          select string_agg(
            ' grant '||g.privilege_type||' ('||quote_ident(a.attname)||') on table '
              ||quote_ident(n.nspname)||'.'||quote_ident(c.relname)||' to '
              ||case when g.grantee=0 then 'public' else quote_ident(r.rolname) end
              ||case when g.is_grantable then ' with grant option' else '' end||';',
            '' order by g.grantee,a.attnum,g.privilege_type,g.is_grantable
          )
          from pg_attribute a
          cross join lateral aclexplode(a.attacl) g
          left join pg_roles r on r.oid=g.grantee
          where a.attrelid=c.oid
            and a.attnum>0
            and not a.attisdropped
            and a.attacl is not null
            and g.grantee<>c.relowner
        ),'')
      from pg_class c
      join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
      where c.oid=v_relation
    );
  end if;
  if v_function is not null then
    return (
      select 'select public.custodial_release_authority_reset_grants('||quote_literal(p_object_identity)||');'
        ||coalesce((
          select string_agg(
            ' grant execute on function '||p.oid::regprocedure::text||' to '
              ||case when a.grantee=0 then 'public' else quote_ident(r.rolname) end
              ||case when a.is_grantable then ' with grant option' else '' end||';',
            '' order by a.grantee,a.is_grantable
          )
          from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a
          left join pg_roles r on r.oid=a.grantee
          where a.privilege_type='EXECUTE' and a.grantee<>p.proowner
        ),'')
      from pg_proc p
      where p.oid=v_function
    );
  end if;
  return null;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custodial_release_authority_current_policy_definition(p_object_identity text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_relation oid:=to_regclass(split_part(p_object_identity,':',1)); v_policy text:=substr(p_object_identity,position(':' in p_object_identity)+1);
begin
  return (
    select 'drop policy if exists '||quote_ident(p.polname)||' on '||quote_ident(n.nspname)||'.'||quote_ident(c.relname)||'; create policy '
      ||quote_ident(p.polname)||' on '||quote_ident(n.nspname)||'.'||quote_ident(c.relname)||' as '||case when p.polpermissive then 'permissive' else 'restrictive' end
      ||' for '||case p.polcmd when '*' then 'all' when 'r' then 'select' when 'a' then 'insert' when 'w' then 'update' when 'd' then 'delete' end
      ||' to '||(select string_agg(case when role_oid=0 then 'public' else quote_ident(r.rolname) end,',' order by role_oid) from unnest(p.polroles) role_oid left join pg_roles r on r.oid=role_oid)
      ||case when p.polqual is null then '' else ' using ('||pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid)||')' end
      ||case when p.polwithcheck is null then '' else ' with check ('||pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)||')' end||';'
    from pg_policy p join pg_class c on c.oid=p.polrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
    where p.polrelid=v_relation and p.polname=v_policy
  );
end
$function$
