DECLARE
 actor jsonb;basis jsonb;source_row jsonb;current_source jsonb;candidate jsonb;
 dated jsonb;projection jsonb;authority jsonb;lunch jsonb;
 publication public.weekly_schedule_publications%rowtype;
 entry public.static_weekly_approved_template_catalog%rowtype;
 v_week_start date;operation_day integer;actual_revision bigint;actual_generation bigint;
 materialized jsonb;accepted_lunch jsonb;v_projection_id uuid;new_revision bigint;checked jsonb;
 original_version jsonb;candidate_version jsonb;original_unaffected jsonb;candidate_unaffected jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 actor:=public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager);
 IF p_manager IS NULL OR p_publication IS NULL OR p_service_date IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_service_date)
  OR p_template_id IS NULL OR length(p_template_id) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 160
  OR p_template_id IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_template_id)
  OR p_expected_revision IS NULL OR p_generation IS NULL
  OR p_expected_revision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 OR p_generation NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
  OR p_preview_digest IS NULL OR length(p_preview_digest)<>64 OR p_preview_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_feasibility) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023',MESSAGE='Exact approved dated original command required';END IF;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_feasibility,
  ARRAY['schema','contract','mapping','sourceDigest','currentSourceDigest','candidateSource','assignments','projectionAssignments','lunchDocument','baseAuthorityDigest','baseReplayDigest','compilerInput','overlayCompilerInput','baselineAssignments','slotAvailability','projectionAvailability','shiftEndDerivation','derivedBaselineDigest','baselineInputDigest','inputDigest','basisDigest','hardConstraintDigest','hardConstraintCount','witnessDigest','lunch','solverInvoked','optimized','publicationAuthority','digest','datedAbsence'],
  ARRAY['schema','contract','mapping','sourceDigest','currentSourceDigest','candidateSource','assignments','projectionAssignments','lunchDocument','baseAuthorityDigest','baseReplayDigest','compilerInput','overlayCompilerInput','baselineAssignments','slotAvailability','projectionAvailability','shiftEndDerivation','derivedBaselineDigest','baselineInputDigest','inputDigest','basisDigest','hardConstraintDigest','hardConstraintCount','witnessDigest','lunch','solverInvoked','optimized','publicationAuthority','digest','datedAbsence'],'approved dated feasibility DATA');
 v_week_start:=p_service_date-(extract(isodow FROM p_service_date)::integer-1);
 operation_day:=extract(dow FROM p_service_date)::integer;

 -- Actual current Source acquisition is already Monday-based. Do not infer
 -- employment, exceptions, template admission or publication from caller DATA.
 basis:=public.static_weekly_read_approved_template_basis(
  p_manager,p_publication,p_service_date,'DATED_ABSENCE',p_template_id,p_expected_revision);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT publication FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications
  WHERE publication_id=p_publication FOR SHARE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT entry FROM public.static_weekly_approved_template_catalog
  WHERE template_id=p_template_id FOR SHARE;
 SELECT current_revision INTO STRICT actual_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton;
 actual_generation:=public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation();
 source_row:=public.static_weekly_v3_read_publication_source(p_publication,v_week_start);
 current_source:=jsonb_set(jsonb_set(source_row->'compiler_input','{serviceDate}',
  to_jsonb(p_service_date::text),true),'{exceptions}',source_row->'exceptions',true);
 IF basis->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-template-basis.v1'
  OR basis->>'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_publication::text
  OR basis->>'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM p_service_date::text
  OR basis->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DATED_ABSENCE'
  OR basis->'authorityRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_expected_revision)
  OR basis->'generation' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_generation)
  OR actual_revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision OR actual_generation IS DISTINCT FROM p_generation
  OR basis->'currentSource' IS DISTINCT FROM current_source
  OR source_row->>'publication_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_publication::text
  OR source_row->>'version_id' IS DISTINCT FROM publication.version_id::text
  OR public.static_weekly_effective_version(v_week_start) IS DISTINCT FROM publication.version_id
  OR public.static_weekly_effective_version(v_week_start+6) IS DISTINCT FROM publication.version_id
  OR entry.owner_config IS DISTINCT FROM basis->'ownerConfig'
  OR entry.catalog_entry_digest IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(jsonb_build_object(
    'template',entry.template_json,'binding',entry.binding_json,'ownerConfig',entry.owner_config,'approvalEvidence',entry.approval_evidence))
  OR basis->'templates' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(entry.template_json)
  OR basis->'admittedBindings' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(entry.binding_json)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.static_weekly_approved_template_retirements WHERE template_id=p_template_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='Approved dated current actor Source template revision or generation differs';END IF;

 dated:=p_feasibility->'datedAbsence';projection:=dated->'projection';
 authority:=projection->'authority';lunch:=dated->'lunchDocument';candidate:=p_feasibility->'candidateSource';
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(dated,
  ARRAY['schema','sourcePublicationId','sourceVersionId','serviceDate','scopeDates','scopeDays','projection','lunchDocument'],
  ARRAY['schema','sourcePublicationId','sourceVersionId','serviceDate','scopeDates','scopeDays','projection','lunchDocument'],'approved dated original scope');
 IF p_feasibility->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-feasibility.v1'
  OR p_feasibility->'solverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR p_feasibility->'optimized' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR p_feasibility->>'publicationAuthority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_PUBLISHED'
  OR p_feasibility->>'digest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_feasibility-'digest'-'datedAbsence')
  OR p_feasibility ?| ARRAY['initialBaseline','recurringStaffing']
  OR p_feasibility#>>'{mapping,templateId}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_template_id
  OR p_feasibility#>>'{mapping,templateDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM entry.binding_json->>'sourceDigest'
  OR p_feasibility#>>'{mapping,serviceDate}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_service_date::text
  OR p_feasibility#>'{mapping,scopeDays}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(operation_day)
  OR dated->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-dated-absence.v1'
  OR dated->>'sourcePublicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_publication::text
  OR dated->>'sourceVersionId' IS DISTINCT FROM current_source#>>'{version,id}'
  OR dated->>'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM p_service_date::text
  OR dated->'scopeDates' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(p_service_date::text)
  OR dated->'scopeDays' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(operation_day)
  OR jsonb_typeof(projection) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(authority) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR projection#>>'{adapter,schema}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-dated-adapter.v1'
  OR projection->>'compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved-static-dated-v1'
  OR projection->>'service_date' IS DISTINCT FROM v_week_start::text
  OR projection->>'week_start' IS DISTINCT FROM v_week_start::text
  OR projection->>'week_end' IS DISTINCT FROM (v_week_start+6)::text
  OR authority->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-authority.v1'
  OR authority->'originalCompilerInput' IS DISTINCT FROM current_source
  OR authority->>'originalPublicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_publication::text
  OR authority->>'originalVersionId' IS DISTINCT FROM current_source#>>'{version,id}'
  OR authority->'scopeDates' IS DISTINCT FROM dated->'scopeDates'
  OR authority->'scopeDays' IS DISTINCT FROM dated->'scopeDays'
  OR authority->>'effectiveDate' IS DISTINCT FROM v_week_start::text
  OR authority#>>'{weekDerivation,operationDate}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_service_date::text
  OR authority#>>'{weekDerivation,weekStart}' IS DISTINCT FROM v_week_start::text
  OR authority#>>'{weekDerivation,weekEnd}' IS DISTINCT FROM (v_week_start+6)::text
  OR authority#>>'{weekDerivation,originalSourceDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(current_source)
  OR projection->>'authority_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(authority)
  OR projection->>'database_projection_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(projection-'database_projection_identity')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',MESSAGE='Approved dated original operation and complete weekly projection bindings differ';END IF;

 -- Compare untouched RAW Source, not a Monday representative-person roster.
 -- The current producer supplies one effective version. Unknown multi-version
 -- raw shapes remain unsupported here rather than selecting a caller version.
 original_version:=current_source->'version';candidate_version:=candidate->'version';
 IF jsonb_typeof(original_version) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(candidate_version) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='0A000',MESSAGE='Approved dated raw effective version shape unsupported';END IF;
 IF candidate-'version' IS DISTINCT FROM current_source-'version'
  OR candidate_version-'assignments' IS DISTINCT FROM original_version-'assignments'
  OR jsonb_typeof(original_version->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(original_version->>'id','')=''
  OR jsonb_typeof(original_version->'assignments') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(candidate_version->'assignments') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',MESSAGE='Approved dated mapping changed original Source outside dated work';END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(original_version->'assignments') r
     WHERE jsonb_typeof(r->'dayOfWeek') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (r->>'dayOfWeek')!~'^[0-6]$')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(candidate_version->'assignments') r
     WHERE jsonb_typeof(r->'dayOfWeek') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (r->>'dayOfWeek')!~'^[0-6]$')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',MESSAGE='Approved dated work day shape differs';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r ORDER BY ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) INTO original_unaffected
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(original_version->'assignments') WITH ORDINALITY t(r,ordinal)
  WHERE r->'dayOfWeek' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(operation_day);
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r ORDER BY ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) INTO candidate_unaffected
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(candidate_version->'assignments') WITH ORDINALITY t(r,ordinal)
  WHERE r->'dayOfWeek' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(operation_day);
 IF original_unaffected IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_unaffected
  OR candidate->'exceptions' IS DISTINCT FROM current_source->'exceptions'
  OR projection->'assignments' IS DISTINCT FROM p_feasibility->'projectionAssignments'
  OR projection->'applied_exceptions' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->'appliedExceptions'
  OR jsonb_typeof(projection->'assignments') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(projection->'assignments')=0
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',MESSAGE='Approved dated unaffected days or existing exceptions changed';END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(projection->'assignments') r
    WHERE (r->>'service_date'=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT (v_week_start+d)::text FROM generate_series(0,6) d))) IS NOT TRUE)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(0,6) d WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(projection->'assignments') r WHERE r->>'service_date'=(v_week_start+d)::text))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',MESSAGE='Approved dated projection must retain every original week day';END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(lunch) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR lunch->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'memphis-zoo.static-weekly-lunch-authority-document.v1'
  OR lunch->>'week_start' IS DISTINCT FROM v_week_start::text
  OR lunch->>'persistence_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_PERSISTED'
  OR lunch->>'base_authority_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM projection->>'authority_digest'
  OR lunch->>'base_replay_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM projection->>'replay_digest'
  OR lunch->>'document_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(lunch-'document_identity')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',MESSAGE='Approved dated full week lunch identity differs';END IF;

 -- Recheck actual pinned inputs; no inferred capability escapes this preflight.
 IF public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager) IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision
  OR public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation() IS DISTINCT FROM p_generation
  OR public.static_weekly_read_approved_template_basis(p_manager,p_publication,p_service_date,
    'DATED_ABSENCE',p_template_id,p_expected_revision) IS DISTINCT FROM basis
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='Approved dated original inputs changed during preflight';END IF;

 -- Independent validation, not a hash receipt, admits the compatible path.
 checked:=public.static_weekly_assert_approved_dated_projection(projection,p_publication,v_week_start,
  public.static_weekly_accepted_exception_set(p_publication,v_week_start));
 IF projection->>'replay_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(jsonb_build_object(
   'projectionAssignments',p_feasibility->'projectionAssignments','lunch',p_feasibility->'lunch'))
  OR authority->'mapping' IS DISTINCT FROM p_feasibility->'mapping'
  OR authority->'overlayCompilerInput' IS DISTINCT FROM p_feasibility->'overlayCompilerInput'
  OR authority->'projectionAvailability' IS DISTINCT FROM p_feasibility->'projectionAvailability'
  OR p_feasibility->'compilerInput' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_set(CASE WHEN authority#>>'{shiftEndDerivation,schema}'='custodial.approved-static-dated-closing.v1'
   THEN authority#>'{shiftEndDerivation,mappedInput}' ELSE authority->'overlayCompilerInput' END,'{exceptions}','[]'::jsonb)
  OR p_feasibility->'inputDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->'inputDigest'
  OR p_feasibility->'baselineInputDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->'mappedBaselineInputDigest'
  OR p_feasibility->'derivedBaselineDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->'mappedBaselineInputDigest'
  OR projection#>>'{receipt,feasibilityDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_feasibility->>'digest'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dated feasibility and independently checked projection differ';END IF;
 PERFORM public.custodial_begin_application_mutation();
 materialized:=public.static_weekly_approved_dated_projection_sink(p_publication,v_week_start,
  public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(public.static_weekly_accepted_exception_set(p_publication,v_week_start)),
  projection->>'compiler_version',projection->'objective',projection->'metrics',projection->>'replay_digest',projection,
  p_expected_revision,p_manager,actor->>'manager_name',p_preview_digest||':dated-projection');
 v_projection_id:=(materialized#>>'{data,projection_id}')::uuid;new_revision:=(materialized->>'revision')::bigint;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_approved_dated_lunch(v_projection_id,lunch);
 accepted_lunch:=public.static_weekly_v8_materialize_lunch_document(v_projection_id,lunch,p_manager);
 IF accepted_lunch->>'persistence_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERSISTED'
  OR accepted_lunch->>'document_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM lunch->>'document_identity'
  OR new_revision IS NULL OR new_revision<=p_expected_revision
  OR public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager) IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM new_revision
  OR public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation() IS DISTINCT FROM p_generation
  OR public.static_weekly_compiler_exception_set(p_publication,v_week_start) IS DISTINCT FROM basis#>'{currentSource,exceptions}'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections p
   JOIN public.weekly_schedule_lunch_documents l USING(projection_id)
   WHERE p.projection_id=v_projection_id AND p.publication_id=p_publication AND p.version_id=publication.version_id
    AND p.week_start=v_week_start AND p.week_end=v_week_start+6 AND p.projection_envelope=projection
    AND p.compiled_by_manager_id=p_manager AND l.accepted_by_manager_id=p_manager AND l.document_json=lunch)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dated original relational projection lunch or final currentness differs';END IF;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_approved_dated_projection(projection,p_publication,v_week_start,
  public.static_weekly_accepted_exception_set(p_publication,v_week_start));
 -- DATA for Main's same-transaction original receipt, never a new publication.
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.approved-static-confirmation.v1','status','PERSISTED_CURRENT',
  'ok',true,'persistence_status','PERSISTED','source_id',checked->'source_id','publication_id',p_publication,
  'projection_id',v_projection_id,'authority_revision',new_revision,'revision',new_revision,
  'feasibility_digest',p_feasibility->>'digest','lunch_document_identity',accepted_lunch->>'document_identity',
  'previewDigest',p_preview_digest,'solverInvoked',false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_approved_initial_document(p_document jsonb, p_date date, p_publishable boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from public.static_weekly_approved_initial_baselines b
  where b.effective_start=p_date and b.snapshot_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(b.feasibility)
   and b.feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document}'=p_document
   and not exists(select 1 from public.static_weekly_approved_template_retirements r where r.template_id=b.template_id)) then
  raise exception 'document is not the exact release-admitted independently validated initial fixed baseline';end if;
end $function$

functions.identity_arguments: p_envelope jsonb, p_publication_id uuid, p_date date, p_exceptions jsonb
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_approved_initial_projection(p_envelope jsonb, p_publication_id uuid, p_date date, p_exceptions jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if p_exceptions is distinct from '[]'::jsonb or not exists(select 1 from public.static_weekly_approved_initial_baselines b
  join public.weekly_schedule_versions v on v.authority_source_id=b.source_id
  join public.weekly_schedule_publications p on p.version_id=v.version_id and p.publication_id=p_publication_id
  where b.effective_start=p_date and b.snapshot_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(b.feasibility)
   and b.feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,projection}'=p_envelope
   and b.feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document}'=v.draft_document
   and not exists(select 1 from public.static_weekly_approved_template_retirements r where r.template_id=b.template_id)) then
  raise exception 'projection requires exact accepted fixed baseline with no dated overlays';end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_approved_recurring_document(p_document jsonb, p_date date, p_publishable boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE authority jsonb:=p_document->'authority';source jsonb;live_source jsonb;approved_source jsonb;config jsonb;entry record;current_source record;
 expected_availability jsonb:='[]';expected_slots jsonb:='[]';expected_rows jsonb:='[]';expected_projection jsonb:='[]';
 slot jsonb;availability jsonb;incumbent jsonb;owner_config jsonb;work jsonb;normalized_work jsonb;person jsonb;owner_key text;
 roster jsonb:='[]';projection_availability jsonb;item jsonb;identity_key text;d date;day integer;baseline_person jsonb;
 productive numeric;effort numeric;duty numeric;v_source_id uuid;employee_count integer;working_count integer:=0;
 mapped_rows jsonb;mapping jsonb;role_availability jsonb;actual_availability jsonb;role_profile jsonb;actual_profile jsonb;
 route jsonb;stops jsonb;stop jsonb;nodes jsonb;node jsonb;previous_node jsonb;blocked jsonb;protected_windows jsonb;
 route_start text;route_provenance text;node_start integer;node_end integer;previous_end integer;shift_start integer;shift_end integer;
 block_start integer;block_end integer;cursor_minute integer;protected_minutes integer;travel integer;available_gap integer;
 committed_duty numeric;stop_effort numeric;stop_duration integer;route_count integer:=0;route_pass integer;baseline_travel integer;staged_stop_nodes jsonb;
 prior_version uuid;
 derived_receipt jsonb;original_open boolean;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 IF p_date IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_date) OR extract(isodow FROM p_date)<>1 OR p_publishable IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='Finite recurring Monday and explicit validation purpose required';END IF;
 SELECT s.source_id,s.canonical_source,s.source_digest,v.draft_document,p.prior_version_id,v.version_id INTO STRICT current_source
  FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications p JOIN public.weekly_schedule_versions v USING(version_id)
  JOIN public.static_weekly_authority_source_documents s ON s.source_id=v.authority_source_id
  WHERE v.version_id=public.static_weekly_effective_version(p_date) AND s.active AND s.retired_at IS NULL;
 -- During projection the just-published server-owned version is effective.
 -- Resolve only its actual immutable predecessor, not a caller Source ID.
 IF current_source.draft_document=p_document AND current_source.version_id<>(authority#>>'{compilerInput,version,id}')::uuid THEN
  prior_version:=current_source.prior_version_id;
  SELECT s.source_id,s.canonical_source,s.source_digest,v.draft_document,p.prior_version_id,v.version_id INTO STRICT current_source
   FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications p JOIN public.weekly_schedule_versions v USING(version_id)
   JOIN public.static_weekly_authority_source_documents s ON s.source_id=v.authority_source_id
   WHERE v.version_id=prior_version AND s.active AND s.retired_at IS NULL;
 END IF;
 v_source_id:=current_source.source_id;
 IF current_source.source_digest IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(current_source.canonical_source) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring registered source digest differs';END IF;
 live_source:=public.static_weekly_v4_hydrate_compiler_source(current_source.draft_document#>'{authority,compilerInput}',p_date);
 source:=authority->'compilerInput';
 SELECT c.owner_config INTO STRICT config FROM public.static_weekly_approved_template_source_configs c
  WHERE c.source_id=v_source_id AND c.config_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(c.owner_config);
 IF config->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.owner-corrected-recurring-schedule.v2'

     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring accepted stop window effort or provenance invalid';END IF;
    stop_effort:=stop_effort+coalesce((stop->>'serviceEffortMinutes')::numeric,(stop->>'service_effort_minutes')::numeric,stop_duration);
    nodes:=nodes||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('start',node_start,'end',node_end,'location',coalesce(stop->>'locationId',stop->>'location')));
   END LOOP;
   staged_stop_nodes:=nodes;
   FOR route_pass IN 1..2 LOOP
   nodes:=staged_stop_nodes;baseline_travel:=0;committed_duty:=0;
   IF route_pass=2 THEN
    FOR work IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(authority#>'{overlayCompilerInput,version,assignments}')
     WHERE value->'ownerSlotId'=slot->'id' AND value->>'dayOfWeek'=day::text AND NOT(value ? 'schedulingMode') LOOP
     PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_window(work->'window','recurring fixed appointment');
     nodes:=nodes||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('start',extract(epoch FROM (work#>>'{window,start}')::time)::integer/60,
      'end',extract(epoch FROM (work#>>'{window,end}')::time)::integer/60,'location',work->>'locationId'));
    END LOOP;
   END IF;
   previous_end:=shift_start;previous_node:=jsonb_build_object('location',route_start);
   FOR node IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(nodes) ORDER BY (value->>'start')::integer,(value->>'end')::integer,value->>'location' COLLATE "C" LOOP
    node_start:=(node->>'start')::integer;node_end:=(node->>'end')::integer;
    IF node_start<previous_end OR node_start<shift_start OR node_end>shift_end
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(protected_windows) b
      WHERE extract(epoch FROM (b->>'start')::time)/60<node_end AND extract(epoch FROM (b->>'end')::time)/60>node_start) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring fixed route overlaps another node lunch blocked interval or shift';END IF;
    travel:=NULL;
    IF previous_node->'location'=node->'location' THEN travel:=0;
    ELSE SELECT min((e->>'minutes')::integer) INTO travel FROM jsonb_array_elements(source->'proximity') e
     WHERE ((e->>'fromLocationId'=previous_node->>'location' AND e->>'toLocationId'=node->>'location')
      OR ((e->'bidirectional'='true'::jsonb OR e->'symmetric'='true'::jsonb)
       AND e->>'toLocationId'=previous_node->>'location' AND e->>'fromLocationId'=node->>'location'))
      AND e->'verified'='true'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(e->'minutes')='number'
      AND (e->>'minutes')::numeric>0 AND (e->>'minutes')::numeric=trunc((e->>'minutes')::numeric)
      AND nullif(e->>'provenance','') IS NOT NULL;
    END IF;
    cursor_minute:=previous_end;protected_minutes:=0;available_gap:=0;
    FOR blocked IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(protected_windows) ORDER BY value->>'start',value->>'end' LOOP
     block_start:=greatest(previous_end,extract(epoch FROM (blocked->>'start')::time)::integer/60);
     block_end:=least(node_start,extract(epoch FROM (blocked->>'end')::time)::integer/60);
     IF block_end>block_start THEN
      available_gap:=greatest(available_gap,block_start-cursor_minute);
      protected_minutes:=protected_minutes+greatest(0,block_end-greatest(cursor_minute,block_start));
      cursor_minute:=greatest(cursor_minute,block_end);
     END IF;
    END LOOP;
    available_gap:=greatest(available_gap,node_start-cursor_minute);
    IF travel IS NULL OR (route_pass=1 AND node_start-previous_end<travel) OR (route_pass=2 AND available_gap<travel) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring fixed route has no contiguous protected-safe directed transit';END IF;
    baseline_travel:=baseline_travel+travel;
    committed_duty:=committed_duty+node_end-node_start+travel+greatest(0,node_start-previous_end-travel-protected_minutes);
    previous_end:=node_end;previous_node:=node;
   END LOOP;
   IF route_pass=1 AND stop_effort+baseline_travel>productive THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring immutable accepted route baseline exceeds productive capacity';END IF;
   IF route_pass=2 AND committed_duty>duty THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring fixed service travel and committed waiting exceed duty capacity';END IF;
   END LOOP;
   route_count:=route_count+jsonb_array_length(stops);
   SELECT coalesce(sum((w->>'serviceEffortMinutes')::numeric),0) INTO effort
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(authority#>'{overlayCompilerInput,version,assignments}') w
    WHERE w->>'ownerSlotId'=slot->>'id' AND w->>'dayOfWeek'=day::text;
   IF effort+stop_effort>(availability->>'maxServiceEffortMinutes')::numeric THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring hard workload capacity including original stops exceeded';END IF;
  END IF;
  expected_slots:=expected_slots||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
   'slot_id',slot->'id','day_of_week',day,'availability_state',availability->'status',
   'shift_start',availability#>'{shift,start}','shift_end',availability#>'{shift,end}',
   'lunch_start',availability#>'{lunch,start}','lunch_end',availability#>'{lunch,end}',
   'capacity_units',availability->'productiveCapacityMinutes','max_load_points',availability->'maxServiceEffortMinutes',
   'qualification_snapshot',coalesce(availability->'qualifications','[]'::jsonb),
   'qualification_provenance',jsonb_build_object('source',availability->'qualificationProvenance'),
   'restriction_snapshot',coalesce(availability->'restrictions','[]'::jsonb),
   'restriction_provenance',jsonb_build_object('source',availability->'restrictionProvenance'),
   'slot_label_snapshot',slot->'label','incumbent_person_id_snapshot',incumbent->'personId','incumbent_name_snapshot',incumbent->'displayName'));
 END LOOP;
 -- Array order is serialization, not a different roster; preserve multiplicity.
 IF EXISTS((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_availability) EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(authority->'projectionAvailability'))
  UNION ALL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(authority->'projectionAvailability') EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_availability)))
  OR EXISTS((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_slots) EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_document->'slot_availability'))
  UNION ALL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_document->'slot_availability') EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_slots))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring exact dated availability differs';END IF;
 SELECT count(DISTINCT value->>'incumbentPersonId') INTO employee_count FROM jsonb_array_elements(roster)
  WHERE value->>'incumbentPersonId' IS NOT NULL;
 IF employee_count<>entry.staffing_count OR employee_count NOT BETWEEN 6 AND 9
  OR jsonb_array_length(entry.template_json->'roleSlotIds')<>employee_count
  OR jsonb_array_length(authority#>'{mapping,slotMapping}')<>employee_count
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(authority#>'{mapping,slotMapping}') m
   WHERE NOT(entry.template_json->'roleSlotIds' ? (m->>'patternSlotId'))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(0,6) AS days(n) WHERE
     (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(source->'slots') s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s->'incumbencies') i
      WHERE s->>'id'=m->>'actualSlotId' AND i->>'personId'=m->>'actualPersonId'
       AND (i->>'effectiveStart')::date<=p_date+days.n
       AND (i->>'effectiveEnd' IS NULL OR p_date+days.n<(i->>'effectiveEnd')::date))<>1))
  OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT m->>'actualSlotId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(authority#>'{mapping,slotMapping}') m)<>employee_count THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring exact scope people and bijective current role binding differ';END IF;
 -- Prove every immutable parent row and every derived segment independently.
 FOR work IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source#>'{version,assignments}') LOOP
  day:=(work->>'dayOfWeek')::integer;
  SELECT value INTO STRICT slot FROM jsonb_array_elements(source->'slots') WHERE value->'id'=work->'ownerSlotId';
  SELECT value INTO STRICT person FROM jsonb_array_elements(roster) WHERE value->'slotId'=work->'ownerSlotId' AND value->>'dayOfWeek'=day::text;
  IF person->>'incumbentPersonId' IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring baseline work cannot invent a person';END IF;
  expected_rows:=expected_rows||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
   'work_id',work->'workId','day_of_week',day,'status','assigned','location_id',work->'locationId',
   'location_code_snapshot',work->'locationCodeSnapshot','location_name_snapshot',work->'locationNameSnapshot',
   'coverage_start',work#>'{window,start}','coverage_end',work#>'{window,end}','owner_slot_id',slot->'id',
   'owner_slot_label_snapshot',slot->'label','owner_person_id_snapshot',person->'incumbentPersonId','owner_name_snapshot',person->'incumbentName',
   'required_qualifications_snapshot',coalesce(work->'requiredQualifications','[]'::jsonb),'restriction_snapshot',coalesce(work->'restrictions','[]'::jsonb),
   'workload_points',work->'serviceEffortMinutes','workload_provenance',jsonb_build_object('source',work->'serviceEffortProvenance'),
   'manual_lock',coalesce(work->'manualLock','false'::jsonb),'payload_json',jsonb_build_object('plan_work_id',day::text||':'||(work->>'workId'),'status','assigned',
    'authority_facts',jsonb_build_object('stable_roster_slot_id',coalesce(work->'originSlotId',work->'ownerSlotId'),
     'baseline_owner_slot_id',slot->'id','baseline_owner_person_id',person->'incumbentPersonId','baseline_owner_name',person->'incumbentName',
     'original_actor_person_id',person->'incumbentPersonId','original_actor_name',person->'incumbentName',
     'optimized_owner_slot_id',slot->'id','optimized_owner_person_id',person->'incumbentPersonId',
     'service_mode',work->'serviceMode','included_locations',work->'includedLocations'))));
 END LOOP;
 IF EXISTS((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_rows) EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_document->'assignments'))
  UNION ALL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_document->'assignments') EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_rows))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring baseline typed rows differ from exact original source';END IF;
 derived_receipt:=CASE WHEN authority#>>'{shiftEndDerivation,schema}'='custodial.approved-mapped-shift-end-derivation.v1'
  THEN authority#>'{shiftEndDerivation,derivation}' ELSE authority->'shiftEndDerivation' END;
 FOR work IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(authority#>'{overlayCompilerInput,version,assignments}') LOOP
  day:=(work->>'dayOfWeek')::integer;
  SELECT value INTO STRICT person FROM jsonb_array_elements(roster) WHERE value->'slotId'=work->'ownerSlotId' AND value->>'dayOfWeek'=day::text;
  SELECT value INTO STRICT owner_config FROM jsonb_each(config->'slots') WHERE value->'slotId'=work->'ownerSlotId' AND value->'personId'=person->'incumbentPersonId';
  -- Retained v9 vacancy responsibility is OPEN, never an execution owner.
  -- Its exact unique chain was checked above by ordinary or mapped derivation;
  -- caller status/flags cannot create an OPEN escape for required real work.
  original_open:=person->>'status'='vacant_unfilled' AND person->'incumbentPersonId'='null'::jsonb
   AND coalesce(source#>'{version,vacancyCapableSlotIds}','[]'::jsonb) ? (work->>'ownerSlotId')
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(derived_receipt->'parentChains') chain
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(chain->'segments') segment WHERE chain->'dayOfWeek'=work->'dayOfWeek'
     AND segment->'workId'=work->'workId' AND segment->'ownerSlotId'=work->'ownerSlotId' AND segment->>'kind'='open')=1;
  original_open:=coalesce(original_open,false);
  PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_window(work->'window','recurring independently derived work');
  IF (work ? 'schedulingMode' AND work->'schedulingMode' IS DISTINCT FROM '"flexible_coverage_ownership"'::jsonb)
   OR (NOT original_open AND (person->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'working' OR person->'incumbentPersonId'='null'::jsonb OR person->>'incumbentPersonId' IS NULL))
   OR jsonb_typeof(work->'serviceEffortMinutes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR jsonb_typeof(work->'requiredQualifications') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_typeof(work->'restrictions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR nullif(work->>'qualificationProvenance','') IS NULL OR nullif(work->>'restrictionProvenance','') IS NULL
   OR (coalesce(work->'required','true'::jsonb) NOT IN('true'::jsonb,'false'::jsonb))
   OR (coalesce(work->'required','true'::jsonb)='true'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof(work->'priority') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR (work->>'priority')::numeric<>trunc((work->>'priority')::numeric) OR nullif(work->>'priorityProvenance','') IS NULL))
   OR (work->>'serviceEffortMinutes')::numeric<=0 OR (work->>'serviceEffortMinutes')::numeric<>trunc((work->>'serviceEffortMinutes')::numeric)
   OR nullif(work->>'serviceEffortProvenance','') IS NULL
   OR (NOT(work ? 'schedulingMode') AND (work->>'serviceEffortMinutes')::numeric>
    extract(epoch FROM ((work#>>'{window,end}')::time-(work#>>'{window,start}')::time))/60)
   OR work#>>'{window,start}'<person#>>'{shift,start}' OR work#>>'{window,end}'>person#>>'{shift,end}'
   OR NOT(person->'qualifications' @> coalesce(work->'requiredQualifications','[]'::jsonb))
   OR coalesce(work->'restrictedSlotIds','[]'::jsonb) ? (work->>'ownerSlotId')
   OR coalesce(owner_config->'hardForbiddenFamilies','[]'::jsonb) ? (work->>'locationCodeSnapshot')
   OR (person->'restrictions') ? (work->>'locationId')
   OR (work->'manualLock'='true'::jsonb AND work->'ownerSlotId' IS DISTINCT FROM work->'originSlotId')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(work->'includedLocations','[]'::jsonb)) l WHERE (person->'restrictions') ? (l->>'locationId')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring independent fixed owner eligibility or work window differs';END IF;
  route_start:=coalesce(person#>>'{acceptedRoute,startLocationId}',person#>>'{acceptedRoute,start_location_id}',person->>'acceptedRouteStartLocationId',
   person->>'acceptedRouteAnchorLocationId',person->>'routeAnchorLocationId');
  IF work->>'schedulingMode'='flexible_coverage_ownership' AND work->>'serviceMode'<>'reminder_only' AND route_start IS DISTINCT FROM work->>'locationId'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source->'proximity') edge
    WHERE ((edge->>'fromLocationId'=route_start AND edge->>'toLocationId'=work->>'locationId')
     OR ((edge->'bidirectional'='true'::jsonb OR edge->'symmetric'='true'::jsonb) AND edge->>'toLocationId'=route_start AND edge->>'fromLocationId'=work->>'locationId'))
     AND edge->'verified'='true'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(edge->'minutes')='number'
     AND (edge->>'minutes')::numeric>=0 AND (edge->>'minutes')::numeric=trunc((edge->>'minutes')::numeric)
     AND nullif(edge->>'provenance','') IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring fixed flexible area lacks exact verified directed geography';END IF;
  IF (person->>'incumbentPersonId',person->>'slotId') IN(
    ('3da709bb-2223-4e15-8e3a-db02e3f32e97','f22348e9-d4b9-5a7e-b8fd-d0d2c1ec534f'),
    ('cd97111e-cfa0-4228-b4d7-401bc7a5ac13','4a5a83ca-d297-5a30-8344-db08d05b978c'),
    ('30ec85e0-a579-45a8-9c27-c164e77a9190','55e5939c-175c-5026-94fd-c4350d538922'))
   AND NOT(coalesce(owner_config->'normalAssignmentFamilies','[]'::jsonb) ? (work->>'locationCodeSnapshot')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring original personal geography differs';END IF;
  SELECT value INTO baseline_person FROM jsonb_array_elements(roster) WHERE value->'slotId'=work->'originSlotId' AND value->>'dayOfWeek'=day::text;
  d:=p_date+mod(day+6,7);identity_key:=day::text||':'||(work->>'workId');
  normalized_work:=jsonb_build_object('workId',work->'workId','dayOfWeek',day,'originSlotId',work->'originSlotId',
   'locationId',work->'locationId','locationCodeSnapshot',work->'locationCodeSnapshot','locationNameSnapshot',work->'locationNameSnapshot',
   'serviceMode',work->'serviceMode','includedLocations',work->'includedLocations','window',work->'window',
   'serviceEffortMinutes',work->'serviceEffortMinutes','serviceEffortProvenance',work->'serviceEffortProvenance',
   'priority',CASE WHEN original_open OR work->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN '0'::jsonb ELSE work->'priority' END,
   'priorityProvenance',work->'priorityProvenance','required',CASE WHEN original_open THEN 'false'::jsonb ELSE coalesce(work->'required','true'::jsonb) END,
   'coveragePolicy',work->'coveragePolicy','bestEffortCoverage',coalesce(work->'required'='false'::jsonb,false) AND
    (coalesce(work->'coveragePolicy'='"best_effort"'::jsonb,false) OR coalesce(work->'bestEffortCoverage'='true'::jsonb,false)),
   'coveragePolicyOrder',CASE WHEN work->'required'='false'::jsonb AND
    (work->>'coveragePolicy'='best_effort' OR work->'bestEffortCoverage'='true'::jsonb) THEN coalesce(work->'coveragePolicyOrder','1'::jsonb) ELSE 'null'::jsonb END,
   'coveragePolicyProvenance',work->'coveragePolicyProvenance',
   'requiredQualifications',coalesce(work->'requiredQualifications','[]'::jsonb),'qualificationProvenance',work->'qualificationProvenance',
   'restrictions',coalesce(work->'restrictions','[]'::jsonb),'restrictionProvenance',work->'restrictionProvenance',
   'restrictedSlotIds',coalesce(work->'restrictedSlotIds','[]'::jsonb),'manualLock',coalesce(work->'manualLock','false'::jsonb),
   'manualLockSlotId',CASE WHEN work->'manualLock'='true'::jsonb THEN work->'originSlotId' ELSE 'null'::jsonb END,'overlayWork',false);
  expected_projection:=expected_projection||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('plan_work_id',identity_key,'work_id',work->'workId',
   'day_of_week',day,'service_date',d::text,'status',CASE WHEN original_open THEN 'open' ELSE 'assigned' END,
   'reason_code',CASE WHEN original_open THEN 'permitted_open' ELSE NULL END,
   'owner_slot_id',CASE WHEN original_open THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE work->'ownerSlotId' END,'owner_person_id',person->'incumbentPersonId',
   'owner_digest',public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(jsonb_build_object('planWorkId',identity_key,'slotId',CASE WHEN original_open THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE work->'ownerSlotId' END,'personId',person->'incumbentPersonId','serviceDate',d::text)),
   'exact_owner_identity',public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(jsonb_build_object('plan_work_id',identity_key,'service_date',d::text,
    'optimized_owner_slot_id',CASE WHEN original_open THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE work->'ownerSlotId' END,'optimized_owner_person_id',person->'incumbentPersonId',
    'baseline_owner_slot_id',work->'originSlotId','baseline_owner_person_id',baseline_person->'incumbentPersonId')),
   'baseline_owner_slot_id',work->'originSlotId','baseline_owner_person_id',baseline_person->'incumbentPersonId','baseline_owner_name',baseline_person->'incumbentName',
   'original_actor_person_id',baseline_person->'incumbentPersonId','original_actor_name',baseline_person->'incumbentName',
   'optimized_owner_slot_id',CASE WHEN original_open THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE work->'ownerSlotId' END,'optimized_owner_person_id',person->'incumbentPersonId','work_snapshot',normalized_work,
   'explanation',jsonb_build_object('contract','fixed_approved_pattern','hardConstraints','satisfied',
    'reasons',CASE WHEN original_open THEN '[{"code":"permitted_open"}]'::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)));
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(expected_rows)=0 OR jsonb_array_length(expected_projection)=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring work cannot be empty';END IF;
 -- Complete semantics above establish feasibility, never this model-size DATA.
 -- Fixed candidate-universe nodes vary independently of the selected path.
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_document#>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
  OR (p_document#>>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}')::numeric<>trunc((p_document#>>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}')::numeric)
  OR (p_document#>>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}')::numeric<jsonb_array_length(expected_projection)+5*working_count+2*route_count
  OR (p_document#>>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}')::numeric>100000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring model-size serialization invalid';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('source_id',v_source_id,'projection_assignments',expected_projection,
  'staffing_count',employee_count,'hard_constraint_count',p_document#>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_approved_recurring_projection(p_envelope jsonb, p_publication_id uuid, p_date date, p_exceptions jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE publication record;checked jsonb;document jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT p.*,v.draft_document,v.authority_source_id INTO STRICT publication FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications p
  JOIN public.weekly_schedule_versions v USING(version_id) WHERE p.publication_id=p_publication_id;
 document:=publication.draft_document;
 checked:=public.static_weekly_assert_approved_recurring_document(document,p_date,false);
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_envelope,
  ARRAY['adapter','service_date','week_start','week_end','authority','receipt','authority_digest','replay_digest','compiler_version','objective','metrics','applied_exceptions','assignments','semantic_snapshot','database_projection_identity'],
  ARRAY['adapter','service_date','week_start','week_end','authority','receipt','authority_digest','replay_digest','compiler_version','objective','metrics','applied_exceptions','assignments','semantic_snapshot','database_projection_identity'],'approved recurring projection');
 IF p_exceptions IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb OR p_envelope->'applied_exceptions' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
  OR publication.version_id<>public.static_weekly_effective_version(p_date)
  OR publication.authority_source_id IS DISTINCT FROM (checked->>'source_id')::uuid
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_versions prior WHERE prior.version_id=publication.prior_version_id
   AND prior.authority_source_id=publication.authority_source_id
   AND prior.draft_document#>>'{authority,compilerInput,version,id}'=document#>>'{authority,compilerInput,version,id}'
   AND prior.draft_document#>>'{authority,compilerInput,version,publicationId}'=document#>>'{authority,compilerInput,version,publicationId}')
  OR p_envelope->'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM document->'authority' OR p_envelope->'receipt' IS DISTINCT FROM document->'receipt'
  OR p_envelope->'adapter' IS DISTINCT FROM document->'adapter' OR p_envelope->'objective' IS DISTINCT FROM document->'objective'
  OR p_envelope->>'service_date' IS DISTINCT FROM p_date::text OR p_envelope->>'week_start' IS DISTINCT FROM p_date::text
  OR p_envelope->>'week_end' IS DISTINCT FROM (p_date+6)::text
  OR p_envelope->>'authority_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(document->'authority')
  OR p_envelope->>'replay_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>>'{validation,replay_digest}'
  OR p_envelope->>'compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved-static-fixed-v1'
  OR p_envelope->>'database_projection_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_envelope-'database_projection_identity')
  OR p_envelope->'metrics' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('hardConstraints',checked->'hard_constraint_count','violations',0)
  OR EXISTS((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(checked->'projection_assignments') EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'assignments'))
   UNION ALL(SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'assignments') EXCEPT ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(checked->'projection_assignments'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring projection requires exact new relational version and original source lineage';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_command_identity(p_expected_revision bigint, p_actor_manager_id uuid, p_actor_manager_name text, p_idempotency_key text, p_operation text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_expected_revision is null or p_expected_revision<0 or p_actor_manager_id is null
    or nullif(btrim(p_actor_manager_name),'') is null or nullif(btrim(p_idempotency_key),'') is null then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message=format('%s requires non-null revision, actor identity, actor name, and idempotency key',p_operation);
  end if;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_compiler_authority(p_authority jsonb, p_receipt jsonb, p_effective_start date, p_require_publishable boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_generic_plan'
AS $function$
declare
  v_certificate jsonb;
  v_expected_authority_certificate jsonb;
  v_solver_tiers jsonb;
  v_tier_options jsonb;
  v_authority_tiers jsonb;
begin
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_authority,
    array['schema','effectiveDate','compilerInput','overlayCompilerInput','inputDigest','baselineInputDigest','weeklyVersionDigest','projectionAvailability','optimizerResult','appliedExceptions','databaseContentIdentity']||case when p_authority->>'schema'='memphis-zoo.static-weekly-authority.v4' then array['shiftEndDerivation','derivedBaselineDigest'] else '{}'::text[] end,
    array['schema','effectiveDate','compilerInput','overlayCompilerInput','inputDigest','baselineInputDigest','weeklyVersionDigest','projectionAvailability','optimizerResult','appliedExceptions','databaseContentIdentity']||case when p_authority->>'schema'='memphis-zoo.static-weekly-authority.v4' then array['shiftEndDerivation','derivedBaselineDigest'] else '{}'::text[] end,'compiler authority');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_receipt,
    array['schema','adapterVersion','trustedAdapterBoundary','compiler'],
    array['schema','adapterVersion','trustedAdapterBoundary','compiler'],'adapter receipt');
  if jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'schema') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'effectiveDate') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_receipt->'schema') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_receipt->'adapterVersion') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_receipt->'trustedAdapterBoundary') is distinct from 'string'
    or p_authority->>'schema' not in ('memphis-zoo.static-weekly-authority.v3','memphis-zoo.static-weekly-authority.v4')
    or p_receipt->>'schema' not in ('memphis-zoo.static-weekly-database-adapter.v1','memphis-zoo.static-weekly-database-adapter.v2')
    or p_receipt->>'adapterVersion' is distinct from (case p_receipt->>'schema' when 'memphis-zoo.static-weekly-database-adapter.v1' then 'static-weekly-database-adapter-v1' else 'static-weekly-database-adapter-v2-dated-shift-end' end)
    or p_receipt->>'trustedAdapterBoundary' is distinct from 'I1 compileStaticWeeklySchedule result independently reverified before I2 persistence' then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='complete trusted I1-to-I2 adapter receipt is required';
  end if;


  if p_authority->>'schema'='memphis-zoo.static-weekly-authority.v4' then
   if p_receipt->>'schema'<>'memphis-zoo.static-weekly-database-adapter.v2' then raise exception 'derived authority requires v2 adapter'; end if;
   perform public.static_weekly_v9_assert_shift_end_derivation(p_authority);
  elsif p_authority#>'{compilerInput,version,shiftEndContinuityPolicy}' is not null
    or p_authority#>'{compilerInput,version,shiftEndDerivationApplied}' is not null
    or p_authority#>'{overlayCompilerInput,version,shiftEndContinuityPolicy}' is not null
    or p_authority#>'{overlayCompilerInput,version,shiftEndDerivationApplied}' is not null then
   raise exception 'legacy authority cannot carry unverified derivation policy';
  end if;
  v_certificate:=p_receipt#>'{compiler,certificate}';
  v_solver_tiers:=p_receipt#>'{compiler,solver,tiers}';
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object((p_receipt->'compiler'),
    array['contract','compilerVersion','serviceDate','status','publicationAuthority','inputDigest','weeklyVersionId','weeklyVersionDigest','solutionDigest','authorityDigest','replayDigest','certificate','solver','verifier','independentVerification'],
    array['contract','compilerVersion','serviceDate','status','publicationAuthority','inputDigest','weeklyVersionId','weeklyVersionDigest','solutionDigest','authorityDigest','replayDigest','certificate','solver','verifier','independentVerification'],'compiler receipt');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object((p_authority->'optimizerResult'),
    array['compilerVersion','assignments','objective','certificate','tiers','metrics'],
    array['compilerVersion','assignments','objective','certificate','tiers','metrics'],'optimizer authority');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_authority->'compilerInput',
    array['serviceDate','version','slots','exceptions','proximity'],
    array['serviceDate','version','slots','exceptions','proximity'],'baseline compiler input');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_authority->'overlayCompilerInput',
    array['serviceDate','version','slots','exceptions','proximity'],
    array['serviceDate','version','slots','exceptions','proximity'],'overlay compiler input');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(v_certificate,
    array['schema','compilerVersion','verifierVersion','objectivePolicyVersion','canonicalInputDigest','baselineInputDigest','weeklyVersionDigest','solverIdentity','tierReceiptDigest','tierOptionsDigest','assignmentDigest','canonicalProgram','modelBasis','modelBasisDigest','finalWitness','execution'],
    array['schema','compilerVersion','verifierVersion','objectivePolicyVersion','canonicalInputDigest','baselineInputDigest','weeklyVersionDigest','solverIdentity','tierReceiptDigest','tierOptionsDigest','assignmentDigest','canonicalProgram','modelBasis','modelBasisDigest','finalWitness','execution'],'v5 solver certificate');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(v_certificate->'execution',
    array['durationMilliseconds','solveCount','modelBytes','modelBasisBytes','modelVariables','modelRows','modelTerms','workerOutputBytes','boundedWorkingMemoryBytes','receiptBytes','preflight','resultBytes'],
    array['durationMilliseconds','solveCount','modelBytes','modelBasisBytes','modelVariables','modelRows','modelTerms','workerOutputBytes','boundedWorkingMemoryBytes','receiptBytes','preflight','resultBytes'],'v5 solver execution receipt');

  if exists(
    select 1 from unnest(array['durationMilliseconds','solveCount','modelBytes','modelBasisBytes','modelVariables','modelRows','modelTerms','workerOutputBytes','boundedWorkingMemoryBytes','receiptBytes','resultBytes']) field_name
    where jsonb_typeof(v_certificate->'execution'->field_name) is distinct from 'number'
  ) or jsonb_typeof(v_certificate#>'{execution,preflight}') is distinct from 'object' then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='v5 execution receipt fields require exact numeric telemetry and one preflight object';
  end if;
  if exists(
    select 1 from unnest(array['durationMilliseconds','solveCount','modelBytes','modelBasisBytes','modelVariables','modelRows','modelTerms','workerOutputBytes','boundedWorkingMemoryBytes','receiptBytes','resultBytes']) field_name
    where (v_certificate->'execution'->>field_name)::numeric<>trunc((v_certificate->'execution'->>field_name)::numeric)
       or (v_certificate->'execution'->>field_name)::numeric<0
       or (v_certificate->'execution'->>field_name)::numeric>9007199254740991
  ) then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='v5 execution receipt telemetry must be nonnegative exact safe integers';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')->'compilerVersion') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')->'status') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')->'publicationAuthority') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')->'inputDigest') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')->'solutionDigest') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')->'authorityDigest') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')->'replayDigest') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{compilerInput,version}') is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{compilerInput,version,id}') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{compilerInput,version,publicationId}') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{compilerInput,version,assignments}') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{compilerInput,version,slotAvailability}') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{compilerInput,slots}') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{compilerInput,exceptions}') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority#>'{overlayCompilerInput,exceptions}') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_authority->'optimizerResult')->'assignments') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_authority->'optimizerResult')->'tiers') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_authority->'optimizerResult')->'certificate') is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'projectionAvailability') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'appliedExceptions') is distinct from 'array' then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='compiler, optimizer, certificate, model, and projection receipt fields are required';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'inputDigest') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'baselineInputDigest') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'weeklyVersionDigest') is distinct from 'string'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_authority->'databaseContentIdentity') is distinct from 'string'
    or p_authority->>'effectiveDate' is distinct from p_effective_start::text
    or p_authority->>'databaseContentIdentity' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_authority-'databaseContentIdentity')
    or p_authority->>'inputDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_authority->'overlayCompilerInput')
    or p_authority->>'baselineInputDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_authority->'compilerInput')
    or (p_receipt->'compiler')->>'inputDigest' is distinct from p_authority->>'inputDigest'
    or (p_receipt->'compiler')->>'solutionDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb((p_authority->'optimizerResult'))
    or (p_receipt->'compiler')->>'authorityDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_authority)
    or coalesce((p_receipt->'compiler')->>'replayDigest','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='compiler input, baseline, solution, authority, and replay identities must be exact';
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(tier.value->'options' order by tier.ordinality),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_tier_options
  from jsonb_array_elements(v_solver_tiers) with ordinality tier(value,ordinality);
  v_authority_tiers:=public.static_weekly_v5_canonical_solver_tiers(v_solver_tiers);
  v_expected_authority_certificate:=
    (v_certificate-'tierReceiptDigest'-'tierOptionsDigest');
  v_expected_authority_certificate:=jsonb_set(
    v_expected_authority_certificate,
    '{execution}',
    (v_certificate->'execution')-'durationMilliseconds'-'receiptBytes'-'workerOutputBytes'-'resultBytes',
    false
  );

  if v_certificate->>'schema' is distinct from 'memphis-zoo.static-weekly-solver-certificate.v5'
    or v_certificate->>'compilerVersion' is distinct from (case p_receipt->>'schema' when 'memphis-zoo.static-weekly-database-adapter.v1' then 'static-weekly-highs-mip-v8-workload-duty-boundary' else 'static-weekly-highs-mip-v9-dated-shift-end' end)
    or v_certificate->>'compilerVersion' is distinct from (p_receipt->'compiler')->>'compilerVersion'
    or (p_authority->'optimizerResult')->>'compilerVersion' is distinct from (p_receipt->'compiler')->>'compilerVersion'
    or v_certificate->>'verifierVersion' is distinct from (case p_receipt->>'schema' when 'memphis-zoo.static-weekly-database-adapter.v1' then 'static-weekly-js-verifier-v8-workload-duty-boundary' else 'static-weekly-js-verifier-v9-dated-shift-end' end)
    or (p_receipt->'compiler')#>>'{verifier,verifierVersion}' is distinct from v_certificate->>'verifierVersion'
    or (p_receipt->'compiler')#>>'{independentVerification,verifierVersion}' is distinct from v_certificate->>'verifierVersion'
    or v_certificate->>'objectivePolicyVersion' is distinct from 'monotonic-leximax-v1'
    or (p_authority->'optimizerResult')#>>'{objective,policyVersion}' is distinct from v_certificate->>'objectivePolicyVersion'
    or v_certificate->>'canonicalInputDigest' is distinct from p_authority->>'inputDigest'
    or v_certificate->>'baselineInputDigest' is distinct from p_authority->>'baselineInputDigest'
    or v_certificate->>'weeklyVersionDigest' is distinct from p_authority->>'weeklyVersionDigest'
    or jsonb_typeof(v_certificate->'solverIdentity') is distinct from 'object'
    or v_certificate->'solverIdentity' is distinct from (p_receipt->'compiler')#>'{solver,identity}'
    or coalesce(v_certificate->>'tierReceiptDigest','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or v_certificate->>'tierReceiptDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(v_solver_tiers)
    or coalesce(v_certificate->>'tierOptionsDigest','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or v_certificate->>'tierOptionsDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(v_tier_options)
    or coalesce(v_certificate->>'assignmentDigest','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or coalesce(v_certificate->>'modelBasisDigest','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or jsonb_typeof(v_certificate->'modelBasis') is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(v_certificate->'canonicalProgram') is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(v_certificate->'finalWitness') is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(v_certificate->'execution') is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')#>'{independentVerification,violations}') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof((p_receipt->'compiler')#>'{independentVerification,ok}') is distinct from 'boolean'
    or (p_receipt->'compiler')#>>'{independentVerification,ok}' is distinct from 'true'
    or (p_authority->'optimizerResult')->'certificate' is distinct from v_expected_authority_certificate
    or (p_authority->'optimizerResult')->'tiers' is distinct from v_authority_tiers then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='complete accepted v5 solver/verifier certificate, tier receipts, model, witness, and deterministic authority projection are required';
  end if;

  if p_require_publishable and (
    (p_receipt->'compiler')->>'status' is distinct from 'FEASIBLE'
    or (p_receipt->'compiler')->>'publicationAuthority' is distinct from 'ACCEPTABLE'
  ) then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='only a successful publishable compiler result may create a recurring authority version';
  end if;
  if p_require_publishable and (
    p_authority->'appliedExceptions' is distinct from '[]'::jsonb
    
    or p_authority#>'{overlayCompilerInput,exceptions}' is distinct from '[]'::jsonb
    or (p_authority->>'schema'='memphis-zoo.static-weekly-authority.v3' and (
     p_authority->'overlayCompilerInput' is distinct from p_authority->'compilerInput'
     or p_authority->>'inputDigest' is distinct from p_authority->>'baselineInputDigest'))
    or (p_authority->>'schema'='memphis-zoo.static-weekly-authority.v4' and
     p_authority->>'inputDigest' is distinct from p_authority->>'derivedBaselineDigest')
  ) then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='recurring draft authority must be an exception-free baseline compiler result';
  end if;
end
$function$
functions.comment: Complete v5 proof validation with bounded JSON lifetime for one-GB production Postgres.

functions.identity_arguments: p_binding jsonb, p_source uuid, p_digest text
p_document jsonb, p_effective_start date, p_require_publishable boolean

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_document(p_document jsonb, p_effective_start date, p_require_publishable boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_compiler_authority(p_document->'authority',p_document->'receipt',p_effective_start,p_require_publishable);
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_document,array['adapter','authority','receipt','slot_availability','assignments','objective_inputs','validation'],array['adapter','authority','receipt','slot_availability','assignments','objective_inputs','validation'],'adapter document');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_document->'adapter',array['schema','version'],array['schema','version'],'adapter document adapter');
  perform public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_document->'validation',array['status','publication_authority','compiler_version','input_digest','solution_digest','authority_digest','replay_digest','receipt_digest','database_document_identity'],array['status','publication_authority','compiler_version','input_digest','solution_digest','authority_digest','replay_digest','receipt_digest','database_document_identity'],'adapter document validation');
  if jsonb_typeof(p_document #> '{adapter,schema}') is distinct from 'string' or jsonb_typeof(p_document #> '{adapter,version}') is distinct from 'string'
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['status','publication_authority','compiler_version','input_digest','solution_digest','authority_digest','replay_digest','receipt_digest','database_document_identity']) as r(key) where jsonb_typeof(p_document->'validation'->r.key) is distinct from 'string')
    or p_document #>> '{adapter,schema}' is distinct from p_document#>>'{receipt,schema}'
    or p_document #>> '{adapter,version}' is distinct from p_document#>>'{receipt,adapterVersion}'
    or p_document #>> '{validation,database_document_identity}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_document_identity(p_document)
    or p_document #>> '{validation,authority_digest}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb((p_document->'authority'))
    or p_document #>> '{validation,solution_digest}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb((p_document->'authority')->'optimizerResult')
    or p_document #>> '{validation,input_digest}' is distinct from (p_document->'authority')->>'inputDigest'
    or p_document #>> '{validation,replay_digest}' is distinct from p_document #>> '{receipt,compiler,replayDigest}'
    or p_document #>> '{validation,receipt_digest}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_document->'receipt')
    or jsonb_typeof((p_document->'assignments')) is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_typeof((p_document->'slot_availability')) is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_typeof((p_document->'objective_inputs')) is distinct from 'array' then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='adapter document identity and exact relational projection are required';
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length((p_document->'assignments'))=0 or jsonb_array_length((p_document->'slot_availability'))=0 or jsonb_array_length((p_document->'objective_inputs'))<>1
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'assignments')) as a(x)
      where jsonb_typeof(a.x) is distinct from 'object' or not (a.x ?& array['work_id','day_of_week','status','location_id','location_code_snapshot','location_name_snapshot','coverage_start','coverage_end','owner_slot_id','owner_slot_label_snapshot','owner_person_id_snapshot','owner_name_snapshot','required_qualifications_snapshot','restriction_snapshot','workload_points','workload_provenance','manual_lock','payload_json'])
        or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(a.x) as k(key) where not (k.key=any(array['work_id','day_of_week','status','location_id','location_code_snapshot','location_name_snapshot','coverage_start','coverage_end','owner_slot_id','owner_slot_label_snapshot','owner_person_id_snapshot','owner_name_snapshot','required_qualifications_snapshot','restriction_snapshot','workload_points','workload_provenance','manual_lock','payload_json'])))
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'work_id') is distinct from 'string' or nullif(btrim(a.x->>'work_id'),'') is null
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'day_of_week') is distinct from 'number' or (a.x->>'day_of_week') !~ '^[0-6]$'
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'status') is distinct from 'string' or upper(a.x->>'status') not in ('ASSIGNED','OPEN','REVIEW')
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'location_id') is distinct from 'string' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'location_code_snapshot') is distinct from 'string' or nullif(btrim(a.x->>'location_code_snapshot'),'') is null
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'location_name_snapshot') is distinct from 'string' or nullif(btrim(a.x->>'location_name_snapshot'),'') is null
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'coverage_start') is distinct from 'string' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'coverage_end') is distinct from 'string'
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'required_qualifications_snapshot') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'restriction_snapshot') is distinct from 'array'
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'workload_points') is distinct from 'number' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'workload_provenance') is distinct from 'object'
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'manual_lock') is distinct from 'boolean' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'payload_json') is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(a.x#>'{payload_json,authority_facts}') is distinct from 'object')
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'slot_availability')) as a(x)
      where jsonb_typeof(a.x) is distinct from 'object' or not (a.x ?& array['slot_id','day_of_week','availability_state','shift_start','shift_end','lunch_start','lunch_end','capacity_units','max_load_points','qualification_snapshot','qualification_provenance','restriction_snapshot','restriction_provenance','slot_label_snapshot','incumbent_person_id_snapshot','incumbent_name_snapshot'])
        or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(a.x) as k(key) where not (k.key=any(array['slot_id','day_of_week','availability_state','shift_start','shift_end','lunch_start','lunch_end','capacity_units','max_load_points','qualification_snapshot','qualification_provenance','restriction_snapshot','restriction_provenance','slot_label_snapshot','incumbent_person_id_snapshot','incumbent_name_snapshot'])))
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'slot_id') is distinct from 'string' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'day_of_week') is distinct from 'number' or (a.x->>'day_of_week') !~ '^[0-6]$'
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'availability_state') is distinct from 'string' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'qualification_snapshot') is distinct from 'array'
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'qualification_provenance') is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'restriction_snapshot') is distinct from 'array'
        or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'restriction_provenance') is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(a.x->'slot_label_snapshot') is distinct from 'string' or nullif(btrim(a.x->>'slot_label_snapshot'),'') is null)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'objective_inputs')) as i(x)
      where jsonb_typeof(i.x) is distinct from 'object' or not (i.x ?& array['input_key','input_value','provenance'])
        or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(i.x) as k(key) where not (k.key=any(array['input_key','input_value','provenance'])))
        or i.x->>'input_key' is distinct from 'static_weekly_compiler_receipt' or jsonb_typeof(i.x->'input_value') is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(i.x->'provenance') is distinct from 'object') then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='adapter document rows must be complete, typed, exact, and non-empty';
  end if;
  if (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'assignments')))<>(select count(distinct (x->>'day_of_week',x->>'work_id')) from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'assignments')) as a(x))
    or (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'slot_availability')))<>(select count(distinct (x->>'day_of_week',x->>'slot_id')) from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'slot_availability')) as a(x)) then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='adapter document rows may not contain duplicate work or availability identities';
  end if;
  if exists(
    with source as (select value x,((value->>'dayOfWeek')||':'||coalesce(value->>'workId',value->>'id')) k from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'authority') #> '{overlayCompilerInput,version,assignments}')),
    optimizer as (select value x from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'authority') #> '{optimizerResult,assignments}')),
    document as (select value x from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'assignments')))
    select 1 from source s full join optimizer o on o.x->>'planWorkId'=s.k full join document d on ((d.x->>'day_of_week')||':'||(d.x->>'work_id'))=coalesce(s.k,o.x->>'planWorkId')
    where s.x is null or o.x is null or d.x is null
      or o.x->>'serviceDate' is distinct from (p_effective_start+(((s.x->>'dayOfWeek')::int-extract(dow from p_effective_start)::int+7)%7))::date::text
      or d.x->>'coverage_start' is distinct from s.x#>>'{window,start}' or d.x->>'coverage_end' is distinct from s.x#>>'{window,end}'
      or d.x->>'location_id' is distinct from s.x->>'locationId' or d.x->>'workload_points' is distinct from s.x->>'serviceEffortMinutes'
      or lower(d.x->>'status') is distinct from lower(o.x->>'status')
      or (o.x->>'status'='ASSIGNED' and (d.x->>'owner_slot_id' is distinct from o.x->>'slotId' or d.x->>'owner_person_id_snapshot' is distinct from o.x->>'personId' or d.x->>'owner_name_snapshot' is distinct from o.x->>'displayName'))
      or (o.x->>'status' in ('OPEN','REVIEW') and (d.x->>'owner_slot_id' is not null or d.x->>'owner_person_id_snapshot' is not null or d.x->>'owner_name_snapshot' is not null))
      or d.x#>>'{payload_json,owner_digest}' is distinct from o.x->>'ownerDigest'
      or d.x#>>'{payload_json,exact_owner_identity}' is distinct from o.x->>'exactOwnerIdentity'
  ) then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='all seven-day source work, optimizer owners, and document assignments must exactly agree'; end if;
  if exists(
    with source as (select value x from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'authority')->'projectionAvailability')),
    document as (select value x from jsonb_array_elements((p_document->'slot_availability')))
    select 1 from source s full join document d on d.x->>'slot_id'=s.x->>'slotId' and d.x->>'day_of_week'=s.x->>'dayOfWeek'
    where s.x is null or d.x is null or d.x->>'availability_state' is distinct from s.x->>'status'
      or d.x->>'shift_start' is distinct from s.x#>>'{shift,start}' or d.x->>'shift_end' is distinct from s.x#>>'{shift,end}'
      or d.x->>'capacity_units' is distinct from s.x->>'productiveCapacityMinutes' or d.x->>'max_load_points' is distinct from s.x->>'maxServiceEffortMinutes'
      or d.x->>'incumbent_person_id_snapshot' is distinct from s.x->>'incumbentPersonId' or d.x->>'incumbent_name_snapshot' is distinct from s.x->>'incumbentName'
  ) then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='all seven-day dated availability and incumbent identities must exactly agree'; end if;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_value jsonb, p_required text[], p_allowed text[], p_label text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_value) is distinct from 'object'
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_required) as r(key) where not (p_value ? r.key) or jsonb_typeof(p_value->r.key)='null')
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p_value) as k(key) where not (k.key=any(p_allowed))) then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message=format('%s must be a complete exact non-null JSON object',p_label);
  end if;
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_capacity_accepted_slot(p_publication uuid, p_date date, p_slot uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare slot jsonb;version_id uuid;
begin
 select s.value,v.version_id into slot,version_id from public.weekly_schedule_publications p
  join public.weekly_schedule_versions v using(version_id)
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(v.draft_document#>'{authority,compilerInput,slots}') s(value)
  where p.publication_id=p_publication and s.value->>'id'=p_slot::text;
 if slot is null or not public.static_weekly_capacity_registered(slot)
  or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_roster_slot_incumbencies i where i.slot_id=p_slot)
  or not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_schedule_exception_commands capacity
   where capacity.base_version_id=version_id and capacity.publication_id=p_publication
    and capacity.service_date=p_date and capacity.exception_type='cover_all'
    and capacity.payload_json#>>'{availability,slotId}'=p_slot::text
    and not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_schedule_exception_commands reversal where reversal.reverses_exception_id=capacity.exception_id)) then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='typed capacity owner requires immutable publication source and exact accepted dated manual command';
 end if;
 return slot;
end $function$
