CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_capacity_assert_projection_owner(p_envelope jsonb, p_publication uuid, p_row jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare availability jsonb;optimizer jsonb;capacity jsonb;
 native_source jsonb;native_slot jsonb;native_day jsonb;native_overlay jsonb;
 native_substitute jsonb;native_template jsonb;native_expected jsonb;
begin
 if p_row->>'owner_kind' is null and p_row->>'capacity_id' is null then return;end if;
 if p_row->>'owner_kind' is distinct from 'CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY' or p_row->>'status' is distinct from 'assigned'
  or p_row->>'capacity_id' is distinct from p_row->>'owner_slot_id'
  or p_row->'owner_person_id' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='typed contractor projection cannot invent employee identity or mismatched capacity';
 end if;
 -- Native manual projections carry fixed-witness DATA, not a legacy
 -- recurring cover_all acceptance or independently selected optimizer result.
 if p_envelope#>>'{authority,schema}'='custodial.approved-manual-period-projection-authority.v1' then
  if p_envelope->'adapter' is distinct from jsonb_build_object(
    'schema','custodial.approved-manual-period-database-adapter.v1','version','approved-manual-period-v1')
   or p_envelope->>'compiler_version' is distinct from 'approved-manual-period-v1'
   or p_envelope#>>'{receipt,schema}' is distinct from 'custodial.approved-manual-native-feasibility-data.v1'
   or coalesce(p_envelope#>>'{receipt,nativePreparationDigest}','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   or coalesce(p_envelope#>>'{authority,hardConstraintDigest}','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   or coalesce(p_envelope#>>'{authority,fixedWitnessDigest}','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   or jsonb_typeof(p_envelope#>'{authority,hardConstraintCount}') is distinct from 'number'
   or (p_envelope#>>'{authority,hardConstraintCount}')::bigint<=0
   or p_envelope#>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}' is distinct from p_envelope#>'{authority,hardConstraintCount}'
   or p_envelope#>'{receipt,hardConstraintDigest}' is distinct from p_envelope#>'{authority,hardConstraintDigest}'
   or p_envelope#>'{receipt,fixedWitnessDigest}' is distinct from p_envelope#>'{authority,fixedWitnessDigest}'
   or jsonb_typeof(p_envelope#>'{receipt,selectionSolverInvoked}') is distinct from 'boolean'
   or p_envelope#>'{metrics,hardConstraints}' is distinct from p_envelope#>'{authority,hardConstraintCount}'
   or p_envelope#>'{metrics,violations}' is distinct from '0'::jsonb
   or p_envelope->>'service_date' is distinct from p_envelope->>'week_start'
   or (p_envelope->>'week_end')::date is distinct from (p_envelope->>'week_start')::date+6
   or jsonb_typeof(p_envelope->'assignments') is distinct from 'array'
   then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='Native capacity owner requires the exact manual adapter and fixed-witness receipt';end if;
  if (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'assignments') r where r=p_row)<>1
   or (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'assignments') r
     where r->>'plan_work_id'=p_row->>'plan_work_id' and r->>'service_date'=p_row->>'service_date')<>1 then
   raise exception using errcode='23514',message='Native capacity owner row is not one exact member of the native envelope';end if;
  native_source:=p_envelope#>'{authority,compilerInput}';
  if jsonb_typeof(native_source) is distinct from 'object'
   or p_envelope#>>'{authority,schema}' is distinct from 'custodial.approved-manual-period-projection-authority.v1'
   or p_envelope#>>'{authority,sourceDigest}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(native_source)
   or native_source#>>'{version,publicationId}' is distinct from p_publication::text
   or p_envelope#>>'{authority,sourcePublicationId}' is distinct from p_publication::text
   or p_envelope#>>'{authority,sourceVersionId}' is distinct from native_source#>>'{version,id}'
   or nullif(native_source#>>'{version,id}','') is null
   or native_source->>'serviceDate' is distinct from (p_envelope->>'week_start')::date::text
   or p_envelope->>'authority_digest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_envelope->'authority')
   or p_envelope->>'database_projection_identity' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_envelope-'database_projection_identity')
   then raise exception 'Native capacity owner source or envelope identity changed';end if;
  select value into strict availability from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,projectionAvailability}')
   where value->>'slotId'=p_row->>'owner_slot_id' and value->>'serviceDate'=p_row->>'service_date';
  if availability->'dayOfWeek' is distinct from p_row->'day_of_week'
   or p_row#>'{work_snapshot,dayOfWeek}' is distinct from p_row->'day_of_week' then
   raise exception using errcode='23514',message='Native capacity owner date or work weekday changed';end if;
   if availability->>'ownerKind' is distinct from 'CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY'
    or nullif(availability->>'slotId','') is null
    or availability->>'capacityId' is distinct from availability->>'slotId'
    or availability->'incumbentPersonId' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or availability->'incumbentName' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or (availability->>'serviceDate')::date not between (p_envelope->>'week_start')::date and (p_envelope->>'week_start')::date+6
    or availability->'dayOfWeek' is distinct from to_jsonb(extract(dow from (availability->>'serviceDate')::date)::integer)
    or (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,projectionAvailability}') a
      where a->>'slotId'=availability->>'slotId' and a->>'serviceDate'=availability->>'serviceDate')<>1
    then raise exception 'Native capacity owner requires unique working capacity with explicit null person';end if;
   select value into strict native_slot from jsonb_array_elements(native_source->'slots')
    where value->>'id'=availability->>'slotId';
   if native_slot->>'kind' is distinct from 'CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY'
    or native_slot->'incumbencies' is distinct from '[]'::jsonb
    or public.static_weekly_capacity_registered(native_slot) is not true
    then raise exception 'Native capacity owner capacity is not the exact registered nonemployee source slot';end if;
   select value into strict native_day from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,datedDayBases}')
    where value->>'serviceDate'=availability->>'serviceDate' and value->>'kind'='COVERALL';
   native_overlay:=native_day->'overlay';native_substitute:=native_overlay->'substitute';
   if coalesce(native_overlay->>'schema','') not in('custodial.approved-manual-coverall-overlay.v1','custodial.approved-manual-coverall-overlay.v2')
    or native_overlay->>'status' is distinct from 'VALIDATED_UNPUBLISHED_COVERALL_OVERLAY'
    or native_overlay->>'overlayDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(native_overlay-'overlayDigest')
    or native_overlay->>'sourceDigest' is distinct from p_envelope#>>'{authority,sourceDigest}'
    or native_overlay->>'serviceDate' is distinct from availability->>'serviceDate'
    or native_day#>>'{input,sourceDigest}' is distinct from p_envelope#>>'{authority,sourceDigest}'
    or native_day#>>'{input,inputDigest}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb((native_day->'input')-'inputDigest')
    or native_day#>>'{plan,planDigest}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb((native_day->'plan')-'planDigest')
    or native_overlay->>'acceptedPlanDigest' is distinct from native_day#>>'{plan,planDigest}'
    or native_substitute->>'kind' is distinct from 'CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY'
    or native_substitute->>'slotId' is distinct from availability->>'slotId'
    or native_substitute->'actualHoursConfirmed' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    or jsonb_typeof(native_substitute->'confirmationReference') is distinct from 'string'
    or length(native_substitute->>'confirmationReference') not between 1 and 256
    or native_substitute->'shift' is distinct from availability->'shift'
    or native_substitute#>>'{lunch,start}' is distinct from availability#>>'{lunch,start}'
    or native_substitute#>>'{lunch,end}' is distinct from availability#>>'{lunch,end}'
    then raise exception 'Native capacity owner does not bind its exact confirmed CoverAll overlay';end if;
   select value into strict native_template from jsonb_array_elements(native_slot->'contractorAvailability')
    where value->'dayOfWeek'=availability->'dayOfWeek';
   native_expected:=(native_template-'breakChoice')||jsonb_build_object(
    'slotId',native_slot->'id','dayOfWeek',availability->'dayOfWeek','status','working',
    'shift',native_substitute->'shift',
    'lunch',(native_substitute->'lunch')||jsonb_build_object(
      'startMinute',(extract(epoch from (native_substitute#>>'{lunch,start}')::time)/60)::integer,
      'endMinute',(extract(epoch from (native_substitute#>>'{lunch,end}')::time)/60)::integer),
    'maxDutyMinutes',(extract(epoch from ((native_substitute#>>'{shift,end}')::time-(native_substitute#>>'{shift,start}')::time))/60)::integer-60,
    'maxDutyProvenance',native_template->'productiveCapacityProvenance','blockedWindows','[]'::jsonb,
    'serviceDate',availability->'serviceDate','incumbentPersonId','null'::jsonb,
    'incumbentName','null'::jsonb,'ownerKind','CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY','capacityId',native_slot->'id');
   if availability is distinct from native_expected then
    raise exception 'Native capacity owner hours, eligibility or raw lunch differ from registered capacity and confirmed overlay';end if;
  return;
 end if;
 perform public.static_weekly_capacity_accepted_slot(p_publication,(p_row->>'service_date')::date,(p_row->>'owner_slot_id')::uuid);
 select value into strict optimizer from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,optimizerResult,assignments}')
  where value->>'planWorkId'=p_row->>'plan_work_id';
 if optimizer->>'ownerKind' is distinct from p_row->>'owner_kind' or optimizer->>'capacityId' is distinct from p_row->>'capacity_id'
  or optimizer->'personId' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb or optimizer->'displayName' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='capacity projection must bind exact independently verified optimizer category';
 end if;
 select value into strict availability from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,projectionAvailability}')
  where value->>'slotId'=p_row->>'owner_slot_id' and value->>'serviceDate'=p_row->>'service_date';
 select payload_json->'availability' into capacity from public.weekly_schedule_exception_commands e
  where e.publication_id=p_publication and e.service_date=(p_row->>'service_date')::date and e.exception_type='cover_all'
   and e.payload_json#>>'{availability,slotId}'=p_row->>'owner_slot_id'
   and not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_schedule_exception_commands r where r.reverses_exception_id=e.exception_id)
  order by authority_revision desc limit 1;
 if availability->>'status' is distinct from 'working' or availability->>'ownerKind' is distinct from 'CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY'
  or availability->>'capacityId' is distinct from p_row->>'capacity_id' or availability->'incumbentPersonId' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
  or availability->'shift' is distinct from capacity->'shift'
  or availability->'qualifications' is distinct from capacity->'qualifications'
  or availability->'restrictions' is distinct from capacity->'restrictions' then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='contractor owner requires exact accepted current dated shift/eligibility facts';
 end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_capacity_assert_shape(p_slot jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if p_slot->>'kind' is distinct from 'CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY'
  or p_slot->'contractorCapacity' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
  or p_slot->>'id' is distinct from p_slot->>'capacityId'
  or p_slot->>'label' is null or p_slot->>'label' !~ '^CoverAll0[1-8]$'
  or p_slot->'incumbencies' is distinct from '[]'::jsonb
  or coalesce(p_slot->'vacancyCapable','false'::jsonb) is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
  or coalesce(p_slot->'declaredVacant','false'::jsonb) is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
  or jsonb_typeof(p_slot->'contractorAvailability') is distinct from 'array'
  or jsonb_array_length(p_slot->'contractorAvailability') not between 1 and 7 then
   raise exception using errcode='23514',message='nonemployee capacity requires exact typed stable identity, CoverAll01..08, no incumbent/vacancy, and registered dated templates';
 end if;
 perform public.static_weekly_v3_assert_uuid(p_slot->'id','nonemployee capacity slot id');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_configure_authority_attestation_key(p_hmac_secret text, p_configured_by text DEFAULT 'release-owner'::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if length(coalesce(p_hmac_secret,''))<32 then
    raise exception using errcode='22023',message='static weekly authority attestation key must contain at least 32 characters';
  end if;
  insert into public.static_weekly_authority_attestation_config(singleton,hmac_secret,enabled,configured_at,configured_by)
  values(true,p_hmac_secret,true,statement_timestamp(),left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_configured_by),''),'release-owner'),200))
  on conflict(singleton) do update set hmac_secret=excluded.hmac_secret,enabled=true,configured_at=excluded.configured_at,configured_by=excluded.configured_by;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_coverall_effective_facts(p_publication uuid, p_frame date, p_exclude_operation uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE row record;facts jsonb:='[]';
BEGIN
 FOR row IN SELECT a.*,q.choice_id,c.state,c.expected_revision FROM custodial_coverall.accepted_days a
 JOIN custodial_coverall.choices q USING(operation_id) JOIN public.static_weekly_staffing_commands c USING(operation_id)
 JOIN public.static_weekly_staffing_absences original ON original.absence_id=a.operation_id AND original.accepted_operation_id=c.operation_id
  AND original.accepted_revision=a.accepted_revision AND original.accepted_by_manager_id=a.manager_id
 WHERE a.publication_id=p_publication AND a.service_date BETWEEN p_frame AND p_frame+6
  AND (p_exclude_operation IS NULL OR a.operation_id<>p_exclude_operation)
  AND (c.state='ACCEPTED' OR (c.state='PREPARED' AND current_setting('app.static_weekly_staffing_batch_operation',true)=c.operation_id::text
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_authority_revisions r WHERE r.command_id=c.operation_id AND r.authority_revision=a.accepted_revision AND r.operation='apply_staffing_command')))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custodial_coverall.cancellations x JOIN public.static_weekly_staffing_absence_cancellations k
    ON k.accepted_operation_id=x.operation_id AND k.absence_id=x.original_operation_id AND k.accepted_revision=x.accepted_revision
    JOIN public.static_weekly_staffing_commands cc ON cc.operation_id=x.operation_id
    WHERE x.original_operation_id=a.operation_id AND x.service_date=a.service_date AND (p_exclude_operation IS NULL OR x.operation_id<>p_exclude_operation)
     AND (cc.state='ACCEPTED' OR (cc.state='PREPARED' AND current_setting('app.static_weekly_staffing_batch_operation',true)=cc.operation_id::text)))
 ORDER BY a.service_date,a.operation_id LOOP
  facts:=facts||(SELECT jsonb_agg(e||jsonb_build_object('status','accepted')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.static_weekly_coverall_day_facts(row.operation_id,row.day_json,row.manager_id,row.expected_revision,row.choice_id)) e);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN facts;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_guard_approved_template_confirmation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_expected_revision numeric;v_accepted_revision numeric;v_service_date date;v_kind text;v_week date;
 v_actor jsonb;v_generation bigint;v_checked jsonb;
 v_publication public.weekly_schedule_publications%rowtype;
 v_projection public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections%rowtype;
 v_lunch public.weekly_schedule_lunch_documents%rowtype;
BEGIN
 IF TG_RELID<>'public.static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations'::regclass
  OR TG_TABLE_SCHEMA<>'public' OR TG_TABLE_NAME<>'static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations'
  OR TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR TG_WHEN<>'BEFORE' OR TG_LEVEL<>'ROW' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Exact approved original confirmation trigger required';END IF;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(NEW.manager_id);
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(NEW.request_json,
  ARRAY['serviceDate','kind','expectedRevision','previewDigest','idempotencyKey'],
  ARRAY['publicationId','serviceDate','kind','templateId','expectedRevision','previewDigest','idempotencyKey'],
  'original approved recurring request');
 IF NOT (NEW.request_json ?& ARRAY['publicationId','serviceDate','kind','templateId','expectedRevision','previewDigest','idempotencyKey'])
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.request_json->'kind') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR NEW.request_json->>'kind' NOT IN('RECURRING_STAFFING','DATED_ABSENCE')
  OR NEW.request_json->'idempotencyKey' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.idempotency_key)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.request_json->'serviceDate') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR length(NEW.request_json->>'serviceDate')<>10
  OR NEW.request_json->>'serviceDate' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.request_json->'expectedRevision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
  OR NEW.request_json->>'expectedRevision' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.request_json->'previewDigest') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR length(NEW.request_json->>'previewDigest')<>64
  OR NEW.request_json->>'previewDigest' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Exact original recurring request identity required';END IF;
 IF NEW.request_json->'templateId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
  PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_text(NEW.request_json->'templateId','original approved template',128);
  IF NEW.request_json->>'templateId' IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(NEW.request_json->>'templateId') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Original approved template identity must not be normalized';END IF;
 END IF;
 v_kind:=NEW.request_json->>'kind';
 IF (v_kind='RECURRING_STAFFING' AND (NEW.request_json->'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    OR NEW.publication_id=NEW.source_publication_id))
  OR (v_kind='DATED_ABSENCE' AND (NEW.request_json->'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.source_publication_id::text)
    OR NEW.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_publication_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Original approved kind and publication profile differs';END IF;
 v_service_date:=(NEW.request_json->>'serviceDate')::date;
 v_expected_revision:=(NEW.request_json->>'expectedRevision')::numeric;
 IF NOT isfinite(v_service_date) OR (v_kind='RECURRING_STAFFING' AND extract(isodow FROM v_service_date)<>1) OR v_expected_revision>9007199254740991 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Original recurring Monday and supported exact revision required';END IF;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(NEW.receipt_json,
  ARRAY['schema','status','ok','persistence_status','publication_id','projection_id','authority_revision','revision',
   'feasibility_digest','lunch_document_identity','previewDigest','solverInvoked'],
  ARRAY['schema','status','ok','persistence_status','source_id','publication_id','projection_id','authority_revision','revision',
   'feasibility_digest','lunch_document_identity','previewDigest','solverInvoked'],'original approved recurring receipt');
 IF NEW.receipt_json->'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM '"custodial.approved-static-confirmation.v1"'::jsonb
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'status' IS DISTINCT FROM '"PERSISTED_CURRENT"'::jsonb
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'persistence_status' IS DISTINCT FROM '"PERSISTED"'::jsonb
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'solverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'publication_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.publication_id::text)
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'projection_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.projection_id::text)
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'previewDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.request_json->'previewDigest'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.receipt_json->'authority_revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
  OR NEW.receipt_json->>'authority_revision' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.receipt_json->'revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
  OR NEW.receipt_json->>'revision' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  OR NEW.receipt_json->'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.receipt_json->'authority_revision'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.receipt_json->'feasibility_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR length(NEW.receipt_json->>'feasibility_digest')<>64 OR NEW.receipt_json->>'feasibility_digest' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.receipt_json->'lunch_document_identity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR length(NEW.receipt_json->>'lunch_document_identity')<>64 OR NEW.receipt_json->>'lunch_document_identity' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Exact original accepted recurring receipt required';END IF;
 v_accepted_revision:=(NEW.receipt_json->>'authority_revision')::numeric;
 IF v_accepted_revision<=v_expected_revision OR v_accepted_revision>9007199254740991 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Original accepted recurring revision must advance exactly within the supported range';END IF;
 -- source_id is an existing optional accepted-result field, not a newly
 -- required writer field. If present, bind it to the actual accepted version.
 IF NEW.receipt_json ? 'source_id' THEN
  IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.receipt_json->'source_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR length(NEW.receipt_json->>'source_id')<>36
   OR NEW.receipt_json->>'source_id' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Original accepted source identity differs';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF v_kind='RECURRING_STAFFING' THEN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications p
  JOIN public.weekly_schedule_versions v ON v.version_id=p.version_id
  JOIN public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections x ON x.publication_id=p.publication_id AND x.version_id=v.version_id
  JOIN public.weekly_schedule_lunch_documents l ON l.projection_id=x.projection_id
  WHERE p.publication_id=NEW.publication_id AND x.projection_id=NEW.projection_id
   AND p.actor_manager_id=NEW.manager_id AND x.compiled_by_manager_id=NEW.manager_id AND l.accepted_by_manager_id=NEW.manager_id
   AND p.effective_start=v_service_date AND x.week_start=v_service_date AND x.week_end=v_service_date+6
   AND p.authority_revision>v_expected_revision AND p.authority_revision<=v_accepted_revision
   AND l.document_identity=NEW.receipt_json->>'lunch_document_identity'
   AND (NOT (NEW.receipt_json ? 'source_id') OR NEW.receipt_json->>'source_id'=v.authority_source_id::text)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Original recurring receipt must reference its actual accepted publication projection and lunch';
 END IF;
 ELSE
  -- Prove the actual same-publication dated write, not the old publication's
  -- creator/effective start/revision. No receipt JSON is an admission flag.
  v_week:=v_service_date-(extract(isodow FROM v_service_date)::integer-1);
  v_actor:=public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(NEW.manager_id);
  v_generation:=public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation();
  IF v_generation IS NULL OR v_generation NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
   OR NOT(NEW.receipt_json ? 'source_id')
   OR v_accepted_revision IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_revision+1
   OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM v_accepted_revision
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Dated original current actor generation or exact advanced revision differs';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_publication FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications
   WHERE publication_id=NEW.source_publication_id;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_projection FROM public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections
   WHERE projection_id=NEW.projection_id;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_lunch FROM public.weekly_schedule_lunch_documents
   WHERE projection_id=NEW.projection_id;
  IF v_projection.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.publication_id
   OR v_projection.version_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_publication.version_id
   OR public.static_weekly_effective_version(v_week) IS DISTINCT FROM v_publication.version_id
   OR public.static_weekly_effective_version(v_week+6) IS DISTINCT FROM v_publication.version_id
   OR v_projection.week_start IS DISTINCT FROM v_week OR v_projection.week_end IS DISTINCT FROM v_week+6
   OR v_projection.compiled_by_manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.manager_id
   OR v_lunch.accepted_by_manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.manager_id
   OR v_lunch.document_identity IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.receipt_json->>'lunch_document_identity'
   OR v_lunch.document_json->>'document_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM v_lunch.document_identity
   OR v_lunch.document_json->>'week_start' IS DISTINCT FROM v_week::text
   OR v_projection.receipt_json IS DISTINCT FROM v_projection.projection_envelope->'receipt'
   OR v_projection.receipt_json->'feasibilityDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.receipt_json->'feasibility_digest'
   OR v_projection.projection_envelope->>'compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved-static-dated-v1'
   OR v_projection.projection_envelope#>>'{adapter,schema}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-dated-adapter.v1'
   OR v_projection.projection_envelope#>>'{authority,originalPublicationId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.publication_id::text
   OR v_projection.projection_envelope#>>'{authority,originalVersionId}' IS DISTINCT FROM v_publication.version_id::text
   OR v_projection.projection_envelope#>'{authority,scopeDates}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(v_service_date::text)
   OR v_projection.projection_envelope#>'{authority,scopeDays}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(extract(dow FROM v_service_date)::integer)
   OR v_projection.authority_digest IS DISTINCT FROM v_projection.projection_envelope->>'authority_digest'
   OR v_projection.replay_digest IS DISTINCT FROM v_projection.projection_envelope->>'replay_digest'
   OR v_projection.exception_set_json IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_accepted_exception_set(NEW.publication_id,v_week)
   OR v_projection.exception_set_digest IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(v_projection.exception_set_json)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_versions v
    JOIN public.static_weekly_authority_source_documents s ON s.source_id=v.authority_source_id
    WHERE v.version_id=v_publication.version_id AND s.active
     AND s.source_id::text=NEW.receipt_json->>'source_id'
     AND s.source_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(s.canonical_source))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Dated receipt does not bind its actual original current Source projection and lunch';END IF;
  -- Existing immutable command/revision records prove that THIS manager
  -- actually advanced the original requested revision for THIS projection.
  -- They are not fabricated here, and old publication metadata is not changed.
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts c
   JOIN public.weekly_schedule_authority_revisions a ON a.command_id=c.command_id
   WHERE c.actor_manager_id=NEW.manager_id AND a.actor_manager_id=NEW.manager_id
    AND c.command_type='materialize_projection' AND a.operation='materialize_projection'
    AND c.idempotency_key=(NEW.request_json->>'previewDigest')||':dated-projection'
    AND c.expected_revision=v_expected_revision AND a.authority_revision=v_accepted_revision
    AND a.content_digest=c.content_digest
    AND c.request_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(c.request_canonical_json)
    AND c.request_canonical_json->'publication_id'=to_jsonb(NEW.publication_id::text)
    AND c.request_canonical_json->'service_date'=to_jsonb(v_week::text)
    AND c.request_canonical_json->'expected_revision'=NEW.request_json->'expectedRevision'
    AND c.request_canonical_json->'actor_manager_id'=to_jsonb(NEW.manager_id::text)
    AND c.request_canonical_json->'projection_envelope'=v_projection.projection_envelope
    AND c.response_json#>'{data,projection_id}'=to_jsonb(NEW.projection_id::text)
    AND c.response_json#>'{data,publication_id}'=to_jsonb(NEW.publication_id::text)
    AND c.response_json->'revision'=NEW.receipt_json->'authority_revision')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Dated original native projection command and revision proof differs';END IF;
  -- Reuse only the actual independent DATED validators on actual stored rows;
  -- never call a writer or pass a recurring/ordinary proof for mapped work.
  v_checked:=public.static_weekly_assert_approved_dated_projection(v_projection.projection_envelope,
   NEW.publication_id,v_week,public.static_weekly_accepted_exception_set(NEW.publication_id,v_week));
  IF v_checked->>'source_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.receipt_json->>'source_id'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Dated independently checked original Source differs';END IF;
  PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_approved_dated_lunch(NEW.projection_id,v_lunch.document_json);
  IF public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(NEW.manager_id) IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor
   OR public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation() IS DISTINCT FROM v_generation
   OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM v_accepted_revision
   OR public.static_weekly_effective_version(v_week) IS DISTINCT FROM v_publication.version_id
   OR public.static_weekly_effective_version(v_week+6) IS DISTINCT FROM v_publication.version_id
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='40001',message='Dated original currentness changed during ledger proof';END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_list_coverall_activation_choices(p_manager uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE snapshot jsonb;day date;v_authority_revision bigint;choices jsonb;active jsonb;authority jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager);
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 day:=public.sch_service_date(statement_timestamp());snapshot:=public.static_weekly_manual_roster_snapshot(day);v_authority_revision:=(snapshot->>'authorityRevision')::bigint;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('packetId',p.packet_id,'label','Owner-approved seven-day normal schedule with source-bound CoverAll capacity',
  'serviceDate',p.service_date,'windowEnd',p.service_date+6,'expectedRevision',p.expected_revision,'activationEligible',true) ORDER BY p.packet_id),'[]') INTO choices
 FROM custodial_coverall.activation_packets p WHERE p.manager_id=p_manager AND p.service_date=day AND p.expected_revision=v_authority_revision
  AND p.roster_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(snapshot) AND jsonb_array_length(snapshot->'rosterSlots')=22
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custodial_coverall.activation_operations o WHERE o.packet_id=p.packet_id);
 SELECT to_jsonb(a) INTO authority FROM public.static_weekly_v6_schedule_authority_state(day) a;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('sourceId',v.authority_source_id,'publicationId',pub.publication_id,
  'projectionId',CASE WHEN authority->>'publication_id'=pub.publication_id::text THEN authority->'projection_id' ELSE 'null'::jsonb END,
  'authorityRevision',v_authority_revision,'projectionStatus',authority->>'projection_status','normalSourceLocked',true,
  'initialOperationId',o.operation_id,'initialProjectionId',r.receipt_json->'projectionId') INTO active
 FROM custodial_coverall.activation_operations o JOIN custodial_coverall.activation_packets p USING(packet_id)
 JOIN custodial_coverall.activation_receipts r USING(operation_id)
 JOIN public.weekly_schedule_versions v ON v.authority_source_id=p.source_id
 JOIN public.weekly_schedule_publications pub USING(version_id)
 WHERE v.version_id=public.static_weekly_effective_version(day) AND r.receipt_json->>'schema'='custodial.approved-manual-coverall-source-confirmation.v2';
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.approved-manual-activation-options.v2','serviceDate',day,'authorityRevision',v_authority_revision,'choices',choices,'active',active);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_manual_activation_initial_envelope(p_manager uuid, p_packet uuid, p_revision bigint, p_key text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare packet record;basis jsonb;body jsonb;preview text;request jsonb;
begin
 select p.source_id,p.template_id,p.service_date,p.feasibility_json->>'digest' as feasibility_digest,b.snapshot_digest
  into strict packet from public.static_weekly_manual_activation_packets p
  join public.static_weekly_approved_initial_baselines b on b.source_id=p.source_id where p.packet_id=p_packet;
 basis:=public.static_weekly_read_approved_initial_basis(p_manager,packet.source_id,packet.service_date,p_revision,packet.template_id);
 body:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.approved-static-initial-materialization.reference.v1','managerId',p_manager,
  'sourceId',packet.source_id,'effectiveStart',packet.service_date::text,'expectedRevision',p_revision,
  'generation',basis->'generation','templateCatalogDigest',basis->>'templateCatalogDigest',
  'feasibilityDigest',packet.feasibility_digest,'baselineSnapshotDigest',packet.snapshot_digest);
 -- Every original field remains bound. The full immutable baseline identity
 -- includes the initial document/projection/lunch as well as the feasibility
 -- body; the normal publisher rehashes and checks the same admitted snapshot.
 preview:=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(body);
 request:=jsonb_build_object('sourceId',packet.source_id,'effectiveStart',packet.service_date::text,'templateId',packet.template_id,
  'expectedRevision',p_revision,'previewDigest',preview,'idempotencyKey',p_key);
 return body||jsonb_build_object('previewDigest',preview,'request',request);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_manual_native_lunch_policy(p_envelope jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare body jsonb;loans jsonb;
begin
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(l order by (l->>'dayOfWeek')::integer,l->>'normalOwnerSlotId'),'[]') into loans from(
  select l from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,compilerInput,version,lunchCoveragePolicy,loans}') l
   where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,datedDayBases}') d where extract(dow from (d->>'serviceDate')::date)::integer=(l->>'dayOfWeek')::integer)
  union all
  select jsonb_build_object('dayOfWeek',extract(dow from (d->>'serviceDate')::date)::integer,'normalOwnerSlotId',l->'recipientSlotId','window',l->'window',
   'areas',(select case when jsonb_typeof(l->'areas')='array' then coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('locationCode',c,'covererSlotId',l->'covererSlotId') order by c),'[]'::jsonb) end from jsonb_array_elements_text(l->'areas') c))
   from jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope#>'{authority,datedDayBases}') d cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case when d->>'kind'='COVERALL' then d#>'{overlay,lunchPlans}' else d#>'{plan,lunchPlans}' end) l
 ) q;
 body:=jsonb_build_object('schema','memphis-zoo.static-weekly-full-hour-lunch-policy.v1','sourceDigest',p_envelope#>'{authority,sourceDigest}','loans',loans);
 return body||jsonb_build_object('policyDigest',public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(body));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_manual_recurring_roster_unavailable(p_source jsonb, p_frame date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('serviceDate',d::date::text,'slotId',s->'id','employeeId',i->'personId') ORDER BY d,s->>'id'),'[]')
 FROM generate_series(p_frame,p_frame+6,'1 day') days(d)
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p_source->'slots') slots(s)
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s->'incumbencies') inc(i)
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p_source#>'{version,slotAvailability}') av(a)
  ON a->'slotId'=s->'id' AND (a->>'dayOfWeek')::integer=extract(dow FROM d)::integer AND a->>'status'='working'
 WHERE (i->>'effectiveStart')::date<=d::date AND (i->>'effectiveEnd' IS NULL OR d::date<(i->>'effectiveEnd')::date)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.v_weekly_roster_slot_incumbency_ranges r JOIN public.employees e ON e.id=r.person_id
   WHERE r.slot_id=(s->>'id')::uuid AND r.person_id=(i->>'personId')::uuid AND r.effective_start<=d::date
    AND (r.effective_end IS NULL OR d::date<r.effective_end) AND e.active)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_manual_roster_snapshot(p_date date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare parent jsonb;roster jsonb;people jsonb;revision bigint;
begin
 if p_date is distinct from public.sch_service_date(statement_timestamp()) then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='manual activation uses the current operational date';end if;
 select c.current_revision into strict revision from public.static_weekly_schedule_control c where c.singleton;
 select jsonb_build_object('publicationId',p.publication_id,'versionId',p.version_id,
  'sourceId',v.authority_source_id,'effectiveStart',p.effective_start::text) into parent
 from public.weekly_schedule_publications p join public.weekly_schedule_versions v using(version_id)
 where v.version_id=public.static_weekly_effective_version(p_date);
 if parent is null or parent->>'sourceId' is null then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='manual activation must retain an exact existing publication and source';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slotId',s.slot_id,'slotCode',s.slot_code,'label',s.slot_label,
  'incumbencies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('incumbencyId',r.incumbency_id,
   'personId',r.person_id,'displayName',r.person_name_snapshot,'effectiveStart',r.effective_start::text,
   'effectiveEnd',case when r.effective_end is null then null else r.effective_end::text end)
   order by r.effective_start,r.incumbency_id) from public.v_weekly_roster_slot_incumbency_ranges r
   where r.slot_id=s.slot_id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by s.slot_id),'[]'::jsonb) into roster
 from public.weekly_roster_slots s;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('employeeId',e.id,'displayName',e.display_name,
  'employeeCode',e.employee_code,'active',e.active,'hasMessenger',exists(select 1 from public.msg_users m where m.employee_id=e.id and m.is_active=true and coalesce(m.active,m.is_active)=true))
  order by e.id),'[]'::jsonb) into people from public.employees e where e.id=any(array[
   'cd97111e-cfa0-4228-b4d7-401bc7a5ac13','3da709bb-2223-4e15-8e3a-db02e3f32e97',
   '30ec85e0-a579-45a8-9c27-c164e77a9190','77d50e9a-6338-43b1-aed5-9f47d7129466',
   '8067cca2-7487-4589-ba7c-aa442e135045','d5fecc86-659b-464a-bc99-f0d914385db4',
   '06228c5d-5123-4b8b-b730-e01114bdc971','1318b295-fd70-4e78-8828-62c29302f96f']::uuid[]);
 return jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.manual-live-roster-readback.v1','serviceDate',p_date::text,
  'authorityRevision',revision,'parentPublication',parent,'rosterSlots',roster,'employees',people);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_manual_store_initial_baseline(p_source_id uuid, p_template_id text, p_feasibility jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare source jsonb;entry public.static_weekly_approved_template_catalog%rowtype;prior public.static_weekly_approved_initial_baselines%rowtype;date date;
begin

 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 select * into strict entry from public.static_weekly_approved_template_catalog where template_id=p_template_id;
 if exists(select 1 from public.static_weekly_approved_template_retirements where template_id=p_template_id)
  or entry.catalog_entry_digest<>public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(jsonb_build_object('template',entry.template_json,
    'binding',entry.binding_json,'ownerConfig',entry.owner_config,'approvalEvidence',entry.approval_evidence)) then
  raise exception 'initial baseline requires a live release-admitted approved pattern';end if;
 date:=(p_feasibility#>>'{mapping,serviceDate}')::date;
 select public.static_weekly_v4_hydrate_compiler_source(s.canonical_source,date) into strict source
  from public.static_weekly_authority_source_documents s where s.source_id=p_source_id and s.active and s.retired_at is null
   and s.source_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(s.canonical_source);
 if p_feasibility->>'schema' is distinct from 'custodial.approved-static-feasibility.v1'
  or p_feasibility->'solverInvoked' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb or p_feasibility->'optimized' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
  or p_feasibility#>>'{mapping,templateId}' is distinct from p_template_id
  or p_feasibility#>>'{mapping,templateDigest}' is distinct from entry.binding_json->>'sourceDigest'
  or p_feasibility#>'{mapping,unchanged}' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
  or p_feasibility#>'{mapping,scopeDays}' is distinct from '[0,1,2,3,4,5,6]'::jsonb
  or p_feasibility->>'publicationAuthority' is distinct from 'NOT_PUBLISHED'
  or p_feasibility->'candidateSource' is distinct from source
  or source->>'serviceDate' is distinct from date::text or source#>>'{version,effectiveStart}' is distinct from date::text
  or source->'exceptions' is distinct from '[]'::jsonb
  or p_feasibility->>'currentSourceDigest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(source)
  or p_feasibility->>'digest' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_feasibility-array['digest','initialBaseline'])
  or p_feasibility#>>'{initialBaseline,schema}' is distinct from 'custodial.approved-static-initial-baseline.v1'
  or p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document,assignments}' is distinct from p_feasibility->'baselineAssignments'
  or p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document,slot_availability}' is distinct from p_feasibility->'slotAvailability'
  or p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,projection,assignments}' is distinct from p_feasibility->'projectionAssignments'
  or p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,lunchDocument}' is distinct from p_feasibility->'lunchDocument'
  or p_feasibility#>>'{lunch,status}' is distinct from 'PLANNED'
  or p_feasibility#>>'{initialBaseline,document,receipt,independentDerivations}' is distinct from '2'
  or p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document,authority,optimizerResult}' is not null
  or p_feasibility#>>'{initialBaseline,document,authority,schema}' is distinct from 'custodial.approved-static-authority.v1'
  or p_feasibility#>>'{initialBaseline,projection,authority_digest}' is distinct from public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document,authority}')
  or p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,projection,authority}' is distinct from p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document,authority}' then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='exact independently validated fixed initial source/document/projection/lunch required';end if;
 -- Retain the existing independently implemented SQL derivation checker.
 if p_feasibility->'shiftEndDerivation'<>'null'::jsonb then
  perform public.static_weekly_v9_assert_shift_end_derivation(p_feasibility#>'{initialBaseline,document,authority}');
 end if;
 if public.static_weekly_v3_source_identity(source) is distinct from public.static_weekly_v3_source_identity(entry.template_json->'source') then
  raise exception 'initial baseline cannot change approved recurring geometry';end if;
 select * into prior from public.static_weekly_approved_initial_baselines where source_id=p_source_id;
 if found then
  if prior.feasibility is distinct from p_feasibility or prior.template_id is distinct from p_template_id then
   raise exception using errcode='23505',message='initial baseline source already binds different immutable evidence';end if;
 else
  insert into public.static_weekly_approved_initial_baselines(source_id,template_id,effective_start,feasibility,snapshot_digest)
   values(p_source_id,p_template_id,date,p_feasibility,public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_feasibility));
 end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('registered',true,'sourceId',p_source_id,'snapshotDigest',public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_feasibility),'published',false);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_materialize_approved_template(p_manager_id uuid, p_source_publication_id uuid, p_date date, p_kind text, p_revision bigint, p_generation bigint, p_key text, p_preview_digest text, p_envelope jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor jsonb;basis jsonb;prior public.static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations%rowtype;checked jsonb;
 feasibility jsonb:=p_envelope->'feasibility';material jsonb;document jsonb;projection jsonb;provenance jsonb;
 draft jsonb;published jsonb;materialized jsonb;lunch jsonb;receipt jsonb;v_version_id uuid;v_publication_id uuid;v_projection_id uuid;revision bigint;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();PERFORM public.custodial_begin_application_mutation();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 actor:=public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager_id);
 -- BEGIN DATED_ORIGINAL_CONFIRMATION_DISPATCH
 IF p_kind='DATED_ABSENCE' THEN
  -- Same owner, restore fence and authority queue as the unchanged recurring
  -- path. The private writer validates the selected dated Source independently;
  -- no recurring draft/publication or caller receipt is used for this branch.
  PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_envelope,
   ARRAY['schema','managerId','sourcePublicationId','serviceDate','kind','expectedRevision','generation','templateCatalogDigest','templateInputsDigest','feasibility','previewDigest','request'],
   ARRAY['schema','managerId','sourcePublicationId','serviceDate','kind','expectedRevision','generation','templateCatalogDigest','templateInputsDigest','feasibility','previewDigest','request'],'approved dated materialization');
  PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_envelope->'request',
   ARRAY['publicationId','serviceDate','kind','templateId','expectedRevision','previewDigest','idempotencyKey'],
   ARRAY['publicationId','serviceDate','kind','templateId','expectedRevision','previewDigest','idempotencyKey'],'approved dated original request');
  IF p_source_publication_id IS NULL OR p_date IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_date)
   OR p_revision IS NULL OR p_revision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
   OR p_generation IS NULL OR p_generation NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
   OR p_key IS NULL OR length(p_key)<>36 OR p_key!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
   OR p_key IS DISTINCT FROM (p_key::uuid)::text
   OR p_preview_digest IS NULL OR length(p_preview_digest)<>64 OR p_preview_digest!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR p_envelope->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-materialization.v1'
   OR p_envelope->'managerId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_manager_id::text)
   OR p_envelope->'sourcePublicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_source_publication_id::text)
   OR p_envelope->'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_date::text)
   OR p_envelope->'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_kind)
   OR p_envelope->'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_revision)
   OR p_envelope->'generation' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_generation)
   OR p_envelope->'previewDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_preview_digest)
   OR p_preview_digest IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_envelope-'request'-'previewDigest')
   OR p_envelope#>'{request,publicationId}' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_source_publication_id::text)
   OR p_envelope->'request' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
    'publicationId',p_source_publication_id,'serviceDate',p_date,'kind',p_kind,
    'templateId',p_envelope#>'{request,templateId}','expectedRevision',p_revision,
    'previewDigest',p_preview_digest,'idempotencyKey',p_key)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='Dated exact original scalar envelope request and preview required';END IF;
  -- A null original template selector means automatic selection, not permission to
  -- replace it with the chosen template in the immutable original request.
  IF p_envelope#>'{request,templateId}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb AND
   (jsonb_typeof(p_envelope#>'{request,templateId}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR length(p_envelope#>>'{request,templateId}') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128
    OR p_envelope#>>'{request,templateId}' IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_envelope#>>'{request,templateId}'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='Dated original template selector differs';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations
   WHERE manager_id=p_manager_id AND idempotency_key=p_key;
  IF FOUND THEN
   IF prior.request_json IS DISTINCT FROM p_envelope->'request'
    OR prior.source_publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_publication_id
    OR prior.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_publication_id
    OR prior.receipt_json->'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM '"custodial.approved-static-confirmation.v1"'::jsonb
    OR prior.receipt_json->'status' IS DISTINCT FROM '"PERSISTED_CURRENT"'::jsonb
    OR prior.receipt_json->'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
    OR prior.receipt_json->'persistence_status' IS DISTINCT FROM '"PERSISTED"'::jsonb
    OR prior.receipt_json->'solverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR prior.receipt_json->'publication_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(prior.publication_id::text)
    OR prior.receipt_json->'projection_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(prior.projection_id::text)
    OR p_preview_digest IS DISTINCT FROM prior.receipt_json->>'previewDigest'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23505',message='Original dated confirmation identity conflict';END IF;
   -- Historical exact receipt, not a fresh currentness assertion. No basis
   -- reread, materialization, new identifier or write on original replay.
   RETURN prior.receipt_json;
  END IF;
  basis:=public.static_weekly_read_approved_template_basis(p_manager_id,p_source_publication_id,p_date,
   p_kind,p_envelope#>>'{request,templateId}',p_revision);
  IF basis->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-template-basis.v1'
   OR basis->'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_source_publication_id::text)
   OR basis->'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_date::text) OR basis->'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_kind)
   OR basis->'authorityRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_revision)
   OR basis->'generation' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_generation)
   OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM p_revision
   OR p_generation IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation()
   OR public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager_id) IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR p_envelope->'templateCatalogDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM basis->'templateCatalogDigest'
   OR p_envelope->'templateInputsDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM basis->'templateInputsDigest'
   OR jsonb_typeof(feasibility) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR feasibility->>'currentSourceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(basis->'currentSource')
   OR jsonb_typeof(feasibility#>'{mapping,templateId}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR (p_envelope#>'{request,templateId}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    AND p_envelope#>'{request,templateId}' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility#>'{mapping,templateId}')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(basis->'templates') t
    WHERE t->'templateId'=feasibility#>'{mapping,templateId}')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='40001',message='Dated original current actor Source basis revision generation or selected template differs';END IF;
  receipt:=public.static_weekly_approved_dated_materialize_projection(
   p_manager_id,p_source_publication_id,p_date,feasibility#>>'{mapping,templateId}',
   p_revision,p_generation,p_preview_digest,feasibility);
  -- Keep the actual private receipt byte-for-value as jsonb. No receipt
  -- synthesis, acceptance fallback or conversion to a new publication.
  PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(receipt,
   ARRAY['schema','status','ok','persistence_status','source_id','publication_id','projection_id','authority_revision','revision','feasibility_digest','lunch_document_identity','previewDigest','solverInvoked'],
   ARRAY['schema','status','ok','persistence_status','source_id','publication_id','projection_id','authority_revision','revision','feasibility_digest','lunch_document_identity','previewDigest','solverInvoked'],'approved dated actual receipt');
  IF receipt->'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM '"custodial.approved-static-confirmation.v1"'::jsonb
   OR receipt->'status' IS DISTINCT FROM '"PERSISTED_CURRENT"'::jsonb
   OR receipt->'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR receipt->'persistence_status' IS DISTINCT FROM '"PERSISTED"'::jsonb
   OR receipt->'solverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
   OR receipt->'publication_id' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_source_publication_id::text)
   OR receipt->'previewDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_preview_digest)
   OR receipt->>'feasibility_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->>'digest'
   OR jsonb_typeof(receipt->'authority_revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR coalesce(receipt->>'authority_revision','')!~'^[1-9][0-9]*$'
   OR (receipt->>'authority_revision')::numeric NOT BETWEEN p_revision+1 AND 9007199254740991
   OR receipt->'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM receipt->'authority_revision'
   OR jsonb_typeof(receipt->'projection_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR length(receipt->>'projection_id')<>36 OR receipt->>'projection_id'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(receipt->'source_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR length(receipt->>'source_id')<>36 OR receipt->>'source_id'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(receipt->'lunch_document_identity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR length(receipt->>'lunch_document_identity')<>64 OR receipt->>'lunch_document_identity'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Dated actual private materialization receipt differs';END IF;
  v_projection_id:=(receipt->>'projection_id')::uuid;revision:=(receipt->>'authority_revision')::bigint;
  IF public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager_id) IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM revision
   OR p_generation IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation()
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications p
    JOIN public.weekly_schedule_versions v USING(version_id)
    JOIN public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections x ON x.publication_id=p.publication_id AND x.version_id=v.version_id
    JOIN public.weekly_schedule_lunch_documents l ON l.projection_id=x.projection_id
    WHERE p.publication_id=p_source_publication_id AND x.projection_id=v_projection_id
     AND v.authority_source_id::text=receipt->>'source_id'
     AND x.week_start=p_date-(extract(isodow FROM p_date)::integer-1) AND x.week_end=x.week_start+6
     AND x.compiled_by_manager_id=p_manager_id AND l.accepted_by_manager_id=p_manager_id
     AND x.projection_envelope=feasibility#>'{datedAbsence,projection}'
     AND l.document_json=feasibility#>'{datedAbsence,lunchDocument}'
     AND l.document_identity=receipt->>'lunch_document_identity')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='40001',message='Dated actual original publication projection lunch or currentness differs';END IF;
  -- No exception handler or bypass: the kind-specific native ledger guard
  -- and original manager/key/projection uniqueness remain authoritative.
  INSERT INTO public.static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations(manager_id,idempotency_key,request_json,receipt_json,source_publication_id,publication_id,projection_id)
   VALUES(p_manager_id,p_key,p_envelope->'request',receipt,p_source_publication_id,p_source_publication_id,v_projection_id);
  SELECT * INTO STRICT prior FROM public.static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations
   WHERE manager_id=p_manager_id AND idempotency_key=p_key;
  IF prior.request_json IS DISTINCT FROM p_envelope->'request' OR prior.receipt_json IS DISTINCT FROM receipt
   OR prior.source_publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_publication_id OR prior.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_publication_id
   OR prior.projection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_projection_id
   OR public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager_id) IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM revision
   OR p_generation IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation()
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='40001',message='Dated immutable original confirmation readback differs';END IF;
  RETURN receipt;
 END IF;
 -- END DATED_ORIGINAL_CONFIRMATION_DISPATCH
 IF p_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'RECURRING_STAFFING' OR p_key IS NULL OR length(p_key)<>36
  OR p_key !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR p_key IS DISTINCT FROM (p_key::uuid)::text THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='Exact recurring original UUID key required; DATED_ABSENCE unsupported';END IF;
 IF p_date IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_date) OR extract(isodow FROM p_date)<>1
  OR p_envelope->'managerId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_manager_id::text)
  OR p_envelope->'sourcePublicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_source_publication_id::text)
  OR p_envelope->'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_date::text)
  OR p_envelope->'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_kind)
  OR p_envelope->'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_revision)
  OR p_envelope->'generation' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_generation) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring exact original scalar arguments differ';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations WHERE manager_id=p_manager_id AND idempotency_key=p_key;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF prior.request_json IS DISTINCT FROM p_envelope->'request' OR prior.source_publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_publication_id
   OR p_preview_digest IS DISTINCT FROM prior.receipt_json->>'previewDigest'
   OR p_envelope->>'previewDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_preview_digest
   OR p_preview_digest IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_envelope-'request'-'previewDigest') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23505',message='Original recurring confirmation identity conflict';END IF;
  RETURN prior.receipt_json;END IF;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_envelope,
  ARRAY['schema','managerId','sourcePublicationId','serviceDate','kind','expectedRevision','generation','templateCatalogDigest','templateInputsDigest','feasibility','previewDigest','request'],
  ARRAY['schema','managerId','sourcePublicationId','serviceDate','kind','expectedRevision','generation','templateCatalogDigest','templateInputsDigest','feasibility','previewDigest','request'],'approved recurring materialization');
 basis:=public.static_weekly_read_approved_template_basis(p_manager_id,p_source_publication_id,p_date,p_kind,p_envelope#>>'{request,templateId}',p_revision);
 IF p_revision IS NULL OR p_revision<0 OR p_revision>9007199254740991 OR p_generation IS NULL OR p_generation<0 OR p_generation>9007199254740991
  OR p_generation IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_v15_read_recurring_generation()
  OR p_envelope->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-materialization.v1'
  OR p_envelope->'managerId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_manager_id::text)
  OR p_envelope->'sourcePublicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_source_publication_id::text)
  OR p_envelope->'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_date::text) OR p_envelope->'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_kind)
  OR p_envelope->'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_revision) OR p_envelope->'generation' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_generation)
  OR p_envelope->'templateCatalogDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM basis->'templateCatalogDigest'
  OR p_envelope->'templateInputsDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM basis->'templateInputsDigest'
  OR p_preview_digest IS NULL OR length(p_preview_digest)<>64 OR p_preview_digest !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR p_envelope->'previewDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_preview_digest)
  OR p_preview_digest IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(p_envelope-'request'-'previewDigest')
  OR p_envelope->'request' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('publicationId',NULL,'serviceDate',p_date,'kind',p_kind,
   'templateId',p_envelope#>'{request,templateId}','expectedRevision',p_revision,'previewDigest',p_preview_digest,'idempotencyKey',p_key)
  OR basis#>'{currentSource,exceptions}' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
  OR (feasibility->'candidateSource')-'version' IS DISTINCT FROM (basis->'currentSource')-'version'
  OR (feasibility#>'{candidateSource,version}')-'assignments' IS DISTINCT FROM (basis#>'{currentSource,version}')-'assignments'
  OR feasibility->>'currentSourceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(basis->'currentSource')
  OR feasibility->>'digest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(feasibility-'digest'-'recurringStaffing')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(basis->'templates') t WHERE t->>'templateId'=feasibility#>>'{mapping,templateId}') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23514',message='Recurring original current actor source basis revision generation request and preview differ';END IF;
 material:=feasibility->'recurringStaffing';document:=material->'document';projection:=material->'projection';
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(material,ARRAY['schema','document','projection','objective','lunchDocument'],
  ARRAY['schema','document','projection','objective','lunchDocument'],'approved recurring typed materialization');
 checked:=public.static_weekly_assert_approved_recurring_document(document,p_date,true);
 IF document#>'{authority,compilerInput}' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->'candidateSource' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring candidate Source differs from independently checked document';END IF;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(feasibility,
  ARRAY['schema','contract','mapping','sourceDigest','currentSourceDigest','candidateSource','assignments','projectionAssignments','lunchDocument','baseAuthorityDigest','baseReplayDigest','compilerInput','overlayCompilerInput','baselineAssignments','slotAvailability','projectionAvailability','shiftEndDerivation','derivedBaselineDigest','baselineInputDigest','inputDigest','basisDigest','hardConstraintDigest','hardConstraintCount','witnessDigest','lunch','solverInvoked','optimized','publicationAuthority','digest','recurringStaffing'],
  ARRAY['schema','contract','mapping','sourceDigest','currentSourceDigest','candidateSource','assignments','projectionAssignments','lunchDocument','baseAuthorityDigest','baseReplayDigest','compilerInput','overlayCompilerInput','baselineAssignments','slotAvailability','projectionAvailability','shiftEndDerivation','derivedBaselineDigest','baselineInputDigest','inputDigest','basisDigest','hardConstraintDigest','hardConstraintCount','witnessDigest','lunch','solverInvoked','optimized','publicationAuthority','digest','recurringStaffing'],'approved recurring feasibility');
 IF material->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-recurring-staffing.v1'
  OR feasibility->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.approved-static-feasibility.v1'
  OR feasibility->>'contract' IS DISTINCT FROM 'FIXED_APPROVED_PATTERN_COMPLETE_HARD_CONSTRAINTS_NOT_OPTIMALITY'
  OR feasibility->'solverInvoked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR feasibility->'optimized' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR feasibility->>'publicationAuthority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_PUBLISHED'
  OR document->'assignments' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->'baselineAssignments'
  OR document->'slot_availability' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->'slotAvailability'
  OR projection->'assignments' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->'projectionAssignments'
  OR material->'objective' IS DISTINCT FROM document->'objective'
  OR material->'lunchDocument' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->'lunchDocument'
  OR feasibility->'mapping' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,mapping}'
  OR feasibility->'compilerInput' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,compilerInput}'
  OR feasibility->'overlayCompilerInput' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,overlayCompilerInput}'
  OR feasibility->'projectionAvailability' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,projectionAvailability}'
  OR feasibility->'shiftEndDerivation' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,shiftEndDerivation}'
  OR feasibility->'baseAuthorityDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{validation,authority_digest}'
  OR feasibility->'inputDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,inputDigest}'
  OR feasibility->'baselineInputDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,baselineInputDigest}'
  OR feasibility->'derivedBaselineDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,derivedBaselineDigest}'
  OR feasibility->'basisDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,basisDigest}'
  OR feasibility->'witnessDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{authority,witnessDigest}'
  OR feasibility->>'baseReplayDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(jsonb_build_object(
   'projectionAssignments',feasibility->'projectionAssignments','lunch',feasibility->'lunch'))
  OR feasibility->'baseReplayDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM document#>'{validation,replay_digest}'
  OR feasibility->'baseReplayDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM material#>'{lunchDocument,base_replay_digest}'
  OR feasibility->'baseAuthorityDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM material#>'{lunchDocument,base_authority_digest}'
  OR projection->'semantic_snapshot' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.approved-static-projection-snapshot.v1',
   'sourceDigest',public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(basis->'currentSource'),'feasibilityDigest',feasibility->>'digest')
  OR document#>>'{receipt,feasibilityDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->>'digest'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(basis->'templates') t WHERE t->'staffingCount'=checked->'staffing_count')<>1
  OR feasibility->'hardConstraintCount' IS DISTINCT FROM checked->'hard_constraint_count'
  OR document#>'{receipt,hardConstraintDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM feasibility->'hardConstraintDigest'
  OR jsonb_typeof(feasibility->'hardConstraintDigest') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR length(feasibility->>'hardConstraintDigest')<>64 OR feasibility->>'hardConstraintDigest' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR document#>'{receipt,solverInvoked}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR document#>'{receipt,optimized}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR document#>'{receipt,hardConstraintCount}' IS DISTINCT FROM checked->'hard_constraint_count' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring independently derived typed materialization differs';END IF;
 provenance:=jsonb_build_object('adapter_schema',document#>>'{adapter,schema}','compiler_version',document#>>'{validation,compiler_version}',
  'input_digest',document#>>'{validation,input_digest}','baseline_input_digest',document#>>'{validation,baseline_input_digest}',
  'authority_digest',document#>>'{validation,authority_digest}','replay_digest',document#>>'{validation,replay_digest}');
 draft:=public.static_weekly_approved_recurring_create_draft(p_date,projection->>'compiler_version',projection->'objective',provenance,
  document,p_revision,p_manager_id,actor->>'manager_name',p_key||':draft');
 v_version_id:=(draft#>>'{data,version_id}')::uuid;revision:=(draft->>'revision')::bigint;
 PERFORM set_config('app.static_weekly_source_bind','on',true);
 UPDATE public.weekly_schedule_versions v SET authority_source_id=(checked->>'source_id')::uuid WHERE v.version_id=v_version_id AND v.authority_source_id IS NULL;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_versions v WHERE v.version_id=v_version_id
  AND v.authority_source_id=(checked->>'source_id')::uuid AND v.draft_document=document) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring relational version original source binding differs';END IF;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_draft_incumbency(v_version_id);
 published:=public.static_weekly_approved_recurring_publish_draft(v_version_id,(draft#>>'{data,draft_revision}')::bigint,revision,
  p_manager_id,actor->>'manager_name',p_key||':publish','supersede',NULL);
 v_publication_id:=(published#>>'{data,publication_id}')::uuid;revision:=(published->>'revision')::bigint;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_publications p JOIN public.weekly_schedule_publications original
  ON original.version_id=p.prior_version_id WHERE p.publication_id=v_publication_id AND original.publication_id=p_source_publication_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring new publication original current lineage differs';END IF;
 materialized:=public.static_weekly_approved_recurring_materialize_projection(v_publication_id,p_date,public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb('[]'::jsonb),
  projection->>'compiler_version',projection->'objective',projection->'metrics',projection->>'replay_digest',projection,revision,
  p_manager_id,actor->>'manager_name',p_key||':projection');
 v_projection_id:=(materialized#>>'{data,projection_id}')::uuid;revision:=(materialized->>'revision')::bigint;
 lunch:=public.static_weekly_v8_materialize_lunch_document(v_projection_id,material->'lunchDocument',p_manager_id);
 IF lunch->>'persistence_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PERSISTED' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recurring exact lunch not persisted';END IF;
 receipt:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.approved-static-confirmation.v1','status','PERSISTED_CURRENT','ok',true,'persistence_status','PERSISTED',
  'publication_id',v_publication_id,'projection_id',v_projection_id,'authority_revision',revision,'revision',revision,
  'feasibility_digest',feasibility->>'digest','lunch_document_identity',lunch->>'document_identity','previewDigest',p_preview_digest,'solverInvoked',false);
 INSERT INTO public.static_weekly_approved_template_confirmations(manager_id,idempotency_key,request_json,receipt_json,source_publication_id,publication_id,projection_id)
  VALUES(p_manager_id,p_key,p_envelope->'request',receipt,p_source_publication_id,v_publication_id,v_projection_id);
 RETURN receipt;
END $function$

functions.identity_arguments: p_version_id uuid, p_document jsonb, p_content_digest text, p_actor_manager_id uuid, p_actor_manager_name text
p_reference jsonb, p_reference_digest text, p_credential uuid, p_device text, p_access text

functions.definition:

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_pending_assert_payload(p_operation uuid, p_manager uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE ctx jsonb;result jsonb;week date;publication uuid;
BEGIN
 ctx:=public.static_weekly_pending_context(p_operation,p_manager);
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_assert_exact_object(p_payload,
  ARRAY['actorManagerId','actorManagerName','compilerVersion','envelope','exceptionSetDigest','expectedRevision','idempotencyKey','metrics','objective','publicationId','replayDigest','serviceDate'],
  ARRAY['actorManagerId','actorManagerName','compilerVersion','envelope','exceptionSetDigest','expectedRevision','idempotencyKey','metrics','objective','publicationId','replayDigest','serviceDate'],'pending twelve-field transport');
 week:=(p_payload->>'serviceDate')::date;publication:=(p_payload->>'publicationId')::uuid;
 IF p_payload->>'actorManagerId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_manager::text OR p_payload->>'actorManagerName' IS DISTINCT FROM ctx#>>'{actor,manager_name}'
  OR p_payload->'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM ctx#>'{originalCommand,expectedRevision}'
  OR p_payload->>'idempotencyKey' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staffing:'||p_operation::text||':'||week::text
  OR p_payload->>'serviceDate' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload#>>'{envelope,week_start}'
  OR p_payload->>'publicationId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload#>>'{envelope,semantic_snapshot,originalSource,publication_id}'
  OR p_payload->>'compilerVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload#>>'{envelope,compiler_version}'
  OR p_payload->'objective' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload#>'{envelope,objective}'
  OR p_payload->'metrics' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload#>'{envelope,metrics}'
  OR p_payload->>'replayDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload#>>'{envelope,replay_digest}'
  OR p_payload->>'exceptionSetDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(public.static_weekly_pending_summary(p_operation,publication,week,NULL))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pending transport original identity differs';END IF;
 result:=public.static_weekly_pending_assert_projection(p_operation,p_manager,p_payload->'envelope');
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_v10_list_pending_staffing_commands(p_manager_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_after_created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_after_operation_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare rows jsonb;
begin
 perform public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();perform public.static_weekly_v3_manager_actor(p_manager_id);
 if p_limit not between 1 and 100 or ((p_after_created_at is null)<>(p_after_operation_id is null)) then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='invalid staffing command page'; end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('operation_id',c.operation_id,'state',c.state,
  'semantic_body',c.semantic_body,'semantic_digest',c.semantic_digest,'expected_revision',c.expected_revision,
  'prepared_by_manager_id',c.prepared_by_manager_id,'preview_digest',c.preview_digest,
  'candidate_summary',c.candidate_summary,'created_at',c.created_at,'prepared_at',c.prepared_at)
  order by c.created_at,c.operation_id),'[]'::jsonb) into rows
 from (select * from public.static_weekly_staffing_commands c
  where c.state in ('PREPARING','PREPARED') and (p_after_created_at is null or (c.created_at,c.operation_id)>(p_after_created_at,p_after_operation_id))
  order by c.created_at,c.operation_id limit p_limit) c;
 return jsonb_build_object('commands',rows,'limit',p_limit);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_v10_read_device_schedule_application(p_service_date date, p_device_id uuid, p_credential_id uuid, p_employee_id uuid, p_assignment_epoch bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare target public.static_weekly_schedule_application_intents%rowtype;receipt public.static_weekly_schedule_application_receipts%rowtype;
begin
 if p_service_date is null or p_device_id is null or p_credential_id is null or p_employee_id is null
  or p_assignment_epoch is null or p_assignment_epoch<1 then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='complete schedule application principal is required';end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from public.devices d where d.id=p_device_id and d.active=true
   and d.assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id and d.assignment_epoch=p_assignment_epoch)
  or not exists(select 1 from public.device_auth_credentials c where c.credential_id=p_credential_id
   and c.device_id=p_device_id and c.confirmed_at is not null and c.revoked_at is null
   and c.expires_at>statement_timestamp()) then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='current schedule application principal is required';end if;
 select * into target from public.static_weekly_schedule_application_intents i
  where i.service_date=p_service_date and i.device_id=p_device_id and i.credential_id=p_credential_id
   and i.employee_id=p_employee_id and i.assignment_epoch=p_assignment_epoch
  order by i.authority_revision desc,i.created_at desc,i.intent_id desc limit 1;
 if not found then return null;end if;
 select * into receipt from public.static_weekly_schedule_application_receipts r where r.intent_id=target.intent_id;
 return jsonb_build_object('intent_id',target.intent_id,'operation_id',target.operation_id,
  'service_date',target.service_date,'employee_id',target.employee_id,'device_id',target.device_id,
  'credential_id',target.credential_id,'assignment_epoch',target.assignment_epoch,
  'authority_revision',target.authority_revision,'publication_id',target.publication_id,
  'projection_id',target.projection_id,'lunch_document_identity',target.lunch_document_identity,
  'application_status',case when receipt.receipt_id is null then 'PENDING' else 'DEVICE_REPORTED_APPLIED' end,
  'rendered_digest',receipt.rendered_digest,'applied_at',receipt.applied_at,'received_at',receipt.received_at);
end $function$

   'intent_id',i.intent_id,'service_date',i.service_date,'employee_id',i.employee_id,'device_id',i.device_id,
   'credential_id',i.credential_id,'assignment_epoch',i.assignment_epoch,'authority_revision',i.authority_revision,
   'projection_id',i.projection_id,'lunch_document_identity',i.lunch_document_identity,
   'status',case when r.receipt_id is null then 'PENDING' else 'DEVICE_REPORTED_APPLIED' end,
   'rendered_digest',r.rendered_digest,'applied_at',r.applied_at,'received_at',r.received_at) item
  from public.static_weekly_schedule_application_intents i
  left join public.static_weekly_schedule_application_receipts r on r.intent_id=i.intent_id
  where i.operation_id=p_operation_id
  union all
  select missing||jsonb_build_object('intent_id',null,'device_id',null,'credential_id',null,
   'assignment_epoch',null,'authority_revision',command.accepted_revision,'projection_id',null,
   'lunch_document_identity',null,'rendered_digest',null,'applied_at',null,'received_at',null)
  from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(command.accepted_receipt->'missing_device_targets','[]'::jsonb)) missing
 ) status_rows;
 return jsonb_build_object('operation_id',command.operation_id,'state',command.state,
  'authority_revision',command.accepted_revision,'targets',targets);
end $function$
