CREATE FUNCTION public.custodial_native_schedule_window_source_at(
 p_source_key uuid,p_employee_id uuid,p_generation_id uuid,p_at timestamptz
) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path=pg_catalog,public,extensions AS $fn$
DECLARE
 target jsonb;day date;projection uuid;publication uuid;version uuid;availability jsonb;matches integer;
 segments jsonb;physical jsonb;loans jsonb;analysis jsonb;before_units jsonb;after_units jsonb;
 cut time;shift_end time;start_at timestamptz;end_at timestamptz;credential_end timestamptz;
 name text;source_document jsonb;source_digest text;window_data jsonb;v_status text;
BEGIN
 IF p_source_key IS NULL OR p_employee_id IS NULL OR p_generation_id IS NULL OR p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact native SCHEDULE source and server time required' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 target:=public.custodial_native_target_source_at('SCHEDULE',p_source_key,p_employee_id,p_generation_id,p_at);
 IF target->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SOURCE_ONLY_POLICY_MISSING' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status',target->>'status',
   'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',null);END IF;
 day:=(target#>>'{source,service_date}')::date;projection:=(target#>>'{source,source_id}')::uuid;
 publication:=(target#>>'{source,publication_id}')::uuid;version:=(target#>>'{source,version_id}')::uuid;
 SELECT count(*),min(value::text)::jsonb INTO matches,availability
  FROM public.weekly_schedule_compiled_projections p,
   jsonb_array_elements(p.projection_envelope#>'{authority,projectionAvailability}') value
  WHERE p.projection_id=projection AND value->>'serviceDate'=day::text
   AND value->>'incumbentPersonId'=p_employee_id::text AND value->>'status'='working';
 IF matches<>1 OR availability#>>'{shift,start}' IS NULL OR availability#>>'{shift,end}' IS NULL
  OR (availability#>>'{shift,start}')::time>time '09:45'
  OR (availability#>>'{shift,end}')::time<=time '09:45' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact working SCHEDULE recipient availability required' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 name:=availability->>'incumbentName';shift_end:=(availability#>>'{shift,end}')::time;
 IF name IS NULL OR btrim(name)='' OR octet_length(name)>180 OR name~'[[:cntrl:]]' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted SCHEDULE recipient name unsupported' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 -- Trusted canonical readers, not a caller-supplied DTO or SQL expression.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY segment_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO segments FROM (
  SELECT service_date,projection_status,version_id,publication_id,projection_id,segment_id,location_group_id,
   included_location_ids,owner_type,assigned_employee_id,coverage_start,coverage_end,status,source_type,service_mode,governed
  FROM public.static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(day)) r;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY occurrence_id,location_id,coverage_start),'[]'::jsonb) INTO physical FROM (
  SELECT service_date,projection_status,version_id,publication_id,projection_id,occurrence_id,location_group_id,location_id,
   assigned_employee_id,coverage_start,coverage_end,assignment_status,authority_source
  FROM public.custodial_operational_location_assignments(day)) r;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY normal_occurrence_id,responsibility_id,coverage_start),'[]'::jsonb) INTO loans FROM (
  SELECT projection_id,loan_id,responsibility_id,normal_occurrence_id,normal_owner_id,coverer_id,location_group_id,
   included_location_ids,included_snapshots='[]'::jsonb AS included_snapshots_empty,service_mode,coverage_start,coverage_end
  FROM public.static_weekly_v8_read_lunch_segments(day)) r;
 IF jsonb_array_length(segments)>4096 OR jsonb_array_length(physical)>4096 OR jsonb_array_length(loans)>4096
  OR octet_length(jsonb_build_array(segments,physical,loans)::text)>2097152 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHEDULE source limit exceeded' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(segments) AS r(service_date date,projection_status text,
  version_id uuid,publication_id uuid,projection_id uuid,segment_id uuid,location_group_id uuid,included_location_ids uuid[],
  owner_type text,assigned_employee_id uuid,coverage_start time,coverage_end time,status text,source_type text,service_mode text,governed boolean)),
 p AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(physical) AS r(service_date date,projection_status text,version_id uuid,
  publication_id uuid,projection_id uuid,occurrence_id uuid,location_group_id uuid,location_id uuid,assigned_employee_id uuid,
  coverage_start time,coverage_end time,assignment_status text,authority_source text)),
 l AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(loans) AS r(projection_id uuid,loan_id text,responsibility_id text,
  normal_occurrence_id uuid,normal_owner_id uuid,coverer_id uuid,location_group_id uuid,included_location_ids uuid[],
  included_snapshots_empty boolean,service_mode text,coverage_start time,coverage_end time)),
 sides AS(SELECT * FROM (VALUES(0,true),(1,false)) r(side,pre)),
 active AS(SELECT sides.side,sides.pre,s.* FROM s CROSS JOIN sides WHERE
  CASE WHEN sides.pre THEN s.coverage_start<time '09:45' AND s.coverage_end>=time '09:45'
   ELSE s.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND s.coverage_end>time '09:45' END),
 effective AS(SELECT a.*,loan.n AS loan_count,CASE WHEN loan.n=1 THEN loan.coverer ELSE a.assigned_employee_id END AS effective_owner
  FROM active a CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*) AS n,(array_agg(l.coverer_id))[1] AS coverer FROM l
   WHERE l.normal_occurrence_id=a.segment_id AND CASE WHEN a.pre THEN l.coverage_start<time '09:45' AND l.coverage_end>=time '09:45'
    ELSE l.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND l.coverage_end>time '09:45' END) loan),
 selected_physical AS(SELECT e.side,e.segment_id,e.effective_owner,e.loan_count,p.* FROM effective e JOIN p
  ON p.occurrence_id=e.segment_id AND CASE WHEN e.pre THEN p.coverage_start<time '09:45' AND p.coverage_end>=time '09:45'
   ELSE p.coverage_start<=time '09:45' AND p.coverage_end>time '09:45' END),
 units AS(SELECT e.side,'DUTY:'||e.service_mode||':'||e.location_group_id::text AS key,e.effective_owner AS owner
   FROM effective e WHERE e.service_mode IN('reminder_only','response_only_no_clean')
  UNION ALL SELECT p.side,'LOCATION:'||p.location_id::text,p.assigned_employee_id FROM selected_physical p),
 invalid_segments AS(SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.service_date IS DISTINCT FROM day OR s.projection_id IS DISTINCT FROM projection
  OR s.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM publication OR s.version_id IS DISTINCT FROM version OR s.projection_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'current'
  OR s.governed IS DISTINCT FROM true OR s.source_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'static_weekly_projection'
  OR s.coverage_start IS NULL OR s.coverage_end IS NULL OR s.coverage_start>=s.coverage_end
  OR s.service_mode IS NULL OR s.service_mode NOT IN('scan_tracked','reminder_only','response_only_no_clean')
  OR s.included_location_ids IS NULL OR (s.service_mode='scan_tracked' AND cardinality(s.included_location_ids)=0)
  OR (s.service_mode<>'scan_tracked' AND cardinality(s.included_location_ids)<>0)
  OR NOT((s.status='ASSIGNED' AND ((s.owner_type='EMPLOYEE' AND s.assigned_employee_id IS NOT NULL)
   OR(s.owner_type='COVERALL' AND s.assigned_employee_id IS NULL))) OR(s.status='OPEN' AND s.owner_type='OPEN' AND s.assigned_employee_id IS NULL))),
 invalid_loans AS(SELECT 1 FROM l LEFT JOIN s ON s.segment_id=l.normal_occurrence_id WHERE s.segment_id IS NULL
  OR s.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'ASSIGNED' OR l.projection_id IS DISTINCT FROM projection
  OR l.normal_owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.assigned_employee_id OR l.location_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.location_group_id
  OR l.service_mode IS DISTINCT FROM s.service_mode OR l.coverage_start IS NULL OR l.coverage_end IS NULL
  OR l.coverage_start>=l.coverage_end OR l.coverage_start<s.coverage_start OR l.coverage_end>s.coverage_end
  OR (l.service_mode='scan_tracked' AND (l.included_snapshots_empty IS DISTINCT FROM false OR l.included_location_ids IS NULL))
  OR (l.service_mode<>'scan_tracked' AND l.included_snapshots_empty IS DISTINCT FROM true)
  OR ARRAY(SELECT unnest(coalesce(l.included_location_ids,'{}'::uuid[])) ORDER BY 1)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY(SELECT unnest(s.included_location_ids) ORDER BY 1)),
 invalid_physical AS(SELECT 1 FROM p LEFT JOIN s ON s.segment_id=p.occurrence_id WHERE s.segment_id IS NULL
  OR s.service_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'scan_tracked' OR p.location_id IS NULL OR NOT(p.location_id=ANY(s.included_location_ids))
  OR p.location_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.location_group_id OR p.projection_id IS DISTINCT FROM projection
  OR p.publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM publication OR p.version_id IS DISTINCT FROM version OR p.service_date IS DISTINCT FROM day
  OR p.projection_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'current' OR p.assignment_status IS DISTINCT FROM s.status
  OR p.coverage_start IS NULL OR p.coverage_end IS NULL OR p.coverage_start>=p.coverage_end
  OR p.coverage_start<s.coverage_start OR p.coverage_end>s.coverage_end
  OR p.authority_source IS NULL OR p.authority_source NOT IN('static_weekly_projection','static_weekly_lunch_coverage')),
 edges AS(SELECT coverage_start AS edge FROM s WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_end FROM s WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_start FROM p WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_end FROM p WHERE assigned_employee_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_start FROM l WHERE normal_owner_id=p_employee_id OR coverer_id=p_employee_id UNION ALL
  SELECT coverage_end FROM l WHERE normal_owner_id=p_employee_id OR coverer_id=p_employee_id)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'before_units',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM units WHERE side=0 AND owner=p_employee_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'after_units',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM units WHERE side=1 AND owner=p_employee_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'cut',(SELECT min(edge) FROM edges WHERE edge>time '09:45'),
  'invalid',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalid_segments) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalid_loans) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalid_physical)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective WHERE loan_count>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM units GROUP BY side,key HAVING count(*)<>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective e WHERE e.service_mode='scan_tracked' AND
    (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_physical p WHERE p.side=e.side AND p.segment_id=e.segment_id)<>cardinality(e.included_location_ids))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected_physical p WHERE p.assigned_employee_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.effective_owner
    OR p.authority_source IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN p.loan_count=1 THEN 'static_weekly_lunch_coverage' ELSE 'static_weekly_projection' END)) INTO analysis;
 IF (analysis->>'invalid')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current accepted SCHEDULE source incomplete or ambiguous' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 before_units:=analysis->'before_units';after_units:=analysis->'after_units';
 IF before_units=after_units THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status','NO_OWNERSHIP_CHANGE',
   'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',null);END IF;
 cut:=(analysis->>'cut')::time;
 -- Working availability is an additional authoritative ceiling, never an
 -- invented expiry. Credential and04:00 operational-day ceilings also apply.
 cut:=least(coalesce(cut,shift_end),shift_end);
 start_at:=(day+time '09:45') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago';
 SELECT expires_at INTO STRICT credential_end FROM public.device_auth_credentials
  WHERE credential_id=(target#>>'{recipient,credential_id}')::uuid;
 end_at:=least((day+cut) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago',credential_end,
  ((day+1)+time '04:00') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago');
 IF end_at<=start_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'finite SCHEDULE source interval unavailable' USING errcode='22023';END IF;
 IF p_at>=end_at OR (p_at>=start_at AND public.sch_service_date(p_at) IS DISTINCT FROM day) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status','SOURCE_WINDOW_EXPIRED',
   'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',null);END IF;
 source_document:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-source-evidence.v1','target',target,
  'availability',availability,'segments',segments,'physical',physical,'loans',loans,
  'valid_from',to_char(start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'valid_until',to_char(end_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'));
 source_digest:=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(source_document);
 window_data:=jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window.v1','logical_key','schedule-ownership:'||day::text||':'||p_employee_id::text||':09:45',
  'service_date',day,'timezone','America/Chicago','employee_id',p_employee_id,'employee_name',name,'generation_id',p_generation_id,
  'recipient',target->'recipient','projection_id',projection,'publication_id',publication,'version_id',version,
  'source_revision',target#>>'{source,source_revision}','assignment_occurrence_id',p_source_key,'before_units',before_units,'after_units',after_units,
  'server_source_sha256',source_digest,'server_digest_format','postgres-jsonb-sha256.v1',
  'valid_from',to_char(start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'valid_until',to_char(end_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'server_now',to_char(p_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'));
 v_status:=CASE WHEN p_at<start_at THEN 'WINDOW_NOT_STARTED' ELSE 'CURRENT_WINDOW_SOURCE_ONLY' END;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.native-schedule-server-window-source.v1','status',v_status,
  'delivery_admitted',false,'dispatch_authorized',false,'clock_effect_authority',null,'retention_authority',null,'window',window_data);
END $fn$;

-- Unapplied, owner-confirmed held-event correction. No original-mail replay.
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5s';
SET LOCAL statement_timeout='30s';
SET LOCAL search_path=pg_catalog,public,extensions;
LOCK TABLE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
CREATE TEMP TABLE held_correction_inventory_before ON COMMIT DROP AS
 SELECT * FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory;
CREATE TEMP TABLE held_correction_surface_before ON COMMIT DROP AS
 SELECT proacl acl,proowner owner,pg_get_functiondef(oid) definition FROM pg_proc
 WHERE oid='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure;
DO $held_predecessor$ DECLARE body text;BEGIN
 SELECT definition INTO STRICT body FROM held_correction_surface_before;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_inventory_before)<>6970
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM held_correction_inventory_before WHERE definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_text(definition_sql))
  OR (length(body)-length(replace(body,'  values','')))/length('  values')<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM held_correction_inventory_before WHERE object_kind='function' AND object_identity LIKE '%(%'
   AND to_regprocedure(object_identity)='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure AND definition_sql=body)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory'::regclass
   AND tgname='trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable' AND tgenabled='A')
  OR to_regclass('public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2') IS NOT NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Held correction source254 recovery predecessor changed'; END IF;
END $held_predecessor$;

-- Main owns migration/recovery registration, normal named-manager mount,
-- restricted service client, SQL qualification, and activation decision.
-- Requires pinned events_app_events/history/outlook_sync/event_venues schema,
-- ops_manager_managers/trusted_devices, mutation lease, pgcrypto digest.
-- Existing source_payload and payload_hash remain immutable original evidence.

create table public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2 (
  preview_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  preview_sha256 text not null check (preview_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  ledger_id uuid not null references public.events_app_outlook_sync(id) on delete restrict,
  ui_review_snapshot_sha256 text not null check (ui_review_snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  db_review_snapshot_sha256 text not null check (db_review_snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  source_provenance_digest text not null check (source_provenance_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  original_payload_sha256 text not null check (original_payload_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  original_message_id text not null,
  original_event_key text not null,
  original_received_at timestamptz not null,
  original_subject text,
  original_sync_note text,
  original_created_at timestamptz not null,
  original_updated_at timestamptz not null,
  venue_id uuid not null references public.event_venues(id) on delete restrict,
  venue_fingerprint text not null check (venue_fingerprint ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  normalized_event jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(normalized_event) = 'object'),
  manager_id uuid not null references public.ops_manager_managers(manager_id) on delete restrict,
  credential_id uuid not null references public.ops_manager_trusted_devices(credential_id) on delete restrict,
  device_id text not null,
  session_fingerprint text not null check (session_fingerprint ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  state text not null default 'PREVIEW_ONLY' check (state in ('PREVIEW_ONLY','APPLIED')),
  event_id uuid references public.events_app_events(id) on delete restrict,
  created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  expires_at timestamptz not null default (clock_timestamp() + interval '5 minutes'),
  applied_at timestamptz,
  constraint held_preview_state_event_pair check (
    (state = 'PREVIEW_ONLY' and event_id is null and applied_at is null)
    or (state = 'APPLIED' and event_id is not null and applied_at is not null))
);
create index custodial_held_event_previews_v2_ledger_idx
  on public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2(ledger_id, created_at desc);
alter table public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2 enable row level security;
alter table public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2 force row level security;
revoke all on table public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2 from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update on table public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2 to service_role;
create policy held_event_previews_service_v2 on public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2
  for all to service_role using (true) with check (true);

-- Both RPCs are SECURITY INVOKER, service_role-only. The database validates
-- manager/device state again, but the server's normal signed-token/current
-- trusted-device middleware remains mandatory before and after each await.
-- The caller must never expose service_role to a browser or accept an
-- arbitrary SQL/client callback from a request.
create function public.custodial_held_event_preview_v2(
  p_ledger_id uuid, p_expected_review_snapshot_sha256 text,
  p_source_provenance_digest text, p_manager_id uuid,
  p_credential_id uuid, p_device_id text, p_session_fingerprint text,
  p_event_name text, p_start_at timestamptz, p_end_at timestamptz,
  p_venue_ref uuid, p_manager_fact_confirmation text
) returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, extensions
as $fn$
declare
  v_ledger public.events_app_outlook_sync%rowtype;
  v_venue public.event_venues%rowtype;
  v_preview uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_db_snapshot text; v_payload_sha text; v_venue_sha text; v_preview_sha text;
  v_event jsonb; v_source jsonb;
begin
  if p_expected_review_snapshot_sha256 is null or p_expected_review_snapshot_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     or p_source_provenance_digest is null or p_source_provenance_digest !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     or p_session_fingerprint is null or p_session_fingerprint !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     or p_manager_fact_confirmation is distinct from 'MANAGER_CONFIRMED_MISSING_ORIGINAL_FACTS'
     or p_manager_id is null or p_credential_id is null or p_device_id is null or length(p_device_id) not between 1 and 96
     or p_event_name is null or length(btrim(p_event_name)) not between 1 and 180
     or p_start_at is null or p_end_at is null or not isfinite(p_start_at) or not isfinite(p_end_at)
     or p_end_at <= p_start_at or p_venue_ref is null then
    raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Closed manager correction preview required';
  end if;
  perform 1 from public.ops_manager_managers m
    join public.ops_manager_trusted_devices d on d.manager_id=m.manager_id
    where m.manager_id=p_manager_id and m.active and m.revoked_at is null
      and not m.is_system_principal
      and m.roles && array['OPS_MANAGER','CUSTODIAL_MANAGER','DIRECTOR','SECURITY_ADMIN']::text[]
      and d.credential_id=p_credential_id and d.device_id=p_device_id
      and d.revoked_at is null and d.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
      and d.max_access_level='full_access' for share of m,d;
  if not found then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Current named manager required'; end if;
  select * into v_ledger from public.events_app_outlook_sync where id=p_ledger_id;
  if v_ledger.id is null or v_ledger.sync_status<>'NEEDS_REVIEW' or v_ledger.event_id is not null
     or v_ledger.payload_hash is distinct from p_source_provenance_digest
     or v_ledger.source_event_key not like 'custodial-outlook-events-v1/event/%' then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Held original changed'; end if;
  v_source := v_ledger.source_payload->'source';
  if jsonb_typeof(v_ledger.source_payload) is distinct from 'object'
     or (v_ledger.source_payload - 'source' - 'source_event_key' - 'reason') <> '{}'::jsonb
     or jsonb_typeof(v_source) is distinct from 'object'
     or v_source->>'evidence_kind' is distinct from 'original_event_notice'
     or v_source->>'mailbox' is distinct from 'eoperle@memphiszoo.org'
     or v_source->>'message_id' is distinct from v_ledger.outlook_message_id
     or v_ledger.source_event_key is distinct from
        'custodial-outlook-events-v1/event/' || (v_ledger.source_payload->>'source_event_key')
     or v_source->>'received_at' is null
     or (v_source->>'received_at')::timestamptz is distinct from v_ledger.received_at
     or encode(digest(jsonb_build_object('action','review','observation',v_ledger.source_payload)::text,'sha256'),'hex')
        is distinct from v_ledger.payload_hash then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Original source provenance unavailable'; end if;
  v_payload_sha := encode(digest(v_ledger.source_payload::text,'sha256'),'hex');
  select encode(digest(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(id,event_id,received_at,payload_hash,sync_status,
    source_event_key,source_payload)
    order by id),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'sha256'),'hex') into v_db_snapshot
    from public.events_app_outlook_sync where source_event_key like 'custodial-outlook-events-v1/event/%'
      and sync_status='NEEDS_REVIEW';
  select * into v_venue from public.event_venues where id=p_venue_ref;
  if v_venue.id is null or not v_venue.active or not v_venue.eligible_event_venue
     or v_venue.location_group_id is null
     or v_venue.event_scope not in ('SINGLE_VENUE','ZOO_WIDE') then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Eligible venue changed'; end if;
  v_venue_sha := encode(digest(jsonb_build_array(v_venue.id,v_venue.display_name,v_venue.location_group_id,
    v_venue.event_scope,v_venue.active,v_venue.eligible_event_venue,v_venue.updated_at)::text,'sha256'),'hex');
  if exists (select 1 from public.events_app_events e where lower(btrim(e.event_name))=lower(btrim(p_event_name))
    and e.event_date=(p_start_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date)
     or exists (select 1 from public.events_app_outlook_sync l where l.source_event_key=v_ledger.source_event_key
       and l.id<>v_ledger.id and l.event_id is not null) then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Possible existing event requires identity review'; end if;
  v_event := jsonb_build_object('event_name',btrim(p_event_name),
    'event_date',(p_start_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date,
    'start_time',(p_start_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::time(0),
    'start_instant_utc',p_start_at,'end_date',(p_end_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date,
    'end_time',(p_end_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::time(0),
    'end_instant_utc',p_end_at,'primary_venue_id',v_venue.id,
    'display_location',v_venue.display_name);
  v_preview_sha := encode(digest(jsonb_build_object('preview_id',v_preview,'ledger_id',p_ledger_id,
    'ui_snapshot',p_expected_review_snapshot_sha256,'db_snapshot',v_db_snapshot,
    'original_hash',v_ledger.payload_hash,'original_payload_sha256',v_payload_sha,
    'original_message',v_ledger.outlook_message_id,'original_event_key',v_ledger.source_event_key,
    'original_received_at',v_ledger.received_at,'original_subject',v_ledger.source_subject,
    'original_sync_note',v_ledger.sync_note,'original_created_at',v_ledger.created_at,
    'original_updated_at',v_ledger.updated_at,'venue_fingerprint',v_venue_sha,
    'manager_id',p_manager_id,'credential_id',p_credential_id,'device_id',p_device_id,
    'session_fingerprint',p_session_fingerprint,'normalized_event',v_event)::text,'sha256'),'hex');
  insert into public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2(preview_id,preview_sha256,ledger_id,
    ui_review_snapshot_sha256,db_review_snapshot_sha256,source_provenance_digest,
    original_payload_sha256,original_message_id,original_event_key,original_received_at,
    original_subject,original_sync_note,original_created_at,original_updated_at,
    venue_id,venue_fingerprint,normalized_event,manager_id,credential_id,device_id,session_fingerprint)
  values (v_preview,v_preview_sha,p_ledger_id,p_expected_review_snapshot_sha256,v_db_snapshot,
    v_ledger.payload_hash,v_payload_sha,v_ledger.outlook_message_id,v_ledger.source_event_key,
    v_ledger.received_at,v_ledger.source_subject,v_ledger.sync_note,v_ledger.created_at,v_ledger.updated_at,
    v_venue.id,v_venue_sha,v_event,p_manager_id,p_credential_id,p_device_id,p_session_fingerprint);
  return jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.held-event-correction-preview.v2',
    'state','PREVIEW_ONLY','preview_id',v_preview,'preview_sha256',v_preview_sha,
    'ledger_id',p_ledger_id,'expected_review_snapshot_sha256',p_expected_review_snapshot_sha256,
    'source_provenance_digest',v_ledger.payload_hash,'venue_fingerprint',v_venue_sha,
    'source_evidence_status','ORIGINAL_FACTS_INCOMPLETE',
    'missing_original_fields',jsonb_build_array('event_name','start_at'),
    'fact_basis',jsonb_build_object('event_name','MANAGER_CONFIRMED','start_at','MANAGER_CONFIRMED',
      'end_at','MANAGER_CONFIRMED','venue_ref','MANAGER_CONFIRMED'),
    'normalized_event',v_event,'published',false,'coverage_assigned',false,'reminder_eligible',false);
end $fn$;

create function public.custodial_held_event_confirm_v2(
  p_preview_id uuid, p_preview_sha256 text, p_manager_id uuid,
  p_credential_id uuid, p_device_id text, p_session_fingerprint text
) returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, extensions
as $fn$
declare
  v_preview public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2%rowtype;
  v_ledger public.events_app_outlook_sync%rowtype;
  v_venue public.event_venues%rowtype;
  v_saved public.events_app_events%rowtype;
  v_db_snapshot text; v_venue_sha text; v_calculated_sha text;
  v_lease jsonb; v_request uuid:=gen_random_uuid();
  v_start timestamptz; v_end timestamptz; v_manager_name text;
begin
  if p_preview_id is null or p_preview_sha256 is null or p_preview_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    or p_manager_id is null or p_credential_id is null or p_device_id is null
    or p_session_fingerprint is null or p_session_fingerprint !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' then
    raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Exact held preview confirmation required'; end if;
  v_lease:=public.custodial_begin_application_mutation_lease(v_request,'custodial-held-event-correction-v2');
  if v_lease->'mutations_paused' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb then
    raise exception using errcode='55000',message='Event mutations are paused'; end if;
  -- Same lock used by custodial_outlook_event_sync_v1; no changed-source replay.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('custodial-outlook-events-v1',0));
  select * into v_preview from public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2
    where preview_id=p_preview_id for update;
  if v_preview.preview_id is null or v_preview.state<>'PREVIEW_ONLY'
    or v_preview.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() or v_preview.preview_sha256<>p_preview_sha256
    or v_preview.manager_id<>p_manager_id or v_preview.credential_id<>p_credential_id
    or v_preview.device_id<>p_device_id or v_preview.session_fingerprint<>p_session_fingerprint then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Held preview expired, consumed, or changed'; end if;
  v_calculated_sha := encode(digest(jsonb_build_object('preview_id',v_preview.preview_id,
    'ledger_id',v_preview.ledger_id,'ui_snapshot',v_preview.ui_review_snapshot_sha256,
    'db_snapshot',v_preview.db_review_snapshot_sha256,
    'original_hash',v_preview.source_provenance_digest,
    'original_payload_sha256',v_preview.original_payload_sha256,
    'original_message',v_preview.original_message_id,
    'original_event_key',v_preview.original_event_key,
    'original_received_at',v_preview.original_received_at,
    'original_subject',v_preview.original_subject,
    'original_sync_note',v_preview.original_sync_note,
    'original_created_at',v_preview.original_created_at,
    'original_updated_at',v_preview.original_updated_at,
    'venue_fingerprint',v_preview.venue_fingerprint,
    'manager_id',v_preview.manager_id,'credential_id',v_preview.credential_id,
    'device_id',v_preview.device_id,'session_fingerprint',v_preview.session_fingerprint,
    'normalized_event',v_preview.normalized_event)::text,'sha256'),'hex');
  if v_calculated_sha is distinct from v_preview.preview_sha256 then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Held preview content changed'; end if;
  perform 1 from public.ops_manager_managers m
    join public.ops_manager_trusted_devices d on d.manager_id=m.manager_id
    where m.manager_id=p_manager_id and m.active and m.revoked_at is null
      and not m.is_system_principal
      and m.roles && array['OPS_MANAGER','CUSTODIAL_MANAGER','DIRECTOR','SECURITY_ADMIN']::text[]
      and d.credential_id=p_credential_id and d.device_id=p_device_id
      and d.revoked_at is null and d.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
      and d.max_access_level='full_access' for share of m,d;
  if not found then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Current named manager required'; end if;
  select * into v_ledger from public.events_app_outlook_sync where id=v_preview.ledger_id for update;
  if v_ledger.id is null or v_ledger.event_id is not null or v_ledger.sync_status<>'NEEDS_REVIEW'
    or v_ledger.payload_hash<>v_preview.source_provenance_digest
    or v_ledger.outlook_message_id<>v_preview.original_message_id
    or v_ledger.source_event_key<>v_preview.original_event_key
    or v_ledger.received_at<>v_preview.original_received_at
    or v_ledger.source_subject is distinct from v_preview.original_subject
    or v_ledger.sync_note is distinct from v_preview.original_sync_note
    or v_ledger.created_at is distinct from v_preview.original_created_at
    or v_ledger.updated_at is distinct from v_preview.original_updated_at
    or encode(digest(v_ledger.source_payload::text,'sha256'),'hex')<>v_preview.original_payload_sha256
    or encode(digest(jsonb_build_object('action','review','observation',v_ledger.source_payload)::text,'sha256'),'hex')
      <>v_ledger.payload_hash then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Original held ledger changed'; end if;
  select encode(digest(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(id,event_id,received_at,payload_hash,sync_status,
    source_event_key,source_payload)
    order by id),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'sha256'),'hex') into v_db_snapshot
    from public.events_app_outlook_sync where source_event_key like 'custodial-outlook-events-v1/event/%'
      and sync_status='NEEDS_REVIEW';
  if v_db_snapshot<>v_preview.db_review_snapshot_sha256 then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Held review snapshot changed'; end if;
  select * into v_venue from public.event_venues where id=v_preview.venue_id for share;
  if v_venue.id is null or not v_venue.active or not v_venue.eligible_event_venue
    or v_venue.location_group_id is null or v_venue.event_scope not in ('SINGLE_VENUE','ZOO_WIDE') then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Eligible venue changed'; end if;
  v_venue_sha := encode(digest(jsonb_build_array(v_venue.id,v_venue.display_name,v_venue.location_group_id,
    v_venue.event_scope,v_venue.active,v_venue.eligible_event_venue,v_venue.updated_at)::text,'sha256'),'hex');
  if v_venue_sha<>v_preview.venue_fingerprint then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Venue fingerprint changed'; end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.events_app_events e
    where lower(btrim(e.event_name))=lower(btrim(v_preview.normalized_event->>'event_name'))
      and e.event_date=(v_preview.normalized_event->>'event_date')::date)
    or exists (select 1 from public.events_app_outlook_sync l
      where l.source_event_key=v_ledger.source_event_key and l.id<>v_ledger.id and l.event_id is not null) then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Possible existing event requires identity review'; end if;
  v_start:=(v_preview.normalized_event->>'start_instant_utc')::timestamptz;
  v_end:=(v_preview.normalized_event->>'end_instant_utc')::timestamptz;
  if v_start is null or v_end is null or v_end<=v_start
    or (v_start at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date<>(v_preview.normalized_event->>'event_date')::date
    or (v_end at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date<>(v_preview.normalized_event->>'end_date')::date
    or (v_start at time zone 'America/Chicago')::time(0)<>(v_preview.normalized_event->>'start_time')::time
    or (v_end at time zone 'America/Chicago')::time(0)<>(v_preview.normalized_event->>'end_time')::time then
    raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Normalized event changed'; end if;
  select display_name into strict v_manager_name from public.ops_manager_managers where manager_id=p_manager_id;
  if nullif(btrim(v_manager_name),'') is null then
    raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Current manager actor snapshot unavailable'; end if;
  insert into public.events_app_events(event_name,event_scope,primary_venue_id,venue_ids,
    location_group_id,display_location,event_date,end_date,start_time,end_time,
    start_instant_utc,end_instant_utc,source_format,created_by_manager_id,
    updated_by_manager_id,created_by,overridden_by,needs_review,manually_overridden,
    overridden_at,event_timezone,revision,operation_id)
  values (v_preview.normalized_event->>'event_name',v_venue.event_scope,v_venue.id,array[v_venue.id],
    v_venue.location_group_id,v_venue.display_name,(v_preview.normalized_event->>'event_date')::date,
    (v_preview.normalized_event->>'end_date')::date,(v_preview.normalized_event->>'start_time')::time,
    (v_preview.normalized_event->>'end_time')::time,v_start,v_end,
    'outlook_held_manager_correction',p_manager_id,p_manager_id,
    v_manager_name,v_manager_name,false,true,clock_timestamp(),'America/Chicago',1,p_preview_id)
  returning * into v_saved;
  insert into public.events_app_event_history(event_id,action,actor,actor_manager_id,reason,previous_record,new_record)
    values (v_saved.id,'create',v_manager_name,p_manager_id,
      'MANAGER_CONFIRMED_MISSING_ORIGINAL_FACTS; original ledger='||v_ledger.id::text,
      null,jsonb_build_object('event_id',v_saved.id,'revision',v_saved.revision,
        'source_provenance_digest',v_ledger.payload_hash,'preview_id',p_preview_id,
        'manager_id',p_manager_id,'credential_id',p_credential_id,
        'fact_basis',jsonb_build_object('event_name','MANAGER_CONFIRMED','start_at','MANAGER_CONFIRMED',
          'end_at','MANAGER_CONFIRMED','venue_ref','MANAGER_CONFIRMED')));
  -- Only linkage/status/note/updated_at may change. Source payload, subject,
  -- message/key, received_at and original digest stay untouched.
  update public.events_app_outlook_sync set event_id=v_saved.id,sync_status='APPLIED',
    sync_note='Manager-confirmed held event; original facts incomplete',updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    where id=v_ledger.id and event_id is null and sync_status='NEEDS_REVIEW'
      and payload_hash=v_preview.source_provenance_digest;
  if not found then raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Original held ledger changed'; end if;
  update public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2 set state='APPLIED',event_id=v_saved.id,applied_at=clock_timestamp()
    where preview_id=p_preview_id and state='PREVIEW_ONLY';
  if not found then raise exception using errcode='40901',message='Preview already consumed'; end if;
  perform public.custodial_release_application_mutation_lease(v_request);
  return jsonb_build_object('schema','custodial.held-event-correction-confirmed.v2',
    'state','APPLIED','preview_id',p_preview_id,'preview_sha256',p_preview_sha256,
    'ledger_id',v_ledger.id,'event_id',v_saved.id,'revision',v_saved.revision);
end $fn$;
revoke all on function public.custodial_held_event_confirm_v2(uuid,text,uuid,uuid,text,text)
  from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.custodial_held_event_confirm_v2(uuid,text,uuid,uuid,text,text)
  to service_role;

-- Main-owned prerequisites before executing any derivative migration:
-- 1. Verify live schema/policy/role/lease definitions and add exact recovery
--    object inventory, registration, ACL evidence and rollback-safe tests.
-- 2. Verify service_role-only function/table grants, RLS, malformed direct RPC,
--    manager revocation, changed ledger, stale snapshot/venue, duplicate RPC,
--    partial failure rollback and lease behavior in isolated qualified SQL.
-- 3. Mount only through existing normal signed manager + trusted-device write
--    middleware and fixed TEST/prod target; no request-injected service client.
-- 4. Use a separate normally authenticated manager-feed check before claiming
--    display/publication. No automatic staffing/reminder/coverage changes.
CREATE TEMP TABLE held_correction_objects ON COMMIT DROP AS
 WITH funcs AS(SELECT p.oid FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname IN(
  'custodial_held_event_preview_v2','custodial_held_event_confirm_v2')),
 objects AS(
 SELECT 100000 bucket,0 priority,'function'::text kind,'public.'||oid::regprocedure::text identity,pg_get_functiondef(oid) definition FROM funcs
 UNION ALL SELECT 900000,0,'grant','public.'||oid::regprocedure::text,public.custodial_release_authority_current_grant_definition('public.'||oid::regprocedure::text) FROM funcs
 UNION ALL SELECT x.bucket,x.priority,x.kind,x.identity,x.definition FROM unnest(array[
  'public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2']) rel CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
  SELECT 1000 bucket,0 priority,'relation'::text kind,rel identity,public.custodial_release_authority_current_relation_definition(rel) definition
  UNION ALL SELECT 200000,0,'column',rel||':'||attname,public.custodial_release_authority_current_column_definition(rel||':'||attname)
   FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid=rel::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped
  UNION ALL SELECT 300000,0,'column_set',rel,public.custodial_release_authority_current_column_set_definition(rel)
  UNION ALL SELECT 400000,0,'relation_state',rel,public.custodial_release_authority_current_relation_state_definition(rel)
  UNION ALL SELECT 500000,CASE WHEN contype='f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,'constraint',rel||':'||conname,public.custodial_release_authority_current_constraint_definition(rel||':'||conname)
   FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=rel::regclass
  UNION ALL SELECT 600000,0,'index',indexrelid::regclass::text,public.custodial_release_authority_current_index_definition(indexrelid::regclass::text)
   FROM pg_index i WHERE indrelid=rel::regclass AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conindid=i.indexrelid)
  UNION ALL SELECT 700000,0,'trigger',rel||'.'||tgname,'drop trigger if exists '||quote_ident(tgname)||' on '||rel||'; '
   ||pg_get_triggerdef(oid,true)||'; alter table '||rel||CASE WHEN tgenabled='A' THEN ' enable always trigger ' ELSE ' enable trigger ' END||quote_ident(tgname)||';'
   FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid=rel::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal
  UNION ALL SELECT 800000,0,'policy',rel||':'||polname,public.custodial_release_authority_current_policy_definition(rel||':'||polname)
   FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=rel::regclass
  UNION ALL SELECT 900000,0,'grant',rel,public.custodial_release_authority_current_grant_definition(rel)) x)
 SELECT * FROM objects;
DO $private_objects$ BEGIN
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='function')<>2
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='relation')<>1
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='column')<>26
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='column_set')<>1
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='relation_state')<>1
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='index')<>1
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='trigger')<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
   WHERE tgrelid='public.custodial_held_event_previews_v2'::regclass
    AND tgname='custodial_disaster_restore_mutation_fence' AND tgenabled='O'
    AND tgfoid='custodial_dr.guard_application_mutation()'::regprocedure)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='policy')<>1
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE kind='grant')<>3
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM held_correction_objects WHERE definition IS NULL)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT kind,identity FROM held_correction_objects GROUP BY kind,identity HAVING count(*)<>1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM held_correction_inventory_before old JOIN held_correction_objects x ON x.kind=old.object_kind AND x.identity=old.object_identity)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING message='Held correction recovery object declaration changed',
  detail=jsonb_build_object('counts',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(kind,n) FROM (SELECT kind,count(*) n FROM held_correction_objects GROUP BY kind)x),
   'undefined',(SELECT jsonb_agg(identity) FROM held_correction_objects WHERE definition IS NULL),
   'duplicates',(SELECT jsonb_agg(identity) FROM (SELECT identity FROM held_correction_objects GROUP BY kind,identity HAVING count(*)<>1)x),
   'existing',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x.identity) FROM held_correction_objects x JOIN held_correction_inventory_before i ON x.kind=i.object_kind AND x.identity=i.object_identity))::text;
 END IF;
END $private_objects$;
DO $private_surface$ DECLARE original text;patched text;entries text;BEGIN
 SELECT definition INTO STRICT original FROM held_correction_surface_before;
 SELECT string_agg('('||quote_literal(kind)||','||quote_literal(identity)||','||quote_literal('explicit owner-confirmed held-event correction; immutable original provenance; no automatic coverage or reminders')||'),',E'\n' ORDER BY kind,identity)
  INTO entries FROM held_correction_objects;
 patched:=replace(original,'  values','  values'||E'\n'||entries);EXECUTE patched;
 IF pg_get_functiondef('public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure) IS DISTINCT FROM patched
  OR (SELECT proacl FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure)
   IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT acl FROM held_correction_surface_before)
  OR (SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure)
   IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT owner FROM held_correction_surface_before)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Private custody canary owner/ACL/body changed outside exact finite extension';END IF;
END $private_surface$;
-- Same normal, exclusive-lock, exact-predecessor inventory extension used by
-- the existing source251/252 migration controls. No application guard is changed.
ALTER TABLE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory DISABLE TRIGGER trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable;
DO $private_recovery$ DECLARE obj record;next_order integer;changed integer;BEGIN
 UPDATE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory SET
  definition_sql=pg_get_functiondef('public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure),
  definition_sha256=public.static_weekly_digest_text(pg_get_functiondef('public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure)),captured_at=statement_timestamp()
  WHERE object_kind='function' AND object_identity LIKE '%(%'
   AND to_regprocedure(object_identity)='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure
   AND definition_sql=(SELECT definition FROM held_correction_surface_before);
 GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT;IF changed<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Private custody exact canary inventory predecessor changed';END IF;
 FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM held_correction_objects ORDER BY bucket,priority,identity LOOP
  SELECT n INTO next_order FROM generate_series(obj.bucket+1,CASE WHEN obj.bucket=1000 THEN 99998 ELSE obj.bucket+99998 END) n
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory WHERE restore_order=n) ORDER BY n LIMIT 1;
  IF next_order IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Private custody finite recovery order exhausted';END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory(restore_order,object_kind,object_identity,definition_sql,definition_sha256)
   VALUES(next_order,obj.kind,obj.identity,obj.definition,public.static_weekly_digest_text(obj.definition));
 END LOOP;
END $private_recovery$;
ALTER TABLE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory ENABLE ALWAYS TRIGGER trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable;
DO $private_scope$ BEGIN
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_inventory_before)+(SELECT count(*) FROM held_correction_objects)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT old.* FROM held_correction_inventory_before old WHERE NOT(object_kind='function' AND object_identity LIKE '%(%'
   AND to_regprocedure(object_identity)='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure)
   EXCEPT SELECT * FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT now.* FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory now WHERE NOT(object_kind='function' AND object_identity LIKE '%(%'
   AND to_regprocedure(object_identity)='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM held_correction_objects x WHERE x.kind=now.object_kind AND x.identity=now.object_identity)
   EXCEPT SELECT * FROM held_correction_inventory_before)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM held_correction_objects x LEFT JOIN public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory i
   ON x.kind=i.object_kind AND x.identity=i.object_identity WHERE i.definition_sql IS DISTINCT FROM x.definition
    OR i.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_text(x.definition))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory'::regclass
   AND tgname='trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable' AND tgenabled='A')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Private custody unrelated recovery scope, exact new bytes or final ALWAYS inventory guard changed';END IF;
END $private_scope$;
COMMIT;

statements:
-- Main normal CLI-generated follow-up; source preparation only until main's
-- isolated SQL qualification. Requires the separately sealed Mail reader:
-- 20261011214943_custodial_feedback_triage_receipt_reader.sql
-- SHA256 88ca748da7713fd87502675663e34144ea6dea925a29cedd5d358cfbf55c139b (6672 bytes).
-- No function recreation, actual ACL changes, table grants or catalog recapture.
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5s';
SET LOCAL statement_timeout='30s';
SET LOCAL search_path=pg_catalog,public,extensions;
LOCK TABLE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
CREATE TEMP TABLE feedback_receipt_inventory_before ON COMMIT DROP AS
 SELECT * FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory;
CREATE TEMP TABLE feedback_receipt_surface_before ON COMMIT DROP AS
 SELECT proacl acl,proowner owner,pg_get_functiondef(oid) definition FROM pg_proc
 WHERE oid='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure;

-- Verify the Mail-owned exact source/attributes/minimum ACL before using the

DO $reader_source$

  OR reader.prosecdef IS DISTINCT FROM true OR reader.proisstrict IS DISTINCT FROM false
  OR reader.proleakproof IS DISTINCT FROM false OR reader.provariadic<>0 OR reader.pronargdefaults<>0
  OR reader.proargnames IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['p_request','p_manager','p_credential','p_feedback','p_action','p_expected_version']::text[]
  OR reader.proargmodes IS NOT NULL OR reader.proconfig IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog']::text[]
  OR reader.proowner IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc
    WHERE oid='public.custodial_feedback_triage(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text,text)'::regprocedure)

END $scope$;

  'timezone',coalesce(nullif(raw->>'timezone',''),'America/Chicago'),'slots',raw->'slots',
  'proximity',raw->'proximity','exceptions',coalesce(p_source->'exceptions','[]'::jsonb),'versions',jsonb_build_array(raw->'version'));

 packet:=p_utf8::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(packet) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR packet->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.vacancy-reviewed-preparation.v1'
  OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(packet) key) IS DISTINCT FROM
   ARRAY['postInputUtf8','preInputUtf8','preparedProjectionUtf8','previewCanonicalUtf8','previewUtf8','reason','schema']
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy reviewed preparation closed packet required';END IF;
 FOREACH field IN ARRAY ARRAY['preInputUtf8','postInputUtf8','preparedProjectionUtf8','previewCanonicalUtf8','previewUtf8'] LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(packet->field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(convert_to(packet->>field,'UTF8')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216
   OR jsonb_typeof((packet->>field)::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy reviewed preparation exact raw JSON text required';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_text(packet->'reason','vacancy reason',500);
 IF packet->>'reason'<>btrim(packet->>'reason') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy normalized original reason required';END IF;
 v:=(packet->>'previewUtf8')::jsonb;p:=(packet->>'preparedProjectionUtf8')::jsonb;
 canonical:=(packet->>'previewCanonicalUtf8')::jsonb;
 IF v->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.stable-vacancy-preview.v1'
  OR v->>'managerId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_manager::text OR v->>'idempotencyKey' IS DISTINCT FROM p_key
  OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v) key) IS DISTINCT FROM

  OR v->'accepted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR v->'persisted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR v->'phoneUpdated' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(v->'preview') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(v->'expectedRevision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR v->>'expectedRevision' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
  OR (v->>'expectedRevision')::numeric>9007199254740989
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy complete unaccepted preview required';END IF;
 FOREACH field IN ARRAY ARRAY['sourceId','slotId','employeeId','publicationId'] LOOP
  PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_uuid(v->field,'vacancy original identity');
 END LOOP;
 FOREACH field IN ARRAY ARRAY['previewDigest','workerCandidateDigest','reasonDigest','registeredSourceDigest','currentSourceDigest'] LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(v->field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR v->>field !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

CREATE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_current(
 r public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations,p_generation bigint,p_actor_name text)
RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$
DECLARE packet jsonb;v jsonb;snapshot jsonb;original_source jsonb;current_source jsonb;published jsonb;week date;BEGIN
 IF r.state<>'UNSUBMITTED' OR r.generation IS DISTINCT FROM p_generation THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 packet:=public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_packet(r.packet_utf8,r.manager_id,r.idempotency_key);
 IF public.static_weekly_digest_text(r.packet_utf8) IS DISTINCT FROM r.payload_sha256 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy original stored checksum changed';END IF;
 v:=(packet->>'previewUtf8')::jsonb;week:=(v->>'weekStart')::date;
 IF v->>'managerName' IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor_name
  OR (v->>'effectiveStart')::date IS DISTINCT FROM public.sch_service_date(statement_timestamp()) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 snapshot:=public.static_weekly_v3_read_manager_snapshot(week);
 IF snapshot->'authority_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM v->'expectedRevision'
  OR snapshot#>>'{current_publication,publication_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'publicationId'
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('compiler_input',canonical_source) INTO original_source
  FROM public.static_weekly_authority_source_documents WHERE source_id=(v->>'sourceId')::uuid
   AND active IS TRUE AND retired_at IS NULL AND source_digest=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(canonical_source) FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 current_source:=public.static_weekly_v3_read_authority_source((v->>'sourceId')::uuid,week);
 published:=public.static_weekly_v3_read_publication_source((v->>'publicationId')::uuid,week);
 RETURN coalesce(v->>'registeredSourceDigest'=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(original_source->'compiler_input')
  AND v->>'currentSourceDigest'=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(current_source->'compiler_input')
  AND (packet->>'preInputUtf8')::jsonb=public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_input(published,week),false);
END $fn$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor(
 r public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations,p_current boolean,p_replayed boolean)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$
DECLARE v jsonb;BEGIN
 v:=(public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_packet(r.packet_utf8,r.manager_id,r.idempotency_key)->>'previewUtf8')::jsonb;
 IF public.static_weekly_digest_text(r.packet_utf8) IS DISTINCT FROM r.payload_sha256
  OR v->>'previewDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM r.preview_digest
  OR v->>'workerCandidateDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM r.worker_candidate_digest
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy private reviewed preparation checksum changed';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('found',true,'state',r.state,'current',p_current,'replayed',p_replayed,
  'preview_digest',r.preview_digest,'worker_candidate_digest',r.worker_candidate_digest,
  'generation',r.generation,'staged_at',to_char(r.staged_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'packet_utf8',r.packet_utf8,'payload_sha256',r.payload_sha256);
END $fn$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_guard()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$
BEGIN
 IF tg_op='DELETE' OR current_setting('app.static_weekly_vacancy_preparation_write',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'consume'
  OR old.state<>'UNSUBMITTED' OR new.state<>'CONSUMED'
  OR to_jsonb(new)-ARRAY['state','consumed_at','accepted_witness','accepted_witness_sha256'] IS DISTINCT FROM
   to_jsonb(old)-ARRAY['state','consumed_at','accepted_witness','accepted_witness_sha256']
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy original reviewed preparation is immutable';END IF;
 RETURN new;
END $fn$;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_guard BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE
 ON public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations FOR EACH ROW
 EXECUTE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_guard();
ALTER TABLE public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations ENABLE ALWAYS TRIGGER trg_static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_guard;

CREATE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_stage_vacancy_reviewed_preparation(
 p_manager uuid,p_credential uuid,p_device text,p_access text,p_key text,p_packet_utf8 text)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$
DECLARE actor jsonb;generation bigint;packet jsonb;v jsonb;r public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations%rowtype;
 prior public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations%rowtype;BEGIN
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();generation:=public.custodial_begin_application_mutation();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 actor:=public.custodial_action_actor_v1(p_manager,p_credential,p_device,p_access,'write');
 packet:=public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_packet(p_packet_utf8,p_manager,p_key);v:=(packet->>'previewUtf8')::jsonb;
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations WHERE manager_id=p_manager AND idempotency_key=p_key FOR UPDATE;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF prior.credential_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential OR prior.device_identifier IS DISTINCT FROM p_device
   OR prior.packet_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM p_packet_utf8 OR prior.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_text(p_packet_utf8)
   OR public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_current(prior,generation,actor->>'manager_name') IS NOT TRUE
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='23505',message='Original vacancy review key is occupied or no longer current';END IF;
  RETURN public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor(prior,true,true);
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts WHERE actor_manager_id=p_manager
   AND idempotency_key IN(p_key,'projection-'||public.static_weekly_digest_text(p_key))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy preview cannot adopt an existing original mutation';END IF;
 r.manager_id:=p_manager;r.idempotency_key:=p_key;r.credential_id:=p_credential;r.device_identifier:=p_device;
 r.generation:=generation;r.state:='UNSUBMITTED';r.packet_utf8:=p_packet_utf8;
 r.payload_sha256:=public.static_weekly_digest_text(p_packet_utf8);r.preview_digest:=v->>'previewDigest';
 r.worker_candidate_digest:=v->>'workerCandidateDigest';r.staged_at:=clock_timestamp();
 IF public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_current(r,generation,actor->>'manager_name') IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='40001',message='Vacancy original source/revision/current actor changed';END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations SELECT r.*;
 RETURN public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor(r,true,false);
END $fn$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_read_vacancy_reviewed_preparation(
 p_manager uuid,p_credential uuid,p_device text,p_access text,p_key text)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$
DECLARE actor jsonb;generation bigint;r public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations%rowtype;BEGIN
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();generation:=public.custodial_begin_application_mutation();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 actor:=public.custodial_action_actor_v1(p_manager,p_credential,p_device,p_access,'read');
 IF p_key IS NULL OR length(p_key) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR p_key<>btrim(p_key) OR p_key~'[[:cntrl:]]'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy exact original read key required';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations WHERE manager_id=p_manager AND idempotency_key=p_key FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('found',false);END IF;
 IF r.credential_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential OR r.device_identifier IS DISTINCT FROM p_device THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='Vacancy original private review actor mismatch';END IF;
 RETURN public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor(r,
  public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_current(r,generation,actor->>'manager_name'),true);
END $fn$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.static_weekly_consume_vacancy_reviewed_preparation(
 p_manager uuid,p_credential uuid,p_device text,p_access text,p_key text,p_preview_digest text,p_post_input_utf8 text)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $fn$
DECLARE actor jsonb;generation bigint;r public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations%rowtype;
 packet jsonb;v jsonb;p jsonb;completed jsonb;mutation public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts%rowtype;
 projection public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts%rowtype;mutation_xid bigint;projection_xid bigint;BEGIN
 PERFORM public.static_weekly_v3_assert_control_plane();generation:=public.custodial_begin_application_mutation();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('memphis-static-weekly-authority',0));
 actor:=public.custodial_action_actor_v1(p_manager,p_credential,p_device,p_access,'write');
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations WHERE manager_id=p_manager AND idempotency_key=p_key FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR r.credential_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_credential OR r.device_identifier IS DISTINCT FROM p_device
  OR r.generation IS DISTINCT FROM generation OR r.preview_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_preview_digest
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy original retained preparation/actor/generation/digest required';END IF;
 packet:=public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_packet(r.packet_utf8,p_manager,p_key);
 v:=(packet->>'previewUtf8')::jsonb;p:=(packet->>'preparedProjectionUtf8')::jsonb;
 IF public.static_weekly_digest_text(r.packet_utf8) IS DISTINCT FROM r.payload_sha256
  OR p_post_input_utf8 IS NULL OR octet_length(convert_to(p_post_input_utf8,'UTF8')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216
  OR p_post_input_utf8::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM (packet->>'postInputUtf8')::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy actual post-mutation full compiler input changed';END IF;
 -- Normal source263 fixed read validates immutable mutation/projection/lunch,
 -- original actor/revisions, closed server attestation and actual owning HMAC.
 -- No staged parent, caller Boolean or a future/current selector is acceptance.
 completed:=public.static_weekly_read_original_staffing_outcome_v1(p_manager,p_key,'vacate_roster_slot');
 IF completed->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'custodial.original-staffing-outcome.v1'
  OR completed->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACCEPTED_ORIGINAL'
  OR completed#>>'{original_request,operation}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'vacate_roster_slot'
  OR completed#>>'{original_request,source_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'sourceId'
  OR completed#>>'{original_request,slot_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'slotId'
  OR completed#>>'{original_request,employee_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'employeeId'
  OR completed#>>'{original_request,effective_start}' IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'effectiveStart'
  OR completed#>>'{original_request,reason}' IS DISTINCT FROM packet->>'reason'
  OR completed#>>'{receipt,data,worker_candidate_digest}' IS DISTINCT FROM r.worker_candidate_digest
  OR completed#>>'{receipt,data,paired_lunch_document_identity}' IS DISTINCT FROM p#>>'{lunchDocument,document_identity}'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy exact accepted original candidate witness required';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO mutation FROM public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts WHERE actor_manager_id=p_manager AND idempotency_key=p_key
  AND command_type='vacate_roster_slot';
 SELECT * INTO projection FROM public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts WHERE actor_manager_id=p_manager
  AND idempotency_key='projection-'||public.static_weekly_digest_text(p_key) AND command_type='materialize_projection';
 IF mutation.command_id IS NULL OR projection.command_id IS NULL
  OR mutation.expected_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'expectedRevision')::bigint
  OR projection.expected_revision IS DISTINCT FROM mutation.expected_revision+1
  OR projection.request_canonical_json->>'publication_id' IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'publicationId'
  OR (projection.response_json->>'revision')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'resultingRevision')::bigint
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy accepted original revision/publication witness changed';END IF;
 IF r.state='CONSUMED' THEN
  IF r.accepted_witness IS DISTINCT FROM completed OR r.accepted_witness_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(completed)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy original consumed witness changed';END IF;
  RETURN public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor(r,false,true);

 -- Normal writers insert both immutable receipts directly in this same outer
 -- transaction. A later transaction cannot manufacture initial consumption.
 SELECT xmin::text::bigint INTO mutation_xid FROM public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts WHERE command_id=mutation.command_id;
 SELECT xmin::text::bigint INTO projection_xid FROM public.weekly_schedule_command_receipts WHERE command_id=projection.command_id;
 IF mutation_xid IS DISTINCT FROM mod(txid_current(),4294967296)
  OR projection_xid IS DISTINCT FROM mod(txid_current(),4294967296)
  OR (SELECT current_revision FROM public.static_weekly_schedule_control WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'resultingRevision')::bigint
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy consume requires this same accepted authority transaction';END IF;
 PERFORM set_config('app.static_weekly_vacancy_preparation_write','consume',true);
 UPDATE public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations SET state='CONSUMED',consumed_at=clock_timestamp(),
  accepted_witness=completed,accepted_witness_sha256=public.static_weekly_digest_jsonb(completed)
  WHERE manager_id=p_manager AND idempotency_key=p_key AND state='UNSUBMITTED' RETURNING * INTO r;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vacancy original reviewed consumption conflicted';END IF;
 PERFORM set_config('app.static_weekly_vacancy_preparation_write','',true);
 RETURN public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor(r,false,false);
END $fn$;

    and receipt.result_json->>'completion_response_id'=response.id::text
    and receipt.result_json->>'occurrence_id'=context.occurrence_id::text
    and receipt.result_json->>'original_employee_id'=context.employee_id::text
    and (receipt.result_json->>'started_at')::timestamptz=context.started_at
    and (receipt.result_json->>'ended_at')::timestamptz=context.native_completed_at
    and receipt.result_json->>'correlation_id' is not distinct from nullif(btrim(v_correlation),'')
    and (p_payload->'p_context_id' is null or p_payload->'p_context_id'='null'::jsonb or context.context_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_context_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_occurrence_id' is null or p_payload->'p_occurrence_id'='null'::jsonb or context.occurrence_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_occurrence_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_id' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_id'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_employee_id' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_employee_id'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_employee_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_employee_id'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_assignment_epoch' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_assignment_epoch'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_assignment_epoch::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_assignment_epoch'))
    and (p_payload->'p_snapshot_credential_id' is null or p_payload->'p_snapshot_credential_id'='null'::jsonb or context.snapshot_credential_id::text=(p_payload->>'p_snapshot_credential_id'))
    and (select count(*) from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
      where evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id)=jsonb_array_length(receipt.payload_json->'scan_evidence')
    and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(receipt.payload_json->'scan_evidence') event
      where not exists(select 1 from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
        where evidence.client_event_id=btrim(event->>'client_event_id') and evidence.context_id=context.context_id
          and evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id and evidence.session_id=session.id
          and evidence.event_payload=event))
    and (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(receipt.payload_json->'scan_evidence') event
      where event->>'event_type'='scan_finish')=1
    and exists(select 1 from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
      where evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id and evidence.context_id=context.context_id and evidence.session_id=session.id
        and lower(evidence.client_event_id)=context.native_finish_scan_entry_id::text
        and evidence.event_payload->>'event_type'='scan_finish' and evidence.event_payload->>'result'='ok'
        and evidence.event_payload#>>'{payload_json,entry_source}'='native-nfc'
        and evidence.event_payload->>'scanned_at'=(p_payload->>'p_client_ended_at'))
  limit 2;
END
$function$;

CREATE FUNCTION custodial_release_identity.read_current_original_dashboard_completions_v1()
RETURNS TABLE(location_id uuid,latest_original_completion json)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public
AS $function$
select distinct on (receipt.location_id) receipt.location_id,
        json_build_object(
          'schema','custodial.dashboard-original-completion.v1',
          'state','SERVER_ACCEPTED_ORIGINAL_RECORD',
          'reconciliation_id',receipt.reconciliation_id,
          'context_id',context.context_id,
          'occurrence_id',receipt.occurrence_id,
          'occurrence_fingerprint',receipt.occurrence_fingerprint,
          'payload_fingerprint',receipt.payload_fingerprint,
          'employee_id',receipt.original_employee_id,
          'employee_name',employee.display_name,
          'device_id',receipt.device_id,
          'credential_id',receipt.credential_id,
          'assignment_epoch',context.assignment_epoch::text,
          'location_id',receipt.location_id,
          'session_uuid',session.session_uuid,
          'client_session_id',receipt.client_session_id,
          'client_completion_id',receipt.client_completion_id,
          'snapshot_id',context.snapshot_id,
          'started_at',context.started_at,
          'completed_at',context.native_completed_at,
          'accepted_at',receipt.created_at,
          'work_result',response.response_json->>'work_result',
          'services_performed',response.response_json->'services_performed',
          'schedule_authority_revision',null,
          'schedule_authority_revision_available',false
        ) as latest_original_completion
      from public.custodial_offline_reconciliation_records receipt
      join public.custodial_offline_actor_contexts context on context.context_id=receipt.context_id
      join public.sessions session on session.id=receipt.session_id
      join public.completion_responses response on response.id=receipt.completion_response_id
      join public.employees employee on employee.id=receipt.original_employee_id
      where receipt.state='committed' and context.status='committed' and session.status='closed'
        and receipt.result_json->>'status'='closed'
        and receipt.occurrence_id=context.occurrence_id
        and receipt.occurrence_fingerprint=context.occurrence_fingerprint
        and receipt.credential_id=context.credential_id
        and receipt.location_id=session.location_id and context.location_id=session.location_id
        and response.location_id=session.location_id and response.session_id=session.id
        and context.client_session_id=session.client_session_id
        and receipt.client_session_id=session.client_session_id
        and receipt.client_completion_id=response.client_completion_id
        and receipt.original_employee_id=session.employee_id and context.employee_id=session.employee_id
        and receipt.device_id=session.device_id and context.device_id=session.device_id
        and response.device_id=session.device_id and response.submitted_by_employee_id=session.employee_id
        and context.snapshot_employee_id=receipt.original_employee_id
        and context.snapshot_assignment_epoch=context.assignment_epoch
        and context.snapshot_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        and receipt.payload_json->'response_json'=response.response_json
        and response.response_json->>'work_result' in ('full','details','selective','checked_no_cleaning_needed')
        and jsonb_typeof(response.response_json->'services_performed')='array'
        and (response.response_json->>'work_result'<>'checked_no_cleaning_needed'
          or response.response_json->'services_performed'='[]'::jsonb)
        and context.native_start_attestation_version='custodial-native-start.v1'
        and context.native_scan_entry_id is not null
        and context.native_completion_attestation_version='custodial-native-completion.v2'
        and context.native_completion_attestation_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        and context.native_finish_scan_entry_id is not null
        and context.native_finish_scan_entry_id<>context.native_scan_entry_id
        and context.started_at=session.started_at and context.native_completed_at=session.ended_at
        and context.native_completed_at>context.started_at
        and context.native_completed_at>=public.operational_day_start(now())
        and context.native_completed_at<=now() and isfinite(context.native_completed_at)
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.custodial_offline_scan_event_evidence evidence
          where evidence.context_id=context.context_id
            and evidence.reconciliation_id=receipt.reconciliation_id
            and evidence.session_id=session.id
            and lower(evidence.client_event_id)=context.native_finish_scan_entry_id::text
            and evidence.event_payload->>'event_type'='scan_finish'
            and evidence.event_payload->>'result'='ok'
            and evidence.event_payload#>>'{payload_json,entry_source}'='native-nfc'
            and evidence.event_payload->>'scanned_at'=
              public.custodial_canonical_utc_millis(context.native_completed_at)
        )
      order by receipt.location_id, context.native_completed_at desc, receipt.reconciliation_id desc
    ;
$function$;

     WHERE restore_order>=bucket AND restore_order<bucket+100000;
    INSERT INTO public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory(restore_order,object_kind,object_identity,definition_sql,definition_sha256)
     VALUES(next_order,kind,identity,definition,public.static_weekly_digest_text(definition));

  END LOOP;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a

CREATE FUNCTION custodial_recovery.read_current_native_manager_preparation(
