 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()
  WHERE object_kind IN('function','grant') AND object_identity='public.mz_mark_employee_event_opened(uuid,text)')<>2
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM identity_fix_targets WHERE object_kind='grant' AND old_identity='custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'
  AND new_definition=replace(expected_old_definition,
   'reset_grants(''public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'')',
   'reset_grants(''custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'')'))<>1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact identity/canary grant predecessor differs'; END IF;
END $before$;
DO $canary_patch$ DECLARE after_text text; BEGIN
 SELECT after_definition INTO STRICT after_text FROM identity_fix_canary_definition;
 EXECUTE after_text;
 IF pg_get_functiondef('public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure) IS DISTINCT FROM after_text
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface())<>1361 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact canary counterpart compilation differs'; END IF;
END $canary_patch$;
ALTER TABLE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory DISABLE TRIGGER trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable;
DO $repair$ DECLARE changed integer; BEGIN
 UPDATE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory i SET object_identity=t.new_identity,
  definition_sql=t.new_definition,definition_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(t.new_definition,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),captured_at=statement_timestamp()
 FROM identity_fix_targets t JOIN identity_fix_inventory_before b USING(inventory_id)
 WHERE i.inventory_id=t.inventory_id AND to_jsonb(i)=to_jsonb(b);
 GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT;
 IF changed<>57 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact identity update count differs'; END IF;
END $repair$;
ALTER TABLE public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory ENABLE ALWAYS TRIGGER trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable;
DO $after$ BEGIN
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM identity_fix_inventory_before)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT old.* FROM identity_fix_inventory_before old WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_fix_targets t WHERE t.inventory_id=old.inventory_id)
  EXCEPT SELECT * FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT now_row.* FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory now_row WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_fix_targets t WHERE t.inventory_id=now_row.inventory_id)
  EXCEPT SELECT * FROM identity_fix_inventory_before)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_fix_targets t JOIN identity_fix_inventory_before b USING(inventory_id)
  LEFT JOIN public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory i USING(inventory_id)
  WHERE i.inventory_id IS NULL OR i.object_kind IS DISTINCT FROM b.object_kind OR i.restore_order IS DISTINCT FROM b.restore_order
   OR i.object_identity IS DISTINCT FROM t.new_identity OR i.definition_sql IS DISTINCT FROM t.new_definition
   OR i.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(t.new_definition,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   OR (to_jsonb(i)-ARRAY['object_identity','definition_sql','definition_sha256','captured_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(b)-ARRAY['object_identity','definition_sql','definition_sha256','captured_at']))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_fix_trigger_before b LEFT JOIN pg_trigger g ON g.oid=b.oid
  WHERE to_jsonb(g) IS DISTINCT FROM b.catalog_row OR pg_get_triggerdef(g.oid,true) IS DISTINCT FROM b.live_definition)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_fix_proc_before b LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=b.oid
  WHERE CASE WHEN b.oid='public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface()'::regprocedure THEN
   (to_jsonb(p)-'prosrc') IS DISTINCT FROM (b.catalog_row-'prosrc')
   OR pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT after_definition FROM identity_fix_canary_definition)
   ELSE to_jsonb(p) IS DISTINCT FROM b.catalog_row OR pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM b.definition END)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface() s
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory i
   WHERE i.object_kind=s.object_kind AND i.object_identity=s.object_identity))
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.custodial_release_canary_authority_surface())<>1361
 OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory'::regclass
  AND tgname='trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable' AND tgenabled='A')<>1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity repair changed unrelated inventory/live trigger/function/ACL/origin/guard'; END IF;
END $after$;
COMMIT;
